FE Consult AS er et konsulentselskap som spesialiserer seg på salgstjenester og møtebooking for andre bedrifter.

jobs.title: Ma/NO lärare åk 6-9 Noblaskolan Kviberg
jobs.description:
Noblaskolan består av 18 för- och grundskolor som arbetar enligt devisen att elever som utmanas når längre. Genom en kombination av tydliga strukturer, höga förväntningar, undervisning av hög kvalitet samt trygghet och studiero ska eleverna få de bästa förutsättningarna för en bra skolgång. Noblaskolan är en del av AcadeMedias grundskolor.

Lärare i Matematik/NO åk 6-9 till Noblaskolan Kviberg

Om skolan

Noblaskolan Kviberg är en liten, välfungerande högstadieskola med cirka 312 elever i årskurserna 6–9. Skolan grundades 2012 och har sedan dess etablerat sig som ett attraktivt val för elever och vårdnadshavare i närområdet. Noblaskolan Kviberg är känd för sin goda undervisningskvalitet samt ett starkt fokus på trygghet och studiero. Skolan arbetar målmedvetet med att skapa en lärmiljö där varje elev ges möjlighet att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt, i en miljö präglad av respekt, tydlighet och höga förväntningar. Elevgruppen består huvudsakligen av elever från närområdet, särskilt stadsdelarna Utby och Kviberg.

Din profil

Vi utökar vår satsning på matematik och söker nu en engagerad och legitimerad lärare i matematik, gärna i kombination med NO.

Vi söker dig som brinner för undervisning och vill göra skillnad för våra elever. Du har ett stort personligt engagemang för lärande och drivs av att utveckla elevernas kunskaper och stärka deras tilltro till sin egen förmåga.

Du är en tydlig och lyhörd ledare i klassrummet som bygger goda relationer med eleverna och skapar en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö. Du ser värdet av kollegialt samarbete och vill tillsammans med dina kollegor utveckla undervisningen för att nå bästa möjliga resultat.

Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en fantastisk skola med engagerade kollegor och elever. Du blir en del av ett arbetslag med andra kollegor och får samtidigt ett nära samarbete med dina ämneskollegor i matematik och NO, som du träffar regelbundet för att tillsammans utveckla undervisningen.

Du kommer att undervisa i matematik i en eller flera årskurser, med möjlighet att även undervisa i NO beroende på din behörighet.

Övrig information

Som en skola inom Academedia erbjuder vi våra medarbetare kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling genom Academedia Academy samt intern och extern fortbildning. Hos oss får du självklart kollektivavtalade förmåner och försäkringar och även friskvårdsbidrag, pensionsrådgivning och möjlighet till fördelaktiga köp genom netto- och bruttolöneväxling.

Tjänsten är tillsvidare på 100 % med tillträde efter överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our our teams across Europe, mostly across our Commercial, Marketing and Operations departments. Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite.

Your responsibilities 

  • Sourcing, screening & managing candidates  - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience.

  • Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies.

  • Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets.

  • AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n).

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach.

  • Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them).

  • Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates

  • Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations.

  • Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support.

  • Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with.

The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

jobs.title: Customer Success Leader, Southern Europe & DACH
jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As the Enterprise Customer Success Leader, you are tasked with more than just facilitating the adoption of our technology. As a member of the broader Customer Success Leadership team, you will craft and execute a strategic vision for ensuring customers reach their desired outcomes, emphasizing scalability, process rigor, and the development of playbooks to fuel expansion and mitigate churn.

Through empathetic leadership and a focus on value, you will spearhead efforts to enhance renewal and expansion rates, manage and develop talent, and drive forward customer relationships with proactive engagement.

You will also play an integral part in helping to drive strategy and execution in how we deliver an end-to-end excellent customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Lead by Example: Lead a dynamic customer success team towards exceptional performance, promoting a culture of accountability, execution, growth, and relentless improvement.

  • Scalability and Process: Develop and implement strategic improvements to drive scalable strategies and playbooks, ensuring a systematic approach to all stages of the customer journey, including: implementation, adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion.

  • Talent Coaching and Development: Inspire and mentor your team, elevating their capabilities to become strategic partners through influencing and advising decision makers and fostering customer advocacy.

  • Advance Customer Relationships: Deepen client engagements through strategic interactions, serving as an advisor and advocate for key stakeholders, driving advocacy, organic growth, and referrals.

  • Own Retention: introduce processes and early warning systems to reduce churn, mitigate risk, and ensure we are multi-threaded within customer accounts.

  • Effective Collaboration: Work with leaders across the broader GTM organization, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver the voice-of-customer and drive a culture of customer-centricity.

  • Product Feedback: Ensure we develop a feedback flywheel, turning customer insights into meaningful product enhancements and service optimizations.


What You Have

  • Leadership Experience: You are a natural leader, with a proven background in leading high performing customer success teams within late-stage or post-IPO Enterprise SaaS organizations, with a specific emphasis on “Strategic”, “Large Enterprise / Enterprise”, and/or top-tier / lighthouse accounts with multi-million dollar spend.

  • Strategic Acumen: Expertise in designing and executing customer success strategies that foster adoption, reduce churn, and promote expansion.

  • Empathy and Influence: A leadership style characterized by empathy, with a proven track record in team development through hiring, coaching, and fostering talent.

  • Outcome-Oriented: Exceptional ability to drive results through owning strategic initiatives, KPI reporting, and adept at navigating complex customer scenarios.

  • Communication Mastery: Superior communication skills, capable of effectively engaging and influencing at all organizational levels both internally, and externally.

  • Agility: Capacity to excel in a rapidly expanding, dynamic setting and swiftly adjust to evolving requirements.

  • Innovation: A genuine passion for technology and innovation, constantly seeking novel solutions to complex challenges.

jobs.title: (Senior) Data Engineer - Tracking Infrastructure (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day.

You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams.

This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking)

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization)

  • Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL

  • Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases)

  • Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases

  • Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers)

  • Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use

Your profile

  • Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred)

  • Strong skills in Python and SQL

  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect), and APIs

  • Familiarity with large-scale data systems and event-based data (tracking, logs, or similar)

  • Experience with Snowflake (or similar DWH)

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

  • Understanding of data architecture, testing, and best practices

  • Bonus: experience with DBT, streaming tools, or BI tools

What success looks like

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

  • You improve data reliability, usability, and cost efficiency

  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's insurance comparison platform.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What they'll actually do

  • Build the system that connects to multiple insurance providers and requests quotes from all of them at once

  • Design how those quotes get compared fairly and ranked for the customer

  • Build the customer database and the secure audit trail required

  • Set up cloud hosting, CI/CD pipeline, observability and security (encryption, secrets management)

Must-have skills

  • Strong backend development in Node.js / TypeScript (or very close equivalent, e.g. willing/able to work in it)

  • Experience in relational database (PostgreSQL or similar) or non relational database (MongoDB or similar) — not just querying, but designing the schema

  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs, especially handling timeouts, retries, and partial failures gracefully

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines

  • Comfortable working with sensitive customer data and security best practices (encryption, access control)

Strong nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience building a "plugin" or "adapter" style system that needs to support many different external integrations over time

  • Experience with Redis or similar for session/cache management

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in UK. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in UK.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. jobs.title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
jobs.description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

Send your application and CV or LinkedIn profile to Questions about this vacancy? Get in touch with our Corporate Recruiter Veroniek Smits at the same address.

Please note that for this role we do not work with recruitment agencies, and we're unable to accept unsolicited candidate submissions or related fees.

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box.

jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. 

What We Can Offer 

You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights 

You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there. 

What You Will Do 

  • Design and implement decoupled data supply chains, spanning landing zones, quality and transformation layers, and consumption layers, to ensure consistently high-quality data reaches analytics and AI systems 

  • Implement and document business KPIs as defined by business stakeholders, ensuring full metric traceability; define, implement, and document technical KPIs for AI application performance in collaboration with the data architect, ensuring explainability and observability across all AI-driven outputs 

  • Build and maintain a semantic layer that enables AI-based insight generation, bridging structured data assets with natural-language querying and large language model (LLM) integration 

  • Lead the expansion of existing BI reporting with AI-supported, RAG-driven analytics, progressively complementing manual report runs with dynamic, contextual insight delivery 

  • Develop and maintain data models, transformations, and pipelines using industry-standard tooling, complementing existing data infrastructure and ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability throughout 

  • Expose data assets and AI services via well-designed APIs, supporting consumption by both technical and non-technical consumers 

  • Act as a frontline coach and enabler for business users and citizen analysts, building AI and data literacy across the organisation and supporting adoption of AI-assisted workflows 

  • Embed security-by-design principles into all analytics and AI assets, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse 

  • Collaborate across IT, data, security, and business functions to ensure analytics outputs are governed, compliant with EU AI Act and GDPR requirements, and aligned to Intersnack's data sovereignty standards 


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing multi-layer data architectures, including landing zones, transformation layers, and consumption layers

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting or transformation language (e.g., Python, dbt) for data modelling and pipeline development

  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, vector stores, and RAG patterns, including the ability to build semantic layers and design LLM-integrated workflows using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph

  • Experience with BI and analytics platforms (e.g., Qlik, Power BI, or equivalent) and a clear understanding of how to complement existing reporting with AI-assisted delivery

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or AWS data and AI services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, AWS Glue, SageMaker, or equivalent)

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with and understand non-technical business users, translating AI and data concepts into business language with clarity and confidence

  • Solid understanding of AI security fundamentals, including risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and chain-reaction errors in AI pipelines

  • Awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks, including GDPR, the EU AI Act, and data sovereignty principles applicable in the EU context

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage

Valuable Experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Purview, or OneLake for unified data governance and discovery, and with Microsoft Foundry for building and deploying LLM-integrated workflows and AI applications

  • Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or procurement environments, with an understanding of the data and reporting challenges specific to these domains

  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical application of AI ethics frameworks

 

Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position.

jobs.title: Vi söker lagermedarbetare på heltid i Kungsängen
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten


Som lagerarbetare hos vår kund får du möjlighet att arbeta i en modern och välorganiserad logistikverksamhet. Du blir en viktig del av det dagliga flödet och bidrar till att verksamheten fungerar effektivt. Rollen passar dig som trivs i en aktiv arbetsmiljö och vill utveckla dina kunskaper och erfarenheter inom lager och logistik.

Tjänsten är på heltid och anställningen är en visstidsanställning på 6 månader, med möjlighet att bygga vidare på din erfarenhet inom logistik.

Arbetstiderna är förlagda till både dag- och kvällstid:

Dagtid: 05.55–14.40
Kvällstid: 14.50–23.35


Dina arbetsuppgifter


I rollen som lagerarbetare kommer du framför allt att arbeta med:

Inleverans och mottagning av varor.
Plockning av varor utifrån inkommande ordrar.
Packning och hantering av kundordrar inför leverans.
Bidra till att det dagliga lagerflödet fungerar effektivt och smidigt.


Vad vi söker


Hos vår kund blir du en del av ett härligt och engagerat team. Vi söker dig som är en positiv och hjälpsam kollega som gärna stöttar dina arbetskamrater och bidrar till en bra arbetsmiljö.

Som person är du driven, effektiv och noggrann och har en stark vilja att alltid göra ett bra jobb. Du trivs i ett högt arbetstempo, tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och har förmågan att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Krav:
Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, är ett krav för tjänsten.

Meriterande:
Tidigare erfarenhet av lagerarbete.
Tidigare erfarenhet av butiksarbete.
Truckkort.
Tillgång till egen bil.

Tidigare erfarenhet är dock inget krav – vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, din inställning och din vilja att göra ett bra jobb.

Övrig information

Detta är ett bemanningsuppdrag via Pokayoke.

Intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag!


Om Pokayoke


Pokayoke är ett kompetensbolag inom logistik med bemanning som kärnverksamhet. Vi består av logistikspecialister och med vår långa erfarenhet i branschen finns det inte en logistikutmaning vi inte stått inför. Detta är en kunskap vi nu vill dela med oss av.

Hos oss är alla lika värda. Vi tar hand om varandra och vill ständigt lära varandra och av varandra. Vi är öppna för utveckling och gör alltid vårt bästa i uppdrag och samarbeten vi jobbar med. Inställningen är det viktigaste på Pokayoke!

jobs.title: Assistent restaurantmanager
jobs.description:
3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden

Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het leiden van het team en samen met de collega's voor een klantgerichte werking zorgen
  • een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde sfeer op de werkvloer creëren
  • het opvolgen en streven naar het behalen van de verkoopdoelstellingen
  • nauw samenwerken met de manager, waarbij je rapporteert over de resultaten
  • assisteren bij taken zoals het opstellen van werkroosters, het beheren van de voorraad en het uitvoeren van kassawerkzaamheden
  • inspringen in de keuken of de bediening waar nodig om op die manier een voorbeeldfunctie te bekleden en de voeling met het dagelijks reilen en zeilen van het restaurant te behouden
  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

jobs.title: Gitarrlärare akustik gitarr/notspel till privat musikskola
jobs.description:
Om jobbet

Vår privata internationella musikskola i Lund är välkänd för sin konstnärliga och musikpedagogiska kvalitet. Vi undervisar privata elever som drivs av sitt brinnande intresse och elever med Lunds och Staffanstorps musikcheck. Vi söker nu en ny gitarrlärare med klassisk inriktning till vårt lärarteam. Undervisningen är förlagd till tisdagar, onsdagar och söndagar i vårt eget hus i Lund.

Du ska ha utbildning från musikhögskola, ev folkhögskola och erfarenhet av att undervisa. Ditt eget musicerande har en bra nivå inom den klassiska repertoaren och du känner dig trygg med att bygga upp eleverna i både not-och gehörsspel. Du har goda vanor att själv planera ditt arbete, både på kort sikt och med längre perspektiv. Vi lägger värde på att du har god repertoarkunskap och hittar rätt stycke för rätt elev i rätt ögonblick. Du gillar att inspirera eleverna till kammarmusik och ensemblespel, gärna med en av våra många elevkonserter som mål. Du tycker att det är kul att möta nya människor och skapa goda relationer.

Språk: LIMUS är en internationell musikskola. Vårt vardagsspråk är svenska som du behöver kunna tala och förstå flytande. Är du ny i Sverige så behöver du ha minst ett Svenska B1 – prov eller likvärdiga kunskaper. En god kommunikationsförmåga är grunden för skolans goda samarbeten. Utöver svenska behöver du på denna tjänst kunna undervisa på engelska. Du kommer arbeta i ett team med ytterst kompetenta lärare där du både får utrymme för dina egna idéer och möter en väl strukturerad arbetsplats där spridandet av glädjen för musiken står i centrum.

Den här tjänsten passar utmärkt till dig som vill kombinera undervisning med annat arbete, alternativ har du nyss pensionerad dig, men känner att du fortfarande har lust att jobba med unga människor. Många av våra lärare är aktiva frilansmusiker eller undervisar som klasslärare i musik. Viktigt för oss är att du tar undervisningen på allvar, garanterar kontinuitet och följer våra elevers schema för undervisningsveckor.

Som privat musikskola i Sverige som dessutom beskattas med 25% moms, har vi inga möjligheter att betala löner som skattefinansierade kommunala kulturskolor. Vi tillämpar timbetalning med en viss garanti på volym per termin. Gällande deltagande i elevkonserter och andra projekt avgör du själv hur mycket du vill jobba med separat betalning.

Har du rätt kompetens, så kan tjänsten kombineras med undervisning i musikteori.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Tillträde: senast januari 2027, men gärna tidigare.

Vi hos 24Trans søger en selvstændig og serviceorienteret varebilschauffør. Hvis du elsker at være på farten, kan stå på egne ben og samtidig tæller kollegaer og kunder som venner, er det måske netop dig, vi leder efter.

 

Hvad får du?

    En fast rute og et stabilt arbejdsområde.

    Egen lift-bil med plads til 8 paller – klar til hver udfordring 

    Et kollegialt team, der støtter og trækker i samme åg 

    Selvstændigt ansvarsfuldt arbejde med plads til egen indflydelse 

    Løn i overenskomst og klare rammer for dit arbejde 

    En central rolle i vores levering og kundeservice

     

 Hvem er du?

    Du har kørekort klasse B og varebilschaufførbevis (eller vilje til at tage det) 

    Er mødestabil, pålidelig og altid klar til at yde sit bedste 

    Har et positivt og løsningsorienteret sind 

    Elsker at repræsentere virksomheden professionelt over for kunder 

    Kan godt lide at arbejde selvstændigt – men er aldrig helt alene

    

  Hvad går dagen ud på?

Din dag starter med at laste bilen og tjekke din rute. Derefter er det op til dig at levere til kunderne – hurtigt, sikkert og med et smil. Du er ofte alene undervejs, men aldrig uden støtte. Vi er altid i kontakt og bakker op om hinanden, når det gælder. Derudover passer du på bilen, rapporterer fejl og sikrer, at leverancerne hele tiden løber som smurt.

 

Sådan søger du:

Send dit CV til: trans24-online@outlook.com 

Vi fører interviews løbende, så vent ikke – tag skridtet i dag og bliv en del af vores hold!

jobs.title: RESTAURANGBITRÄDE- SEN STREET KITCHEN SKELLEFTEÅ
jobs.description:
Restaurangsbiträde till SEN STREET KITCHEN

SEN STREET KITCHENär ett restaurangkoncept inspirerat av de livliga gatumarknaderna i östra Asien. Vi fokuserar på autentiska smaker och ett arbetssätt som är enkelt, snabbt, nyttigt och fräscht. Kvalitet, tempo och struktur är centralt i allt vi gör.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett kök med tydliga rutiner och högt tempo, där samarbete och ansvar är en självklar del av vardagen.

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Introduktion i vårt kök, våra rutiner och vårt koncept

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Ett sammansvetsat och familjärt team

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 En strukturerad arbetsmiljö med fokus på kvalitet och hygien

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Arbete i ett etablerat restaurangkoncept med tydliga arbetssätt

Vem är du?

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Du är social, positiv och serviceinriktad

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Du arbetar bra i team och klarar högt tempo

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Du är noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och organiserad

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Du värdesätter ordning, renlighet och struktur

Arbetsuppgifter

Som köksbiträde hos oss ingår bland annat:

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Prepp

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Matlagning

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Montering av maträtter

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Kassatjänst

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Disk och städ

󠁯•󠁏󠁏 Mottagning av leveranser

Ansökan

Känner du att detta passar dig? Skicka in din ansökan så berättar vi mer.

En kort videopresentation är meriterande.

---------------

Om SENGROUP

SEN STREET KITCHEN är en del avSENGROUP, en asiatisk restaurangkoncern med rötter i Stockholm. Idag driver vi 6 restauranger i 5 städer runt om i Sverige. Våra koncept hämtar inspiration från olika delar av Asien och bygger på smak, kvalitet och väl genomarbetade arbetssätt.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Guldvän sökes till Bromma
jobs.description:
Guldtid erbjuder personligt sällskap och socialt stöd till äldre personer och personer med funktionsnedsättning eller sjukdom. Vi är ett komplement till vård och omsorg.

Våra sällskapspersoner kallas Guldvänner. Vi matchar varje kund med en Guldvän utifrån behov, personlighet och intressen. Målet är en trygg och långsiktig relation.

Guldvän sökes till äldre person i Bromma

Vi söker en Guldvän till en äldre person med demenssjukdom som bor på ett vård- och omsorgsboende i Bromma.

Kunden vill komma ut på promenader, cafébesök, museer och andra utflykter. Kunden använder rullstol och har begränsad förmåga till samtal.

Vi söker dig som är varm, positiv och initiativrik. Du behöver kunna skapa trygghet och gemenskap även när samtalet är begränsat. Du ska trivas med att hitta på aktiviteter och kunna anpassa dig efter kundens dagsform.

Plats: Bromma

Omfattning: 6 timmar per vecka, fördelade på två träffar

Start: Så snart som möjligt

Uppdragets längd: Långsiktigt

Krav för uppdraget

    Erfarenhet av personer med demenssjukdom.
    Ett varmt, positivt och tryggt bemötande.
    Förmåga att skapa gemenskap även utan samtal.
    Förmåga att ta initiativ och genomföra utflykter.
    Trygghet i att följa med personer med kognitiva svårigheter i offentliga miljöer.

Meriterande: Undersköterskeutbildning eller erfarenhet från vård- och omsorgsboende.

Om arbetet som Guldvän

Som Guldvän träffar du samma kund regelbundet. Träffarna anpassas efter kundens behov och önskemål och kan innehålla samtal, promenader, utflykter, musik och andra aktiviteter.

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd, pålitlig och ansvarstagande. Du behöver tala god svenska och vilja bygga en långsiktig relation med kunden.

Arbetet passar som extraarbete eller deltidsarbete och kan kombineras med studier, pension eller annan sysselsättning.

Efter godkänd rekrytering blir du en del av Guldtids Guldvänsdatabas och kan matchas med fler kunder. Vi kan inte garantera ett visst antal arbetstimmar.

Ansökan

För att ansöka behöver du genomföra två steg:

    Registrera dig med BankID och fyll i ansökan på guldtid.se/se/sv/jobba-med-oss. ANGE VILKET UPPDRAG DET GÄLLER UNDER "Ytterligare information".

OBSERVERA - OM DU INTE FYLLER I DINA KONTAKTUPPGIFTER PÅ HEMSIDAN KOMMER VI INTE KUNNA KONTAKTA DIG OCH DU BLIR RADERAD FRÅN SYSTMET

Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och uppdraget kan starta omgående.

jobs.title: Kock à la carte - Deltid
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced kitchen chef who is familiar with Slavic cuisine (Poland, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, etc.) to join us at Bar Bez Mleczny on Kungsgatan in central Gothenburg. This is a part-time role including afternoon and evening shifts. The role focuses on preparation before opening, à la carte cooking and plating.

About us

Bar Bez Mleczny opened in March 2026 and offers plant‑based comfort food inspired by Polish and Russian home cooking – pierogi, soups, and classic dishes made modern. Production happens in our prep kitchen, while service runs in the café and at events.

About the role

You’ll be responsible for the service flow in the kitchen, from prep before opening to clean‑down after closing. You should be comfortable working independently, keeping the kitchen organised, and maintaining high standards of taste and presentation.

Job duties

    Prepare and cook dishes during service (pierogi, soups, salads, sides, crepes)
    Do pre‑opening prep such as salads, mashed potatoes, portioning, etc
    Set up the kitchen for service
    Ensure consistent quality, taste, and presentation across all dishes
    Maintain hygiene, cleanliness, and correct labelling throughout the shift
    Keep the kitchen organized after service and prepared for the morning shift

Qualifications

    3+ years of experience as a cook or chef in a restaurant/service kitchen
    Hands‑on experience with Slavic cuisine is beneficial (e.g. pierogi/vareniki, borscht, zupa ogórkowa, blini, kotlety, salads, etc.)
    Comfortable taking responsibility for the kitchen during service and making practical decisions
    At least B2 English level (we are an international company)
    Swedish is an advantage
    Polish, Russian, or Ukrainian is a strong plus
    Valid B driver’s license is a strong advantage

Nice to have (but not required)

    Knowledge of vegan or vegetarian cuisine
    Experience with batch‑style prep or working closely with a production kitchen

We offer

    Part-time position (15-20 hours/weekly) in a growing vegan food concept
    Opportunity to shape how evening service runs in a small, creative team
    Market‑typical salary
    4000 SEK/year wellness allowance

Start: Immediately

Selection: ongoing

Montering

Låter detta som något för dig? Ansök idag!  Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta kevin@submitbemanning.se

jobs.title: Fler medarbetare inom produktion
jobs.description:
Vi på Submit Bemanning & Rekrytering söker efter flera medarbetare till vår partner i Tyresö.

Om vår partner:

Vår kund är en etablerad leverantör av fisk till restauranger, sushibarer och storkök. Med många års erfarenhet i branschen och ett starkt fokus på kvalitet, service och pålitliga leveranser har företaget byggt upp ett mycket gott rykte bland sina kunder.

Bolaget är ledande i hela Sverige med att leverera fisk och fiskprodukter till sushi-resturanger i hela Sverige.

jobs.title: Vil du gjøre en forskjell for eldre – og være med å utvikle HeimeBest?
jobs.description:
HeimeBest søker en omsorgsfull og initiativrik medarbeider i Bodø. Vi ser etter deg som har et hjerte for mennesker, tar ansvar og liker å få ting til å skje!

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har et stort engasjement for mennesker, men som også har pågangsmot og lyst til å skape noe.

Du trives med å jobbe selvstendig, tar initiativ og ser muligheter der andre kanskje ser utfordringer. Du liker å bygge relasjoner, oppsøke nye kontakter og bidra til at gode ideer blir gjennomført.

Hos oss får du ansvar og tillit, men vi forventer også at du tar eierskap til arbeidsoppgavene dine og bidrar aktivt til utviklingen av HeimeBest.

Personlig egnethet, engasjement og gjennomføringsevne vil bli særlig vektlagt. Førerkort klasse B og tilgang til egen bil er et krav. Kjøregodtgjørelse dekkes etter statens gjeldende satser.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Gjennomføre kundeoppdrag med sosialt samvær, aktiviteter, følge til avtaler og praktisk bistand i hverdagen.

  • Skape trygghet, gode relasjoner og kontinuitet for eldre og deres pårørende.

  • Ha dialog med kunder, pårørende og aktuelle samarbeidspartnere.

  • Bidra aktivt til synlighet, kommunikasjon og markedsføring av HeimeBest.

  • Ta initiativ til nye samarbeid, bygge nettverk og bidra til å skaffe nye kunder.

  • Bidra med ideer, forbedringer og videreutvikling av HeimeBests tjenester.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast 50 % stilling, med mulighet for økt stillingsprosent i takt med virksomhetens vekst.

  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag.

  • Stor grad av selvstendighet, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag.

  • Mulighet til å bidra aktivt til utviklingen av HeimeBest.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med tett samarbeid med daglig leder.

  • Lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

HeimeBest AS er en lokal omsorgsbedrift med base i Bodø, etablert i oktober 2025. Vi tilbyr sosialt samvær, aktiviteter, praktisk hjelp og støtte i hverdagen til eldre og deres pårørende. Vårt mål er å bidra til at flere eldre kan bo trygt og godt hjemme, med mer tid til det som skaper glede, mestring og livskvalitet.

jobs.title: 💚 Vi søker langtidsvikarer til Fjordadalen FUS barnehage!
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og skape gode barndomsminner i Hammerfest?

Hos oss i Fjordadalen FUS barnehage er det mye latter, lek, undring, små og store øyeblikk – og ikke minst en gjeng fantastiske barn som trenger trygge, engasjerte og tilstedeværende voksne.

Nå søker vi langtidsvikarer, gjerne i 100 % stilling, som ønsker å bli en del av laget vårt!

Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare ønsker en jobb, men som vil bidra til å gjøre barnehagehverdagen trygg, lærerik og full av gode opplevelser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å ha jobbet i barnehage tidligere. Vi er opptatt av hvem du er som menneske, og hva du kan bidra med.

Vi håper du:

  • Har et stort hjerte for barn.

  • Er trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Er leken, nysgjerrig og ikke redd for å by på deg selv.

  • Tar initiativ og ser hva som må gjøres.

  • Takler en hverdag som ikke alltid går etter planen.

  • Liker å samarbeide og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og ønsker å bidra over tid.

Har du fagbrev som barne- og ungdomsarbeider eller erfaring fra arbeid med barn, er det positivt, men ikke et krav.

Hva kan vi tilby?

💚 En meningsfull jobb der du gjør en forskjell hver eneste dag.

💚 Et arbeidsmiljø med gode kolleger, humor og engasjement.

💚 Muligheten til å bli godt kjent med barna og være en viktig del av deres hverdag.

💚 Varierte arbeidsdager med lek, turer, kreativitet og pedagogiske aktiviteter.

💚 Mulighet for lengre vikariater og høy stillingsprosent.

💚 Opplæring og støtte fra dyktige kolleger.

Litt om oss

Fjordadalen FUS barnehage ligger i Hammerfest. Hos oss jobber vi for at alle barn skal oppleve trygghet, mestring, vennskap og glede.

Vi ønsker oss medarbeidere som vil være med på å utvikle barnehagen videre, og som tør å komme med nye ideer og engasjement.

Vi vet at gode barnehager skapes av mennesker som bryr seg – og kanskje er du en av dem?

Praktisk informasjon

Stilling: Langtidsvikar / assistent / barne- og ungdomsarbeider

Stillingsprosent: Inntil 100 %

Oppstart: Snarest eller etter avtale

Varighet: Avklares ved ansettelse

Arbeidssted: Fjordadalen FUS barnehage, Hammerfest

Tilfredsstillende politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse, i henhold til barnehageloven.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Send oss en søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, hva som motiverer deg til å jobbe med barn, og hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

For hos oss trenger vi ikke bare flere hender – vi trenger flere gode hjerter. 💚

Om arbeidsgiveren:

null

jobs.title: Bagare
jobs.description:
Bagare sökes till växande bageri i Malmö

Vill du vara med på vår tillväxtresa?

Vi är ett mindre bageri i Malmö som växer och nu söker en engagerad och pålitlig bagare till vår produktion.

Hos oss står hantverket, kvaliteten och effektiv produktion i fokus. Vi söker dig som gillar att kavla upp ärmarna, arbeta i ett högt tempo och samtidigt vara noggrann med det du lämnar ifrån dig. Du förstår att bra produkter kräver både känsla för hantverket och en vilja att få jobbet gjort.

Vi driver ett eget café där vi säljer våra egenproducerade produkter, med särskilt fokus på våra populära bagels. Vi levererar också till en rad andra verksamheter, och efterfrågan på våra produkter ökar.

I början av nästa år flyttar vi stora delar av produktionen till ett större bageri. Därför söker vi nu fler duktiga medarbetare som vill vara med och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med oss.

Om tjänsten

    Inledningsvis cirka 50 % tjänstgöringsgrad.
    Goda möjligheter att snabbt utöka arbetstiden i takt med att produktionen växer.
    Arbete med daglig bageriproduktion med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och jämna resultat.
    En möjlighet att bli en viktig del av ett växande bageri med ambitioner framåt.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är ansvarstagande, arbetsvillig och pålitlig. Du trivs med fysiskt arbete, gillar ett högt tempo och tar stolthet i att producera produkter av hög kvalitet.

jobs.title: Vi søker trygg og engasjert miljøveileder
jobs.description:
Hafrsfjord skole er en barneskole som ligger i flotte omgivelser, med nærhet til sjø, fine turområder og flotte idrettsanlegg. Skolen har 320 elever fordelt på 14 klasser og 51 ansatte. På SFO har vi rundt 190 elever. Vi har en bydekkende STOLT-avdeling for barn som trenger særskilt tilrettelagt opplæring. Personalet er tverrfaglig sammensatt med spesialpedagoger, miljøveiledere og miljøarbeidere.  

STOLT-avdelingen vil fra august av bestå av 19 elever, og er delt inn i to team bestående av spesialpedagoger og miljøveiledere. STOLT-avdeling har i tillegg en fagveileder som kan gi faglig støtte og bidra til kompetanse-utvikling hos personalet. 

Vi er en skole med profesjonsfellesskap som satsingsområde. Sammen med det ordinære undervisningstilbudet og ordinær SFO, er vi ÈN skole som samarbeider tett og godt på tvers av de tre avdelingene. Stillingen vil hovedsakelig være tilknyttet STOLT, men det er en forutsetning at du er villig til å jobbe i alle avdelingene (skole, SFO og STOLT). Elevene skal møte trygge og profesjonelle voksne med høy kompetanse og ekte hjertevarme. 

Vi verdsetter godt samarbeid på tvers av team og avdelinger. Vi er helt avhengig av dyktige ansatte og gode system for å legge til rette for læring og fellesskap for alle elever. 

Vi utvider STOLT-avdelingen fra høsten 2026, og lyser ut et vikariat for skoleåret 2026/2027. .

Du finner mer informasjon om skolen på www.minskole.no/hafrsfjord


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til å øke STOLT elevenes faglig og sosial læring og utvikling, gjennom hele tidsrommet eleven er på skolen. Skole og SFO.
  • Hjelpe eleven til å utvikle selvstendige ferdigheter, gjennom pedagoigisk opplegg for elevene med ulik diagnoser.
  • Oppfølging av elever med omfattende lærevansker og som kan ha en atferd som utfordrer.
  • Samarbeide med pedagoger og andre miljøveiledere.
  • Delta aktivt med eleven ute og inne.
  • Delta i planlegging og gjennomføring av samarbeidsmøter med foreldre.
  • Være med å planlegge, iverksette og evaluere tydelige mål for eleven 
  • Ansvar for å organisere et godt SFO- tilbud i samarbeid med andre ped.medarbeider/miljøveilederne. 
  • Arbeidstid mellom 7.30-16.30
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det er ønskelig med godkjent 3-årig universitet-/høyskoleutdanning.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn som har lærevansker eller atferd som utfordrer.
  • Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt.
  • Ønskelig at du har kunnskap om og/eller erfaring med 
         - Bruk av metoder som anvendes til barn med autismespekterforstyrrelse. 
         - ASK (Alternativ supplerende kommunikasjon). 
  • Du må kunne ha gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig for å kommunisere med elevene.
  • Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må du kunne dokumentere at du har språknivå tilsvarende B2. Dette gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er en trygg og tydelig voksen, som er en god rollemodell for elevene 
  • Du er autoritativ – tydelig og varm, og jobber etter rutiner og tiltak for elevene. 
  • Du har godt humør, er fleksibel å respektere andre. 
  • Du er ROBUST og takler å stå i krevende situasjoner. Du har stor arbeidskapasitet, tåler avvisning og utforutsette handlinger 
  • Du er positiv, tålmodig, raus, strukturert, fleksibel og løsningsorientert 
  • Du har et genuint engasjement og hjerte for eleven 
  • Du er en lagspiller som er lojal og kan samarbeide godt, både med enkeltpersoner og i team  
  • Du trives med å jobbe tett på enkeltelever 
  • Du liker utfordringer og trives i et arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo. 
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner 
  • Du tar ansvar for å holde deg faglig oppdatert og viser et faglig engasjement som også kommer elever og kollegaer til gode 
  • Du kan delta i svømming og andre fysiske aktiviteter med elev. 
Vi tilbyr
  • En skole med tre avdelinger hvor vi er opptatt av at vi er én skole.
  • En god, hektisk og humørfylt arbeidsplass.
  • Gode kollegaer som gleder seg til å bli kjent med deg!
  • Frisk luft, god takhøyde og godt samarbeidsklima.
  • Tett og systematisk oppfølgning, veiledning og støtte av skolens ledelse.
  • Gode forsikrings og pensjonsordninger.
  • HJEM-JOBB-HJEM ordningen
  • Lønn etter utdannelse og ansiennitet, stillingskode: Miljøveileder med Bachelor (BV, sosialt arbeid, sosionom, vernepleier, barnehagelærer, psykolog).
KontaktinformasjonDaniela Meniconi, Avdelingsleder, 45194007, daniela.meniconi@stavanger.kommune.no
Marte Gundersen Meldahl, Rektor, 90037976, marte.g.meldahl@stavanger.kommune.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere. Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke.

Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 

Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest: Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Nære relasjoner: For å ivareta tillit, habilitet og en hensiktsmessig organisering av arbeidet, ber vi søkere opplyse om eventuelle nære relasjoner til ansatte eller ledere i virksomheten. Slike forhold kan i enkelte tilfeller få betydning i ansettelsesprosessen.

Vedlegg: Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.
