jobs.title: Helgestillinger
jobs.description:
Hei, fremtidige kollega!

Leter du etter en jobb hvor du får kombinert faglig utvikling med et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø?

Øya helsehus søker nå etter positive og engasjerte lagspillere til ti faste 17 prosent stillinger med arbeid hver tredje helg.

Øya helsehus består av 125 korttidsplasser fordelt på sju avdelinger. Tjenestetilbudet på helsehuset består av øyeblikkelig hjelp døgntilbud, medisinsk observasjon og behandling, palliativ avdeling, etterbehandling for hjertemedisin og lindrende behandling. Pasientene kommer fra St. Olavs hospital eller hjemmet for tidsavgrensede opphold. På våre sju avdelinger er vi leger, sykepleiere, vernepleiere, helsefagarbeidere, fysioterapeuter og ergoterapeuter som jobber sammen.

Hos oss ønsker vi at du som ny kollega skal føle deg godt ivaretatt og du vil få god opplæring i oppgaver og rutiner. Vi heier på et personale som deler raust av smil, humør og vet at pågangsmot og motivasjon smitter.

Har du lyst på en spennende og lærerik jobb med varierte dager i et miljø med høy kompetanse? Da håper vi at du søker!

Øya helsehus ligger sentralt i hjertet av Trondheim og har gode kollektive forbindelser. Dersom du ønsker å sykle til jobb har vi en sykkelgarasje som kan benyttes.

Mer informasjon om jobb i helse i Trondheim kommune finner du her


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Faglige tjenester: Gi trygge og gode helsetjenester til våre pasienter
  • Hverdagstøtte: Bistå med hjelp, veiledning og støtte i daglige gjøremål
  • Klinisk blikk: Utføre observasjoner og vurderinger, iverksette tiltak og dokumentere underveis
  • Mestring og aktivitet: Bidra aktivt med aktivisering og opptrening av pasientene
  • Ernæring: Observasjon og tilrettelegging ved måltider, samt enkelte oppgaver på kjøkkenet
  • Dokumentasjon: Bruk av journalsystemet Helseplattformen for nøyaktig og sikker dokumentasjon
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant utdanning og/eller erfaring innenfor helse
  • Gode ferdigheter i norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Må være fylt 19 år
Personlige egenskaper

For å trives hos oss på Øya helsehus, ser vi for oss at du er en person som kjenner deg igjen i dette:

  • Positiv og arbeidsom: Du møter oppgavene med energi og tar i et tak der det trengs
  • Glad i utfordringer: Du trives når dagene er varierte og tar nye utfordringer på strak arm
  • Gode samarbeidsevner: Du kommuniserer godt med både pasienter og kolleger, og forstår verdien av godt lagarbeid
  • En miljøskaper: Med ditt gode humør og engasjement bidrar du aktivt til at Øya helsehus er et godt sted å jobbe
  • Trygg og fokusert: Du er trygg på deg selv og klarer å prioritere de viktigste oppgavene, selv når det er mye som skjer samtidig
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges ved ansettelse
Vi tilbyr
  • Oppstart etter avtale
  • Ved Øya helsehus vil du møte pasienter med en rekke ulike diagnoser og skaffe deg bred erfaring
  • En arbeidsplass med høy kompetanse og inkluderende medarbeidere
  • Mulighet for ekstravakter utover fast stilling og arbeid i ferie og høytider
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

jobs.title: Assistent i spesialpedagogisk team
jobs.description:
Strinda barnehager har behov for å utvide sitt spesialpedagogiske team og søker etter assistent til en fast 100 prosent stilling fra 1. januar 2027. 

Trondheim kommune etablerte 1. august 2024 en ny organisering av det spesialpedagogiske tilbudet i barnehagene. Organiseringen skal sikre at barn med rett til spesialpedagogisk hjelp og tilrettelegging får tidlig hjelp i et inkluderende fellesskap.

Vi leter etter deg som ser mestring og kompetanse i hvert enkelt barn og som jobber for å videreutvikle dette i et fellesskap med andre. Har du et stort hjerte og ønske om å utgjøre en forskjell, kan akkurat du være den vi ser etter.

Strinda barnehager består av Brøset, Lidarende, Persaunet og Rønningen barnehage. Enheten vår har cirka 300 barn og 100 ansatte. Strinda barnehager er vertsbarnehage, med forsterket bygg på Brøset, og har ansvaret for det spesialpedagogiske arbeidet i en klynge som består av flere private og kommunale barnehager i nærområdet. 

Blir du tilsatt som assistent i vårt spesialpedagogiske team, skal du ha ditt daglige virke i en og/eller flere av våre barnehager i klynga. Vår klynge består av Berg barnehage, Hundremeterskogen barnehage, Læringsverkstedet Sætra idrettsbarnehage, Prestegårdsjordet barnehage, Regnbuen barnehage, samt Strinda barnehager.

Stillingen inngår i team med våre åtte erfarne ansatte med komplementerende kunnskap.

Det spesialpedagogiske teamet skal bidra og bistå barnehagene slik at alle barn skal oppleve tilhørighet og inkludering i hverdagen i barnehagen. Det betyr at ansatte i spesialpedagogiske team har et særskilt ansvar for at barn som trenger ekstra hjelp og støtte får mest mulig av hjelpen innenfor det allmennpedagogiske tilbudet sammen med andre barn, i små og store grupper etter behov. Teamene skal utøve arbeidet i samarbeid med de ansatte i barnehagene og innenfor rammene for organisering og planlegging i den enkelte barnehage. 

Vi søker etter assistent, men oppfordrer også andre yrkesgrupper til å søke.

Mer informasjon om jobb i barnehage i Trondheim kommune finnes på Jobb i barnehage.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utøve støtte og tilrettelegging for barn med nedsatt funksjonsevne, i tråd med vedtak etter barnehagelovens paragraf 37. 
  • Bistå med spesialpedagogisk hjelp til barn, i tråd med vedtak etter barnehagelovens paragraf 31.
  • Arbeide målrettet og systematisk med å inkludere barn i lek og meningsfullt fellesskap. 
  • Bistå med dokumentasjon og observasjon av barns utvikling og behov.
  • Samhandle med barn, foreldre og ansatte i den enkelte barnehage, samt andre instanser i laget rundt barnet.
  • Støtte opp om en inkluderende praksis i barnehagen.
  • Bistå i systemisk veiledning og organisering, i ulike barnehager. 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det er ønskelig med kompetanse og/eller erfaring fra barnehage.
  • Det er ønskelig med erfaring med å stå i tette relasjoner til barn og familier med ulike hjelpebehov.
  • Det er en fordel om du har fagbrev som barne- og ungdomsarbeider eller helsefagarbeider, men det er ikke et krav.
  • Annen relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende utdanning.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du må ha et genuint ønske om å være en betydningsfull voksen i barns liv.
  • Du har fokus på barns styrker og iboende muligheter og evner å ivareta og utvikle et inkluderende miljø.
  • Du er engasjert og deltar aktivt i lek og aktiviteter med barn.
  • Du har evne og vilje til å skape gode relasjoner.
  • Du kan jobbe selvstendig, men også som del av et team. 
  • Du har evne til å være strukturert og jobbe i tråd med barnets planer.
  • Du har evne og vilje til å reflektere over egen væremåte.
  • Du er endringsvillig og fleksibel i en stadig skiftende barnehagehverdag.
  • Du er positiv og bidrar til å fremme et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Vi tilbyr
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø preget av høy faglig kompetanse.
  • Høy grad av åpenhet, deling og refleksjonskultur.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Du vil bli en del av et engasjert og faglig fellesskap som tilbyr spennende og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

jobs.title: Avdelingsleder
jobs.description:
Ved Romolslia barnehage er det fra 1. februar 2027 ledig en fast 100 prosent stilling som avdelingsleder.

På Romolslia barnehage skal vi skape trygghet, øke barns nysgjerrighet og etablere et godt fellesskap. Er du avdelingslederen som vil være med på å gjøre en forskjell i barns hverdag gjennom god ledelse?

Romolslia barnehage er plassert midt i hjertet av Romolslia og består av to bygg innenfor samme gjerde. Enheten har 86 barn og 34 årsverk fordelt i grunnbemanning, administrasjon og spesialpedagogisk team. Vi er opptatt av å skape trygge rammer for å sikre barn et trygt og godt læringsmiljø. Gjennom temaplanen SteinSaksPapir skal vi legge føringer for hvordan vi i fellesskap skal skape hverdager preget av mestring, trygghet og inkludering for alle barn og familier i bydelen vår. Som avdelingsleder på Romolslia skal du arbeide i tråd med temaplanens kunnskapsgrunnlag og prinsipper. 

Trondheim kommune har innført en helhetlig modell for inkluderende praksis. Den innebærer at alle barn skal oppleve tilhørighet til fellesskapet i barnehagen og sikre et tilpasset, inkluderende og likeverdig tilbud, uavhengig av hvilken barnehage barnet går i. Vi er vertsbarnehage i vår samarbeidende klynge, som innebærer koordinering og personal- og oppfølgingsansvar for det spesialpedagogiske teamet.

Du vil bli en del av vårt lederteam som består av enhetsleder, avdelingsleder og spesialpedagogisk koordinator. Du vil få delegert lederansvar innenfor fag, utviklingsarbeid, personal og økonomi. Stillingen innebærer et stort ansvar, og du vil være enhetsleders stedfortreder. Det er store krav til selvstendighet og engasjement for å bidra til å videreutvikle barnehagetilbudet i Trondheim kommune. Det gis gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. 

Avdelingsleder må være motivert for å være med å lede dette arbeidet, samt utvikle et fellesskap for alle barn.

Mer informasjon om jobb i barnehage i Trondheim kommune finnes på vår side Jobb i barnehage.

Se også vår hjemmeside Romolslia barnehage for mer informasjon om oss.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Personalansvar for en gruppe ansatte, inkludert oppfølgings-og utviklingssamtaler og systematisk sykefraværsoppfølging
  • Utøve nærledelse for alle ansatte innenfor ditt ansvarsområde
  • Medansvar for økonomi og drift
  • Medansvar for HMS og arbeidsmiljø ved å sikre ivaretakelsen av et godt partssamarbeid og medvirkning på enheten
  • Være en refleksjonspartner, med fokus på å lete etter muligheter og løsninger
  • Ledelse av lærings- og utviklingsprosesser
  • Stedfortreder for enhetsleder
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Barnehagelærerutdanning eller annen høgskoleutdanning som gir barnefaglig og pedagogisk kompetanse
  • Ønskelig med formell lederutdanning og/eller erfaring knyttet til ledelse av personal og fag 
Personlige egenskaper
  • God gjennomføringsevne og beslutningsdyktighet
  • God evne til å overføre kunnskap til praksis
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne
  • Interesse og engasjement for personalledelse
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og i team
  • At du står støtt i krevende situasjoner, og trives i en variert hverdag med høyt tempo
Vi tilbyr
  • Et inkluderende og faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kontinuerlig læring
  • Mulighet til å påvirke og sette preg på enhetens utvikling
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
A little about ADP

We are a global leader in human resources technology, offering the latest AI and machine learning-enhanced payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and much more. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive, down-to-earth culture that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition as a global Best Places to Work and a recipient of many prestigious awards for diversity, equity, and inclusion, including a DiversityInc® Top 50 Company, Best CEO and company for women, LGBTQ+, multicultural talent, and more.

Sales at ADP

It's what drives our global growth as a world-wide leader of workforce solutions. With us, you can achieve your best within a Sales-centric, performance-oriented environment. We give you the tools to succeed, with continuous opportunities to train and advance. And as you develop the relationships that fuel our growth, you can enjoy the rewards and recognition you deserve.


Position Summary:

As our Field Sales Manager for our Swiss market,
•    You will be representing ADP and all the local & international services and products that we can offer to our clients.
•    Your main responsibility is on creating new business opportunities and make sure you close the deal.
•    You will be directly reporting to the Sales Director and will have tight relationships with other local & international District Managers, Global Sales Managers, and important stakeholders in the ADP organization (Implementation, Customer Service, Sales Support etc) to orchestrate the service excellence value proposition delivered to the customer.
•    You will be the owner and plan your territory or account approach in accordance with the Sales strategy.
•    Provide visibility on Sales activities, providing accurate monthly forecast and ensuring maintenance of Salesforce.com with all new account, opportunity, contact and adhere to the current defined Sales processes.


Profile:

Requires 3+ years as an AI Engineer, 5+ years in Software Engineering, experience with Apache Kafka, strongly typed backend languages, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and NLP/LLM fundamentals.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Engineer on our AI Product & Engineering Team, you'll help create new AI solutions that connect leading brands with top talent. Your creative problem-solving will enhance our platform's impact while accelerating your professional growth.

What does a great Senior AI Engineer do?

* Design and develop the foundations of our AI Architecture.
* Define data collection and modeling frameworks.
* Implement, maintain and improve classification pipelines and inference for AI Models.
* Improve application performance using quantitative metrics and business KPIs.
* Designing scalable, automated data pipelines using tools like Apache Kafka.
* Explore and implement solutions to classification problems in cooperation with Data Scientists
* Working collaboratively with other AI Engineering teams in cross product efforts.

Qualifications

* 3+ years as an AI Engineer or equivalent experience.
* Strong background in Software Engineering 5+ years of experience or equivalent
* Experience with distributed event streaming platforms (Apache Kafka).
* Experience building backend services in a strongly typed language (Rust, Scala, Go, or similar).
* Knowledge of AI / ML fundamentals and model optimization techniques.
* Knowledge of NLP, LLMs, RAG, and embedding models.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and CI/CD pipelines for deploying and maintaining backend services.
* Experience working on highly concurrent backend systems with durable state and fault tolerance.
* Knowledge of MLOps, LLM evaluation, and model lifecycle management.
* Understanding of responsible AI, security, and compliance in production systems including AWS guardrails and response style tuning.
* Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune).

Personality

* Quick thinking and acting with minimal/no supervision.

* Great communication skills.
* Experience with and desire to work for an asynchronous, remote, and global team.

jobs.title: Betriebselektriker/in
jobs.description:
Ihre Karriere bei TRAPA

Wir sind ein führendes Unternehmen in Österreich für die Herstellung von hochwertigen Naturholzböden sowie Wand- und Möbellösungen. Rund 40 Mitarbeiter/innen an 2 Standorten bilden die Grundlage für unseren Erfolg. Werden Sie Teil unserer TRAPA-Familie und entdecken Sie Ihre persönlichen Perspektiven. Verbinden Sie mit uns die Leidenschaft zum Werkstoff Holz.

große Leistungen, Authentizität, Wertschätzung, Verantwortung, Innovation

Durch diese Unternehmenswerte setzt TRAPA die Ansprüche und Ziele zur Weiterentwicklung, Zusammenarbeit mit internen sowie externen Mitarbeitern und Partnern, nachhaltiges Wachstum und Innovationen für die Zukunft.

TRAPA - von natur aus

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in St. Veit a.d. Glan suchen wir 1 Betriebselektriker/in Ihre Aufgaben:

· Störungsanalyse in elektrischen Schaltungen, SPS - Steuerungen und Regelstrecken

· Rasche, selbständige und effiziente Störungsbehebung

· Reparatur und Wartung der Produktionsanlagen sowie der Infrastruktur

· Laufende Optimierung der Produktionsanlagen

· Installationen und Inbetriebnahmen

· Unterstützung in sämtlichen elektrotechnischen Themen

Ihr Profil:

· Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik (vorhandene Meisterausbildung von Vorteil)

· Erfahrung im Bereich Antriebs-, Steuerungs- und Regeltechnik

· Pneumatik Kenntnisse

· Hydraulik Kenntnisse

· Berufserfahrung

· Selbständige und genaue Arbeitsweise

· Absolute Zuverlässigkeit

· Teamfähigkeit

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

· Langfristige und sichere Anstellung in einem erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

· Vollzeitbeschäftigung 38,50 Stunden/Woche, 1 Schicht, 4 Tage Woche

· Monatsbruttolohn von € 2800,00 mit der Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung bei entsprechender Einarbeitung, Erfahrung und Qualifikation

· Sehr gutes Betriebsklima und respektvoller Umgang

TRAPA GmbH

Blintendorfer Straße 20

9300 St. Veit a. d. Glan

http://www.trapa.at

Bewerbungen bitte schriftlich an: Hr. Kevin Garnitschnig k.garnitschnig@trapa.at

TRAPA ist ein österreichischer Hersteller von hochwertigen Naturholzböden. Das Mindestentgelt für die Stelle als Betriebselektriker/in beträgt 2.800,00 EUR brutto pro Monat auf Basis Vollzeitbeschäftigung. Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung.

jobs.title: Elektrotechniker_in | St. Ruprecht a.d. Raab
jobs.description:
APS Group festigt mit zahlreichen Standorten in ganz Österreich unsere Nähe zu Kunden und Bewerbern. Wir sind dort, wo Sie uns persönlich brauchen und kennen die Eigenheiten des jeweiligen regionalen Arbeitsmarkts. Für uns zählt der Mensch, der gute Arbeit leistet. Und damit hat er sich auch einen guten Arbeitsplatz verdient. 1 Elektrotechniker_in St. Ruprecht a.d. Raab Tätigkeitsbereich:

·Du führst eigenverantwortlich Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an elektrischen Anlagen und Maschinen durch.

·Störungen zu diagnostizieren und zu beheben gehört zu deinen täglichen Herausforderungen.

·Mit deinem technischen Know-how optimierst du unsere Produktionsprozesse und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe.

·Du installierst und nimmst neue Anlagen in Betrieb.

Die lückenlose Dokumentation deiner durchgeführten Arbeiten gehört ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben.

Fachliche Anforderungen:

·Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektrotechniker_in oder in einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.

·Berufserfahrung in der Elektrotechnik und Instandhaltung bringst du idealerweise mit.

Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell erfassen.

Persönliche Anforderungen:

·Du bist bereit, im Schichtdienst (Früh- und Nachmittagschicht) zu arbeiten sowie zur Leistung von Überstunden bereit

·Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich zügig in neue Aufgaben einzuarbeiten, zeichnen dich aus.

·Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise gehören zu deinen Stärken.

Angemessene Deutschkenntnisse entsprechend den Anforderungen der Tätigkeit

Wir bieten:

·Übernahme ins Stammpersonal des Kunden

·Ein krisensicheres Unternehmen und familiäres Umfeld mit wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur

·Persönliche Betreuung durch die APS Group

·Attraktive Sozialleistungen durch unseren Betriebsrat

Du erhältst für diese Position einen Mindestlohn von brutto 17,50 EUR pro Stunde. Eine Überzahlung ist möglich und hängt von deiner Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation ab.

Bewirb dich am besten gleich mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen - am einfachsten über den Bewerbungslink.

jobs.description:
Darba devējs ir Wandoo Finance SIA, reģ. Nr.: 40103970112

Pievienojies Wandoo Finance komandai kā Programmatūras izstrādātājs (-a) un palīdzi izstrādāt un attīstīt mērogojamu aizdevumu platformu, kas atbalstīs miljoniem aizdevumu visā pasaulē.

Mēs esam strauji augošs globāls fintech uzņēmums ar galveno biroju Latvijā un darbību Polijā, Spānijā, Rumānijā, Peru un nu jau arī Lietuvā. Mēs nodrošinām inovatīvus finanšu risinājumus dažādos tirgos, apvienojot tehnoloģisku domāšanu ar starptautisku mērogu.

Šajā amatā Tu uzņemsies atbildību par vienu no mūsu aizdevumu platformām — izstrādāsi jaunas funkcionalitātes, kas uzlabo lietotāju pieredzi, stiprināsi sistēmas stabilitāti un drošību, kā arī pilnveidosi sistēmas arhitektūru, lai tā būtu gatava straujai izaugsmei.

Šī nav pozīcija cilvēkam, kurš vienkārši izpilda uzdevumus pēc saraksta. Mēs meklējam spēcīgu tehnisko profesionāli, kurš vēlas izprast biznesa un lietotāju vajadzības un aktīvi atbalstīt uzņēmuma izaugsmi. Tu cieši sadarbsies ar produktu, analītikas un biznesa komandām, lai veidotu sistēmu, kuru izmanto desmitiem tūkstošu lietotāju un kas pārvalda miljoniem eiro aizdevumos.

Ja Tev patīk veidot uzticamas sistēmas, uzdot jautājumu “kāpēc?” pirms “kā?”, un apvienot tehnisko izcilību ar biznesa izpratni — šī loma ir Tev.

Tu pievienosies motivētu un aizrautīgu izstrādātāju komandai, kas strādā pie nākamās paaudzes aizdevumu platformas. Tas nozīmē, ka Tavi lēmumi, kods un profesionālais vērtējums tieši ietekmēs produkta attīstību.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye superhelt medarbeider?
jobs.description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Horisont?

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥 

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger. 

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳 

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg! 

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite. 

For ytterligere informasjon ta gjerne kontakt med regional salgsleder xxx på tlf: xxx 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Big Bite åpnet sin første avdeling i Trondheim i 1997 med en ambisjon om å lage rask og smakfull mat til folk i farta. I dag finnes Big Bite i hjertet av over 70 kjøpesenter og handlegater over hele Norge. Vi er en sterk nasjonal merkevare i vekst. Idéen er enkel, men supergod. Subs laget av ferske baguetter fra lokal baker, friske salater og lune wraps - servert innen sekunder med et smil på kjøpet.

The operator is also responsible for checking the quality and dimensions of finished circuit boards, sorting completed products, and reporting any problems. Additional duties include keeping the machine and workstation clean and organized, following health and safety regulations, and recording the quantities of products manufactured.

We offer: The opportunity to gain new knowledge and improve your practical skills. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within the company. A friendly and supportive team where your contribution is recognized and valued.
If you are looking for a stable job that offers opportunities for growth, values its employees, and provides a pleasant and supportive working environment, we encourage you to apply!

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Cruise Consultant til vores salgsteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse.

Som Cruise Consultant får du ansvaret for at rådgive vores kunder og sammensætte den helt rigtige krydstogtrejse. Det handler ikke bare om at finde en kahyt og en afrejsedato, men også om alt det uden om, som fly, hotel, udflugter og meget mere. Du skal forstå kundens ønsker, inspirere, rådgive og skabe en rejse, der passer til den enkelte kunde.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst salgsteam, hvor vi arbejder professionelt med salg, konvertering og kundeoplevelse, men hvor der samtidig er plads til personlighed, godt humør og forskellige måder at være en dygtig sælger på.

Om jobbet

Dine kunder kontakter os, fordi de allerede drømmer om at komme ud at rejse. Din opgave er at omsætte drømmen til den rigtige rejse.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

• Rådgive kunder om krydstogter, destinationer, rederier og rejsemuligheder

• Sælge og sammensætte individuelle krydstogtsrejser

• Afdække kundens behov og finde den løsning, der passer bedst

• Følge op på tilbud og kundehenvendelser

• Arbejde aktivt med mersalg og muligheder for at gøre kundens samlede rejse endnu bedre

• Opbygge relationer til både nye og eksisterende kunder

• Arbejde med nogle af verdens største og mest spændende krydstogtsrederier

• Holde dig opdateret på produkter, destinationer og nye muligheder i markedet

Du får naturligvis en grundig introduktion til vores produkter, systemer og rederier.

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er, at du kan lide at sælge og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater sammen med kunden.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har erfaring med salg, rådgivning eller kundekontakt

• Er god til at lytte og hurtigt kan forstå kundens ønsker og behov

• Har et naturligt kommercielt mindset og trives med mål og resultater

• Er serviceminded og forstår, at den gode kundeoplevelse og det gode salg går hånd i hånd

• Har energi, drive og lyst til at tage ansvar for dine egne kunder

• Trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige kundehenvendelser

• Er struktureret og følger dine tilbud og kunder helt til dørs

• Er fortrolig med IT og har nemt ved at lære nye systemer

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen eller kendskab til krydstogter, er det naturligvis en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Resten kan vi lære dig.

Hvem er MyCruise?

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse.

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises samt River cruises.

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder salg tæt sammen med blandt andet Concierge &  Product Marketing

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi også efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En spændende salgsrolle i en branche, hvor produktet virkelig kan begejstre

• Grundig oplæring i krydstogter, rederier, destinationer og vores systemer

• Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

• Studieture og mulighed for selv at opleve nogle af de produkter, vi sælger

• Personalepriser på rejser

• Pension og sundhedsordning

• Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand

• Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

• En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selv at gøre en forskel

• Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S tog

Lyder det som dig?

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og med arbejdssted på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Epiminds

We’re building Lucy, an AI system that investigates marketing performance and carries approved changes through to execution.

Behind that work is a backend coordinating model calls, external APIs, persistent state, and code running in sandboxes. We’re a small team in Stockholm building the infrastructure this product needs.

The Problem

Agent workloads are difficult to predict. One request can become several parallel investigations. A task can pause for approval and continue later. A worker can disappear after an external API accepts a change but before the result is saved.

Retrying may duplicate the action. Giving up may leave the work unfinished. Keeping everything ready reduces latency but consumes idle compute.

The system has to know what happened, who owns the next step, and what is safe to repeat—while keeping data isolated and costs under control.

The Role

You’ll own the execution infrastructure, data systems, and reliability behind Lucy.

You’ll work across application code, databases, and cloud infrastructure, taking changes from design through deployment and operation. Your decisions will shape how the product handles more work and recovers when things fail.

What You’ll Do

    Make execution durable. Build scheduling, queues, leases, cancellation, and recovery for work that outlives an individual request.
    Make retries safe. Preserve execution state and prevent duplicate events from repeating external actions.
    Run agent compute efficiently. Improve sandbox startup, worker scaling, resource limits, and cleanup.
    Build dependable data flows. Handle pagination, partial failures, changing provider contracts, and datasets that should be streamed rather than held in memory.
    Make failures explainable. Connect traces, logs, and cost data so the team can find bottlenecks and resolve incidents.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve operated backend systems in production and owned their reliability. You understand database design, distributed state, queues, and the difference between a failed request and a failed operation.

You’re comfortable with containers and cloud infrastructure. You can explain what breaks under load, how recovery works, and when a simpler design is enough.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Cloud Run, GKE, Modal, Docker, and Pulumi.

Why Join Now

Execution is central to the product. You’ll shape how agents run, how their work survives failures, and how infrastructure cost changes as usage grows.

What we offer

    Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
    Healthcare, retirement savings, and wellbeing support.
    Office catering.

Hiring process

    Recruiter screening.
    Technical task.
    Code interview.
    Trial with us in the office.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Voor onze klant, actief in schoonheidsverzorging en pedicure binnen de Benelux, zoekt Vivaldis een Onthaalmedewerker Customer Care. Je komt terecht in een organisatie van een 20-tal medewerkers waar klantgerichtheid en productkennis centraal staan.

Als spilfiguur tussen klanten, leveranciers en interne diensten neem je een veelzijdige rol op binnen het secretariaat en de klantendienst. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de operations manager.

Je takenpakket omvat onder andere:

  • Onthaal en telefonie: bestellingen noteren, opvolgen van orders en beantwoorden van klantenvragen
  • Eerste aanspreekpunt voor scholen en groothandels: opmaken en opvolgen van offertes
  • Ondersteuning van retailklanten: aanvragen en opvolgen van CNK-codes, invullen van datasheets
  • Planning van een buitendiensttechnieker (reparaties en leveringen van groot materiaal)
  • Verwerken van retourzendingen
  • Orderinput in Ordas en AFAS
  • Back-up in de winkel: klanten bedienen, kassa en scanning, aanvullen en labelen van producten
  • Verwerking van webshopbestellingen: controleren van opmerkingen, betalingen nakijken en artikelen toevoegen
Profiel

Wij zijn op zoek naar iemand met:

  • Een diploma secundair onderwijs (bij voorkeur handel/verkoop, schoonheidszorgen of pedicure) of gelijkwaardige ervaring
  • Minstens 2 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in customer service, administratie of onthaal
  • Affiniteit met schoonheids- en pedicureproducten is een pluspunt.
  • Een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en Frans, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
  • Een goede kennis van het Engels
  • Basiskennis van het MS Office-pakket
  • Klantvriendelijk en communicatief sterk
  • Stressbestendig en sterk in multitasking
  • Je bent bereid om 2 à 3 keer per jaar aanwezig te zijn tijdens opendeurdagen (zondagen).
Wat je van ons krijgt

Wat kunnen we je bieden?

  • Je werkt voltijds (38 uur/week) in een dynamische omgeving waar je dagelijks schakelt tussen administratie, klantcontact en operationele ondersteuning.
  • Een contract van onbepaalde duur na een geslaagde interimperiode.
  • Een marktconforme verloning, afhankelijk van diploma en ervaring
  • Groepsverzekering Verzekering gewaarborgd loon
  • Een uitgebreide inwerkperiode zodat je de producten en processen grondig leert kennen

Solliciteren via Vivaldis betekent bovendien dat je kan rekenen op professionele begeleiding, opvolging tijdens je tewerkstelling en persoonlijk loopbaanadvies.

Interesse in deze veelzijdige functie als Onthaalmedewerker Customer Care in Mechelen? Solliciteer vandaag nog via Vivaldis. Wij nemen snel contact met je op.

🏢 We’re Hiring: Technical Property Manager – Gothenburg, Sweden

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Technical Property Manager to support facility operations and property management for a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg.

📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

🏢 Work Mode: On-site (100%)

📅 Expected Assignment Period: 26 October 2026 – 26 October 2027

💼 Experience Required: 3–5 years

🌐 Languages: Swedish and English

Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role

Availability: Immediately/on a short notice

🔹 About the Role

We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive professional to manage property operations, building systems, maintenance activities, and facility-related projects. The ideal candidate will ensure safe, compliant, cost-effective, and well-maintained facilities while coordinating suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

🔹 Key Responsibilities

    Manage daily property operations, service requests, incidents, and facility-related issues.

🔹 Required Qualifications & Skills

    3–5 years of experience in technical property management or facility management.

    Strong technical understanding of building systems, maintenance management, and facility operations.
    Knowledge of project management practices and applicable regulations.
    Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Swedish and English.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
    Strong stakeholder management, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
    Ability to manage multiple activities and respond effectively to operational disruptions.
    Valid Category B driving licence.
    Experience with SAP/SRM is an advantage.

🔹 What We’re Looking For

A hands-on, organised, and service-oriented professional who can independently coordinate facility operations, maintain high safety and quality standards, and deliver projects within agreed timelines and budgets.

📩 Interested? Apply now!

Please share your updated CV highlighting your technical property management experience, relevant qualifications, language proficiency, and availability.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly:Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products:Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

â Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

Weâre excited to hear from you! â¤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)



Please mention the word **EXCELENT** and tag RMTcyLjE3Mi4xNTMuMzY= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTcyLjE3Mi4xNTMuMzY=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

jobs.title: Faglig ungdomssekretær
jobs.description:
LO Rogaland skal drive faglig organisasjonsvirksomhet for LO og samordne fagbevegelsens innsats i regionen. Vår innsats kan deles inn i to hovedområder, der den ene er å drive fagligpolitisk arbeid for et rettferdig arbeidsliv med trygge og inkluderende arbeidsplasser. Den andre hovedoppgaven er å styrke LOs organisasjon gjennom kampanjer, aktiviteter og bistand for å styrke LO-fellesskapet i regionen.

Regionkontoret består av en regionleder, en faglig ungdomssekretær (som nå skal erstattes) og en organisasjonsarbeider.

Våre faglige ungdomssekretærer i LO er godt over gjennomsnittet engasjert i det norske arbeidslivet, fagbevegelsen og politikk. De reiser på skolebesøk, holder foredrag, står på stand, og møter likesinnede unge engasjerte mennesker på arbeidsplassbesøk. Dette gir en verdifull arbeidshverdag hvor de får kontinuerlig faglig påfyll og økt kompetanse innenfor ulike felt. Som faglig ungdomssekretær må du kunne holde hodet kaldt i stressende situasjoner, og ha mange baller i luften samtidig. Om dette høres ut som noe for deg har du funnet drømmejobben som kan ta deg videre inn i politikk og et levende samfunnsengasjement.

Den faglige ungdomssekretæren inngår i teamet som i fellesskap skal ivareta LOs interesser i fylket, regionalt og lokalt. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som faglig ungdomssekretær vil du:

  • Planlegge, koordinere og gjennomføre LOs fellesaktiviteter rettet mot unge arbeidstakere, blant annet LOs sommerpatrulje.
  • Drive aktiv oppsøkende virksomhet rettet mot ungdomstillitsvalgte i fagforeninger og forbund, unge arbeidstagere i hele fylket og lærlinger på arbeidsplasser, samt mot
  • studenter og elever på skoler.
  • Rekruttere studenter, følge opp og være til stedet ved ulike studiesteder for LO studenter.
  • Bidra til et aktivt ungdomsarbeid i regionen, og jobbe for å rekruttere unge medlemmer.
  • Engasjere aktive unge tillitsvalgte, og legge til rette for skolering av unge fagorganiserte.
  • Vår en pådriver for ungdomsarbeidet i regionen og samarbeide nært med LOs forbund, Los lokalorganisasjoner og politiske ungdomsparti.
  • Bistå regionleder og øvrige ansatte i planlegging og gjennomføring av regionkontorets aktiviteter.  
  • Delta i ulike prosjekter, utvalg og styrer.
  • Delta i øvrige arbeidsoppgaver som måtte tilfalle regionkontoret.

Det vil være noe kvelds- og helgearbeid, samt reiseaktivitet i regionen og noen nasjonale samlinger.

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som vil jobbe sammen med våre unge medlemmer, rekruttere engasjerte unge og snakke deres sak og som:

  • Har et brennende hjerte for rekrutteringsarbeidet og kjenner godt til problemstillinger unge arbeidstakere møter i arbeidslivet.
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for å arrangere og koordinere eventer (både digitale og fysiske).
  • Har erfaring med å knytte kontakt med andre mennesker og bygge bro på tvers av organisasjoner.
  • Har erfaring med arbeid og kommunikasjon via sosiale medier.

Det er en fordel med kjennskap til fagbevegelsen og LO sin organisasjon, og du kan gjerne ha bakgrunn som tillitsvalgt og/eller har erfaring fra organisasjonsarbeid.
Førerkort klasse B.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • Du er arbeider systematisk, selvstendig og er initiativrik.
  • Du er flink til å skape engasjement og forstår andres ståsted.
  • Du er flink til å knytte kontakt med andre.
  • Du er opptatt av å levere gode resultater og skape verdi med det du gjør.
  • Du har lyst til å være en del av et stort felleskap og lyst til å bidra til et godt formål.
  • Du har godt humør og er opptatt av å skape et trivelig arbeidsmiljø rundt deg.
  • Du har gode samhandling- og kommunikasjonsevner. 
Vi tilbyr
  • Spennende og viktige arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Gode muligheter til å få et stort nettverk i regionen og blant ungdom i hele landet.
  • Bli en del av et støttende kontorfellesskap hvor alle er opptatt av å spille hverandre gode.
  • Vi tilbyr en fleksibel arbeidstidsordning og en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag.
  • Gode pensjons- forsikrings- og velferdsordninger.
  • Stillingen lønnes etter landsoverenskomsten HK-AAF.
KontaktinformasjonEirin Kristin Sund, regionleder, eirin.kristin.sund@lo.no
Eirik Berg Grav, rådgiver
ArbeidsstedLøkkeveien 22
4008 STAVANGER
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: LO

Referansenr.: 5195657395
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 30.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

LO Norge er landets største og mest innflytelsesrike organisasjon for arbeidstakere, med mer enn én million medlemmer fordelt på 24 forbund. Vår viktigste oppgave er å sikre medlemmene trygge og rettferdige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår. Vi forhandler med arbeidsgivere og vi påvirker politikerne. LOs administrasjon holder til i Oslo Kongressenter Folkets Hus på Youngstorget i Oslo. I tillegg har vi LO-regioner som dekker hele landet. Til sammen er vi ca. 300 ansatte som har et hyggelig og til tider hektisk miljø på arbeidsplassen. LO er en IA-bedrift. Vi ønsker et mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, etnisk bakgrunn, religion, nedsatt funksjonsevne, alder og seksuell orientering.

Informations sur l'entreprise

Mon client est une entreprise familiale, humaine et solide, spécialisée dans les installations chauffage-sanitaire.
Elle se distingue par une équipe soudée, un management accessible, et un réel investissement dans la qualité du travail ainsi que dans le bien‑être de ses techniciens.

jobs.title: Satellit - Senior Database Administrator
jobs.description:
Senior Database Administrator 
 
Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior database administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.

Who are you?

What will you do?

  • Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.
  • Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.
  • Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.
  • Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.
  • Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.
  • Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.
  • Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
  • Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.
  • Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and forecast capacity and cost implications.

Technologies (mandatory)

  • Azure Cloud Platform
  • SQL
  • Security
  • SQL Server
  • Postgresql
  • Conscientiousness
  • Motivation and positive mindset
  • Ability to work independently
  • Quick learning and strong organizational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Customer-centric approach
  • Teamwork
  • Willingness to ask difficult questions
  • Professionalism
  • Transparency and solution orientation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.
  • Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.
  • Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.
  • Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.
  • Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.
  • Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of gas turbine technology. In this role, you will combine fluid mechanics, heat transfer and engineering judgement to develop secondary air systems and whole-engine models that improve performance, reliability and sustainability. You will work in a supportive international team where collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives are valued.

Your days will be varied: you may analyse a design, improve an in-house calculation tool, discuss test results with colleagues or support a technical investigation. You do not need to know every aspect of the role from day one. We will support your development through knowledge sharing, collaboration and opportunities to deepen your expertise.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Design and analyze secondary air systems and whole-engine models using in-house and established engineering tools.
    Contribute to the development of new and existing gas turbine products, methods and calculation tools.
    Collaborate across disciplines and locations to create robust, efficient and cost-effective solutions.
    Plan and evaluate gas turbine and laboratory tests, turning results into practical engineering improvements.
    Support technical investigations and help identify root causes and effective solutions.
    Share knowledge, contribute ideas and help strengthen the team’s collective expertise.
    Provide technical support to colleagues in manufacturing, purchasing, sales and service.

What You Bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems with others and is motivated to keep learning. You may be a strong match if you bring:

    A master’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, engineering physics, or a related field is required. Doctoral studies are welcome but not required.
    A foundation in fluid mechanics and heat transfer, gained through studies, research or professional experience.
    An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
    Using and developing in-house tools complemented by CFD tools.
    The ability to communicate and collaborate in English in an international environment.

Experience with gas turbines, secondary air systems, whole-engine models or test evaluation is an advantage, but it is not essential. If the role interests you and your experience does not match every point, we still encourage you to apply. Your transferable skills, perspective and motivation may be exactly what our team needs.

About the Team

You will join an experienced, international team in Finspång and India working with aerodynamics and secondary air systems. We support one another, share knowledge and welcome questions and new ideas. We believe that different experiences and perspectives lead to better engineering decisions, stronger collaboration and more innovative solutions.

We are committed to an inclusive working environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to contribute, develop and succeed. We value sustainable ways of working, open communication and flexibility where the role allows. We especially welcome applications from people who are currently underrepresented in engineering and technology.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.title: KOTA CHEF – TRADITIONAL FINNISH CAMPFIRE COOKING
jobs.description:
**Levi, Finnish Lapland | Winter Season 2026–2027**

**Scandinavian Travel Group (STG) – Safarimarket** is looking for an experienced Kota Chef to join our winter team in Levi.

You will prepare and serve traditional Finnish food and drinks at our outdoor venues, including cosy wooden kotas, snow igloos and Arctic wilderness camps in Levi and occasionally Rovaniemi.

This is a hands-on, guest-facing role for someone who enjoys cooking over an open fire, sharing Finnish food traditions and creating a welcoming atmosphere for visitors from around the world.

The position is **part-time, approximately 20–30 hours per week**, with daytime and evening shifts depending on guest bookings. It is a great opportunity to combine work with skiing, outdoor activities and winter life in Lapland.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Prepare food in advance at our company kitchen, including soups, berry jams, Finnish pancake batter and other simple dishes.

- Cook and serve traditional Finnish food over an open fire in our kotas, including _lettu_ (Finnish pancakes), warm _leipäjuusto_ (Finnish squeaky cheese) and grilled sausages.

- Prepare coffee and traditional pot-brewed tea over the fire.

- Welcome guests, introduce the dishes and share Finnish food traditions in a friendly, engaging way.

- Set up the cooking and dining areas before programs, ensuring everything is ready for groups of approximately 10–20 guests.

- Follow established recipes and menus, with opportunities to suggest improvements.

- Manage food storage, ingredient stocks and kitchen supplies, coordinating purchasing needs with the office.

- Handle cleaning, hygiene and proper food storage at both the kitchen and outdoor venues.


**WHAT WE EXPECT**

- **Previous practical experience cooking over an open fire in a Finnish kota is required.**

- Experience in hospitality, catering or customer service, with confidence interacting with international guests.

- **Valid Finnish Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi).**

- Good conversational English; Finnish and other languages are an advantage.

- **Valid Category B driving licence** and willingness to drive company vehicles between venues, transporting food and equipment when needed.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently.

- A friendly, reliable and service-minded attitude.

- Readiness to work outdoors in cold winter conditions, including evening shifts.


**WHAT WE OFFER**

- Seasonal position from **1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027**.

- Part-time work, approximately **20–30 hours per week**, with shifts based on guest programs.

- Hourly pay, agreed individually based on experience.

- Fixed-term seasonal employment or the possibility of working as a self-employed contractor.

- Winter work clothing, necessary equipment and training.

- Additional leisure-time accident insurance and limited additional healthcare through Pihlajalinna for eligible employees.

- Staff accommodation in Levi available at **€400 per person/month + electricity**.

- A friendly international team and the opportunity to enjoy Lapland's winter lifestyle alongside your work.


**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV and a short introduction describing your **campfire cooking, hospitality and customer service experience** to **hr@gostg.fi**.

**Applications are open until the position is filled.**

Join our team and help us share the warmth, flavours and traditions of Finnish Lapland with our guests!

jobs.title: SNOW CONSTRUCTION & OUTDOOR WINTER CAMP MAINTENANCE SPECIALIST
jobs.description:

**Scandinavian Travel Group (STG) – Safarimarket** is looking for a practical, hands-on person to join our team in Levi for snow construction and outdoor camp maintenance.

Working with a team of 4–5 people, you will help build our **Snow Igloo Park** during an intensive 3–4-week construction phase. Throughout the winter, you will also prepare **Polarman's Camp** for regular evening guest programs and take care of the outdoor areas, facilities and equipment.

This is a varied, physical job for someone who enjoys working outdoors, knows how to use tools and machinery, and is comfortable getting things done in winter conditions.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

**WHAT WE EXPECT**

- Practical experience in construction, maintenance, building work or machinery operation.

- Confidence using common hand tools and power tools.

- Experience with chainsaws, tractors or snow-clearing equipment is an advantage, but not essential.

- Good physical fitness and willingness to work outdoors in cold and sometimes demanding winter conditions.

- Basic English communication skills.

- A reliable, practical attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.


**Previous experience in snowmaking or snow construction is welcome but not required.** We will provide training in the specific techniques and equipment used at our sites.

jobs.title: Intermediate Backend Engineer - Code Security

jobs.description:
We’re Hiring Personal Trainers at Multiple SATS Clubs Across Norway!

SATS is taking the personal training profession to the next level! We are proud to offer newly hired Personal Trainers greater security and closer support than ever before. We are now looking for passionate individuals who are driven to improve the health and well-being of people across Norway, backed by the best support system in the industry.

SATS operates fitness clubs in several of Norway’s largest cities, and we are currently recruiting Personal Trainers for multiple locations in Greater Oslo, Bærum, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand, Drammen, Porsgrunn, Sarpsborg, Skien, Stavanger, and Tromsø.

Please indicate in your application which location or region you would prefer to work in.

Are you passionate about inspiring others to live healthier lives and helping members achieve their goals? Would you like to work in a professional, energetic environment alongside knowledgeable and inspiring colleagues, while developing both personally and professionally? Then we would love to hear from you!

💙 How You Can Make a Difference

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will play an important role in the lives of our members. For many, working with a Personal Trainer is the key to achieving lasting results, whether that means improving their lifestyle, reaching specific fitness goals, or building sustainable training habits.

You will work closely with members from the very first meeting, conducting thorough needs assessments and using your expertise to create realistic, motivating, and individualized training and nutrition plans that help them achieve their goals.

You are a positive motivator, a proactive team player, and someone who contributes beyond your own responsibilities. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure that the club delivers an exceptional experience in every area while continuously developing and improving.

🤩 Does This Sound Like You?

  • You have at least one year of Personal Trainer education (equivalent to 60 ECTS credits or similar). PT certifications that do not award academic credits but are equivalent in scope to a one-year program are also accepted. (Please upload documentation of completed and/or ongoing studies as part of your application.)

  • Alternatively, you have other education relevant to the PT profession, such as a bachelor’s degree in sports science, physiotherapy, psychology, coaching, or a related field. (All candidates, regardless of educational background, must complete a thorough interview process, including a practical audition.)

  • You have strong work capacity and see yourself delivering approximately 80 to 100 hours per month as an established Personal Trainer.

  • You are passionate about creating unique training experiences based on concrete and individual goals.

  • You enjoy sales and take responsibility for developing and growing your own client portfolio.

  • You are confident and skilled at building and maintaining strong relationships.

  • You are positive, inclusive, and approachable.

  • You work independently and take initiative.

  • You are committed to following procedures and respecting rules and guidelines.

🤝 Why Join the SATS Team?

  • SATS offers an introductory salary during your start-up period.

  • Close mentoring and support from experienced leaders and PT Managers.

  • You will become part of a competent and professional team that supports and motivates one another to succeed.

  • Access to a large membership base, providing unique opportunities to build your client portfolio.

  • The chance to work with an exciting and continuously evolving product.

  • Excellent development opportunities through our internal education platform, SATS Academy.

  • Guaranteed minimum income protection following maternity/paternity leave and/or periods of illness.

  • Free training at all SATS clubs across the Nordic region.

  • Employee benefits and discounts through our partner network.

  • As a new PT at SATS, you will participate in our introductory program, PT Trial Session. Personal Trainers help members get started with exercise and establish healthy training habits. Working with PT Trial Sessions is the perfect gateway to becoming a full-time PT. It allows you to gain valuable experience in PT sales, build relationships with potential clients, and develop your business while receiving an introductory salary.

As a Personal Trainer at SATS, you will contribute to work that truly matters. You help people improve their quality of life, achieve important goals, and sometimes even realize long-held dreams. That is why we believe a career at SATS offers a more meaningful and rewarding workday than many others.

#SATSNorge
#LI-AB1

SATS Group, through our brands and concepts SATS, ELIXIA and Fresh Fitness, is the leading provider of fitness and training services in the Nordics with over 275 clubs, some 10 000 employees and around 700,000 members. At SATS, everyone is welcome and our members have full flexibility to tailor packages for their individual needs.
