jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Nav Bergen vest gir tenester til innbyggjarane i Fyllingsdalen og Laksevåg. Vi held til i sentrale og nyoppussa lokale på Vestkanten storsenter. Kontoret består av om lag 130 kommunale og statlege tilsette som samarbeider tett, både internt og med dei andre bydelskontora i Nav region Bergen. Hos oss blir du ein del av eit stort fagmiljø med høge ambisjonar for kvalitet, læring og gode resultat. 
Vi søkjer no ein engasjert medarbeidar til ei fast stilling som fagansvarleg.

Stillinga er delt mellom fagansvar (70 %) og oppfølging av eigne brukarar (30 %). Fagansvaret omfattar heile det statlege tenesteområdet ved kontoret. Dette gir ei brei og variert rolle med gode moglegheiter til å påverke kompetanseutvikling, arbeidsprosessar og tenestekvalitet. Samstundes vil du ha ansvar for eiga brukarportefølje og bidra til at fleire kjem i arbeid, aktivitet eller utdanning.

Du blir ein av to fagansvarlege ved kontoret og vil, saman med kollegaen din, ha ei sentral rolle i fagutvikling, opplæring og kvalitetsarbeid. De vil arbeide tett saman og vere viktige støttespelarar for både leiarar og medarbeidarar.

Hos oss får du ein meiningsfull arbeidskvardag der du kan vere med og gjere ein forskjell for menneske som treng støtte på vegen vidare.
Kva går jobben ut på?
  • planleggje og gjennomføre opplæring for nye og etablerte medarbeidarar
  • formidle fagstoff, regelverksendringar og nye arbeidsmåtar på ein tydeleg, engasjerande og pedagogisk måte
  • vere fagleg støttespelar for leiarar og kollegaer
  • sikre informasjonsdeling, kompetansedeling og læring på tvers av kontoret
  • samarbeide tett med den andre fagansvarlege, leiargruppa og regionale fagmiljø
  • vere pådrivar for fagleg utvikling, kvalitetsforbetring og implementering av nye arbeidsmåtar
  • oppfølging og rettleiing av eiga brukarportefølje

Det kan bli endringar i ansvar og arbeidsoppgåver.

Kva kompetanse er viktig i denne rolla?

Du må ha

  • fullført utdanning på bachelornivå. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet
  • brei fagleg erfaring frå Nav sine statlege tenesteområde, og god kunnskap om relevant lovverk, sakshandsaming og arbeidsprosessar
  • erfaring med rettleiing og oppfølging av brukarar
  • evne til å formidle komplekst fagstoff på ein pedagogisk, tydeleg og engasjerande måte
  • svært god skriftleg og munnleg framstillingsevne 

Det er ein fordel om du har

  • erfaring med opplæring, fagleg rettleiing eller kompetansedeling
  • erfaring med Nav sine fagsystem, og digital kompetanse som gjer at du raskt kan setje deg inn i ulike digitale system
  • kunnskap om Lean og prosessar for kontinuerleg forbetring
Kven er du?
  • ein pådrivar og støttespelar
  • sjølvstendig
  • god til å samarbeide og skape engasjement for endring
  • trygg på å ta faglege avgjerder i krevjande situasjonar
  • pedagogisk og motivert av å lære opp og utvikle andre
Kvifor velje oss?
  • ei sentral rolle med stor moglegheit til å påverke fagleg kvalitet, læring og utvikling ved kontoret
  • eit fagmiljø med høge ambisjonar for tenesteutvikling og gode resultat

  • Heldøgns botilbud for personer med ulike funksjonsvariasjoner

Den kliniske delen av stillingen omfatter undersøkelse, behandling og oppfølging av barn, unge og voksne, og innebærer arbeid både i institusjon og i brukers hjem. Du vil inngå i et tverrfaglig fagmiljø med fokus på helhetlige tjenester. Som leder har du budsjett, fag og personalansvar for tre ergoterapeuter, to fysioterapeuter, fysioturnus og en hjelpemiddelteknikker. Som leder for rehabilitering og friskliv inngår du i enhetens lederteam.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Undersøkelse, kartlegging av funksjon og behandling i institusjon og i hjemmet
  • Oppfølging og rehabilitering
  • Veiledning av brukere, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid, herunder deltakelse i rehabiliteringsteam
  • Dokumentasjon i gjeldende fagsystemer
  • Budsjett og personalansvar
  • Fagansvar for ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeuter og hjelpemiddelteknikker

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Norsk autorisasjon som fysioterapeut
  • Erfaring fra kommunal fysioterapitjeneste er en fordel
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra arbeid med både barn, unge og voksne
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid vektlegges
  • God kjennskap til kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskkunnskaper
  • Kompetanse i bruk av digitale verktøy og journalsystemer (f.eks. Visma Samspill og Helseplattformen)
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Erfaring og/eller utdanning innenfor ledelse
  • Interesse for faglig utvikling

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ønsker deg som er:

  • Faglig engasjert og initiativrik 
  • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Jobber strukturert og har god gjennomføringsevne
  • God på, og opptatt av tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Reflektert og fagleg dyktig med fokus på kvalitet
  • Har evne til å håndtere en variert og tidvis uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag

Vi tilbyr

  • En faglig spennende stilling i et utviklingsorientert arbeidsmiljø
  • Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Mulighet for å påvirke og forme en tjeneste i utvikling
  • En meningsfull lederstilling i et viktig fagfelt
  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår i henhold til gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oppdal er fjellbygda i Midt-Norge, også kjent for Norges største alpine skiområde. Mellom Dovrefjell og Trollheimen ligger Oppdalsbygda, som kan tilby et utall av naturbaserte aktiviteter for hele familien. Omgitt av majestetiske fjell, grønne daler med seteridyller, gode fiskevann, ren luft og Norges reneste drikkevann, er Oppdal et sted hvor batteriene lades. Levende håndverkstradisjoner holdes flittig i hevd. Oppdal sentrum, Auna, er et regionsenter og levende handelssentrum med stort varesortiment som du finner i spesialforretninger, varehus og kjøpesentre. Oppdal tilbyr helårs aktivitetstilbud for både turister, hyttefolk og fastboende. Bredden på aktivitetene er stor både sommer som vinter.

jobs.title: Kokki
jobs.description:
**Kokki, tule tekemään Saimaan makuja Sahanlahteen!**

Sahanlahti Resort on perheomisteinen, ympäri vuoden palveleva matkailukohde Saimaan rannalla Puumalassa. Meille tullaan hyvän ruoan, viihtyisän majoituksen, järviluonnon ja lämminhenkisten kohtaamisten vuoksi. Vieraanamme on niin lomailijoita, juhlaseurueita kuin yritysryhmiä Suomesta ja maailmalta. Haluamme, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja saa mukaansa syyn palata.

Ruoka on Sahanlahden sydän. Keittiössämme lähiruoka tarkoittaa lähiseudun tuottajia, sesongin raaka-aineita ja omin käsin tekemistä. Lautasillemme päätyvät lähijärvien kalat, metsien sienet ja marjat sekä lähitilojen parhaat antimet. Arvostamme raaka-aineiden alkuperää, selkeitä makuja ja huolellista käsityötä.

Kolme erilaista ravintolaamme – maisemaravintola Koskivahti, avotuliravintola Pajapirtti ja kesäravintola Rantamakasiini – tarjoavat monipuolisen ympäristön kokin työhön. Pajapirtin avotuli-illallinen valittiin **Suomen parhaaksi ruokamatkailutuotteeksi Hungry for Finland -ruokamatkailukilpailussa 2026**. Olemme saavutuksesta ylpeitä ja haluamme jatkaa ruokatuotteemme kehittämistä yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

**Etsimme nyt ammattiylpeää kokkia joukkoomme**

Toivomme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä sekä innostusta ruokaan, ravintola-alaan ja lähiruokaan perustuvaan tapaamme tehdä työtä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja tuoda ajatuksiasi yhteiseen tekemiseen.

Osaat suunnitella ja viedä työsi läpi itsenäisesti sekä toimia osana tiimiä. **Järjestelmällisyys ja siisteys ovat meille erityisen tärkeitä:** pidät työpisteesi kunnossa, ennakoit tulevaa ja huolehdit siitä, että keittiön arki sujuu myös kiireessä. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyötä, vastuullista työotetta ja reilua suhtautumista työkavereihin.

**Työ elää vuodenaikojen mukana**

Sahanlahdessa työtehtävät ja työyhteisön koko vaihtelevat sesonkien mukaan. Kesäkaudella keittiötiimissämme työskentelee noin 15 henkilöä. Talvikaudella olet osa kolmen hengen keittiötiimiä, joka täydentyy tarpeen mukaan lisäkäsillä.

Työssäsi osallistut monipuolisesti ravintoloidemme ja tilaisuuksiemme ruoanvalmistukseen, esivalmisteluista annosten viimeistelyyn. Pienessä talvitiimissä korostuvat itsenäisyys ja kokonaisuuden hallinta, kesällä puolestaan yhteistyö suuremman tiimin kanssa. Ympäri vuoden yhteistä ovat hyvä maku, huolellinen tekeminen ja ylpeys omasta työstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn lähiruoan parissa, mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja olla mukana rakentamassa Sahanlahden ruokaelämyksiä. Meillä laadukas tekeminen ja lupsakka yhdessäolo kuuluvat samaan keittiöön.

**Puumalassa on tilaa hyvälle arjelle**

Puumala tarjoaa Saimaan maisemien ja luonnon lisäksi myös käytännön etuja: maksuttoman varhaiskasvatuksen, alhaisen kunnallisveron sekä hyvin saatavilla olevia vuokra- ja omistusasuntoja. Täällä on tilaa asua, harrastaa ja viihtyä myös työpäivän jälkeen.

Työn aloitus sovitaan joustavasti, kuitenkin viimeistään **helmikuussa 2027**.

Kiinnostuitko? Kerro meille itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, mikä sinua ruoan tekemisessä innostaa.

**Tervetuloa tekemään hyvää ruokaa ja hyvää arkea Sahanlahteen!**

jobs.title: Funksjonshemmet kvinne søker BPA assistenter!
jobs.description:
Liker du å hjelpe andre og skape gode opplevelser? Som BPA-assistent hos meg får du en meningsfull jobb der du bidrar til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.

Vi søker assistenter til stillinger annenhver helg, eventuelt en ettermiddag i uken.

Jeg er en voksen kvinne som bor i egen leilighet i Fana bydel. Hverdagen min er aktiv og innholdsrik – jeg har dagtilbud fem dager i uken og deltar på ulike aktiviteter på fritiden.

Nå søker jeg flere BPA-assistenter som kan bli en del av mitt team, som kan bistå slik at jeg kan leve livet etter mine behov.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søker deg som:

· Er pålitelig, punktlig og ansvarsbevisst

· Er selvstendig, med evne til å se hva som må gjøres

· Er aktiv og glad i å være med på aktiviteter, men samtidig har evnen til å finne roen hjemme.

· Har gode norskferdigheter

· Har erfaring fra lignende arbeid

· Har førerkort, klasse B

· På grunn av arbeidets art oppfordres kvinner til å søke

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Det gis en grundig opplæring i alle oppgaver som utføres i assistansen.

· Bistand med matlaging

· Enkelt husarbeid

· Personlig hygiene

· Følge på fritidsaktiviteter

· Ellers legge til rette for at jeg kan leve et trygt og godt liv

 

Stillingene er for tiden organisert i en 12 ukers turnus.

· Faste stillinger er organisert annenhver helg

 

Arbeidstider:

I helgene varieres det mellom dagvakter og ettermiddag/kveldsvakter annenhver arbeidshelg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen: Kontakt arbeidsleder Vigdis Søvik: vigdisanne@online.no

 

Hva tilbyr Medvind Assistanse?

· Tariffestet lønn fra 236,49 kr/t + tillegg for kveld, natt og helg

· Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med utviklingsmuligheter

· Ryddige arbeidsforhold med forsikring og pensjon

· Enkle, digitale systemer for vaktplan og timeføring


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Kontaktperson i barnevernstjenesten
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb hvor du får muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell for barn, unge og deres familier? Har du kompetanse innen barnevernsarbeid, kombinert med gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og et engasjement for faglig utvikling? Da kan du være den vi søker.

Barneverntjenesten i Melhus og Skaun består av 22 årsverk og er organisert i tre team: mottak- og undersøkelsesteam, tiltaksteam og omsorgsteam. Vi har nå ledig et svangerskapsvikariat som barnevernkonsulent/ kontaktperson i 100 % stilling. Vikariatet er tilknyttet omsorgsteamet. 

Du vil få ansvar for å følge opp barn og unge under omsorg og bidra til at de får trygge og stabile omsorgsrammer. Stillingen innebærer tett samarbeid med barn, familier, fosterhjem og samarbeidspartnere. Du vil arbeide med saksbehandling, planarbeid og utvikling av gode tiltak, med barnets beste som grunnleggende prinsipp.

Barneverntjenesten er en del av enhet for familie, forebygging og mestring. Hos oss blir du en del av et aktivt og utviklingsorientert fagmiljø, hvor det legges stor vekt på kompetansedeling, veiledning og tverrfaglig samarbeid.

Vi er i kontinuerlig utvikling og arbeider målrettet for å bygge robuste og helhetlige tjenester som gir barn og familier best mulig støtte. Hos oss møter du en spennende og meningsfull arbeidshverdag sammen med engasjerte, dyktige og inkluderende kollegaer.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Saksbehandling etter barnevernsloven for barn og unge under omsorg.
  • Oppfølging av barn og unge plassert i fosterhjem, institusjon eller andre omsorgstiltak
  • Gjennomføring av samtaler med barn, ungdom og familier.
  • Oppfølging og veiledning av fosterhjem.
  • Oppfølging av biologiske foreldre.
  • Utarbeidelse, oppfølging og evaluering av tiltaks- og omsorgsplaner.
  • Sikre barns medvirkning og ivareta barnets beste i alle deler av arbeidet.
  • Samarbeid med foreldre, nettverk og aktuelle samarbeidspartnere som skole, barnehage, helse- og omsorgstjenester samt spesialisthelsetjenesten.
  • Forberede og følge opp saker for Barneverns- og helsenemnda, domstolene og andre relevante instanser.
  • Delta i utviklingsarbeid og bidra til faglig kvalitet i tjenesten. Ukentlige team- møter og jevnlige veiledninger/ saksgjennomganger.               
  • Aktivt bidra til et trygt og positivt arbeidsmiljø og kollegafellesskap
  • Samarbeid innad og på tvers av teamene                                                                                                                                                        

Kvalifikasjoner

     Krav til stillingen:

  • 3-årig sosialfaglig utdanning på bachelornivå.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge.
  • God skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Førerkort klasse B.
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring:
  • fra kommunalt barnevern.
  • med fagprogrammet Modulus Barn.
  • med oppfølging av barn som er plassert utenfor hjemmet.
  • Relevant videreutdanning vil bli vektlagt. 
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og evner å møte mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner på en respektfull og profesjonell måte.
  • Samarbeider godt med kollegaer, samarbeidspartnere og andre aktører rundt barnet og familien.
  • Er tolerant, ydmyk, tydelig og trygg i møte med brukere og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Kan arbeide selvstendig og ta ansvar for egne oppgaver og prosesser.
  • Er en lagspiller som bidrar positivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Jobber strukturert, målrettet og effektivt, også i perioder med høyt arbeidspress.
  • Er lærevillig, robust og har evne til å håndtere en variert og krevende arbeidshverdag.
  • Har engasjement for barneverns faglig arbeid og et sterkt ønske om å bidra til gode tjenester for barn, unge og familier.
  • Kommuniserer tydelig og profesjonelt, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Har evne til å skape tillit, bygge gode relasjoner og etablere konstruktivt samarbeid med barn, familier og nettverk.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
Vi tilbyr
  • Du vil bli inkludert i et godt og kreativt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer.
  • Du vil få muligheten til å utvikle deg i en spennende og utfordrende stilling med god kollegastøtte og veiledning.
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk.
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.

Vi har syv tettsteder; Hovin, Lundamo, Ler, Kvål, Melhus, Korsvegen og Gåsbakken, hvor det legges til rette for vekst og utvikling. Næringslivet preges av landbruk, handelsvirksomhet samt offentlig og privat tjenesteyting. Viktig infrastruktur som jernbane og E6 går tvers gjennom kommunen.

Melhus kommune er en viktig samfunnsaktør med mange og varierte oppgaver knyttet til tjenesteproduksjon og forvaltning. Vi er en IA-bedrift, og titulerer oss selv som både modig og mangfoldig. Våre medarbeidere skal representere hele Norges befolkning, og vi ønsker oss ansatte med forskjellig alder, kjønn og bakgrunn.

jobs.title: Service Sales Manager – Marine Electrification
jobs.description:
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**

As our global installed base continues to grow, so does the opportunity to develop long-term lifecycle business with our customers. We are looking for an experienced Service Sales Manager to strengthen our team and take an active role in further developing and scaling WE Techs global lifecycle service business.

This is a hands-on international sales role where you will work directly with shipowners, operators and ship management companies. You will develop existing customer relationships, identify new opportunities and turn customer needs into valuable service solutions and long-term business.

Your portfolio will include service agreements, maintenance, spare parts, training, remote services, system updates and upgrades, as well as retrofit and modernisation opportunities for vessels equipped with WE Tech solutions.

The role goes beyond responding to enquiries and preparing quotations. We are looking for someone who proactively develops customers and opportunities, understands the commercial potential of the installed base and helps us continuously improve how we sell and develop lifecycle services.

You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities where WE Techs wider Shaft Generator and Electrification Solutions can create additional value for existing customers.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

· Develop an assigned customer portfolio and grow lifecycle service business within WE Techs installed base

· Identify and pursue new service business opportunities with shipowners, operators and ship management companies

· Drive sales of service agreements, maintenance, spare parts, training, remote services, and system updates and upgrades

· Identify opportunities for system upgrades, modernisations and retrofits across WE Techs installed base, including opportunities related to both Shaft Generator Solutions and Electrification Solutions

· Understand customer operations, fleet plans and lifecycle needs and translate them into relevant technical and commercial service solutions

· Work with technical specialists to develop lifecycle solutions based on the vessels existing electrical architecture, operational profile and customer requirements

· Actively identify cross-selling opportunities between service, upgrades, retrofits and WE Techs wider solution portfolio

· Develop recurring service business and long-term customer agreements

· Manage opportunities from identification and solution development through quotation, negotiation and closing

· Build strong and lasting relationships with customers and key stakeholders

· Actively manage your sales pipeline, targets and customer activities

· Collect and communicate customer, competitor and installed-base intelligence to support the continued development and commercialisation of WE Techs lifecycle offering

· Work closely with Service Sales Engineering, Technical Service, Field Service, Newbuild Sales, Engineering, Product Development and Marketing.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

You are an experienced salesperson who combines commercial drive with a good understanding of technical products and services. You enjoy developing customers, identifying opportunities, negotiating and closing business, while also seeing the bigger picture of how long-term customer and service relationships are built.

You are comfortable entering a business that already has customers, products and technical capabilities, while bringing your own experience and ideas to help take Service Sales to the next level.

**WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE**

· Several years of experience in service sales, technical solution sales or a comparable customer-facing commercial role

· A relevant technical or commercial education, preferably **B.Sc**. or **M.Sc**.

· Strong commercial mindset with proven negotiation and closing skills

· Good technical understanding and the ability to understand customer requirements and work with technical specialists to develop relevant solutions; knowledge of electrical, automation and/or control systems is an advantage

· Ability to identify service, upgrade and retrofit opportunities within existing vessel installations, assess their commercial potential and work with technical specialists to confirm technical feasibility

· A proactive approach to developing customers and identifying new business opportunities

· Ability to understand customer needs and turn technical opportunities into commercially attractive solutions

· Strong relationship-building and communication skills in an international environment

· Ability to independently manage customers, opportunities and priorities

· Fluency in written and spoken English

· Willingness to travel internationally.

**STRONG ADVANTAGES**

Experience in the marine industry, marine services or marine technology is a strong advantage.

Experience with marine electrical power systems, variable frequency drives, energy storage systems, propulsion systems, automation or vessel system integration is considered a strong advantage.

The ability to read and understand electrical single-line diagrams and P&I diagrams is beneficial.

Experience in retrofit, modernisation or lifecycle projects is considered an advantage.

An established marine industry network is beneficial, but you are not expected to bring an existing customer base.

**WHY WE TECH?**

WE Tech offers a competitive salary, good employee benefits and the agility of a growing international company. The position is based at our headquarters in the heart of Vaasa, Finland.

Interested in helping us take WE Techs lifecycle service business to the next level?

Please apply before 31st of October 2026.

As a Project Scheduler, you will work as part of the project organization and be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring project schedules. - tracking key milestones, dependencies and critical paths

- identifying schedule deviations, delays and potential risks

- preparing schedule forecasts and progress reports

- collecting and coordinating schedule information from different project parties

- supporting the follow-up of work progress and upcoming activities

- reporting schedule status and relevant changes to the project organization

- working closely with project management, site teams and other project stakeholders

- previous experience in similar scheduling roles in industrial or construction projects

- experience with Primavera P6

- ability to analyze schedules and identify deviations and potential delays

- good IT and reporting skills

jobs.title: Safety Manager (HS Lead)
jobs.description:
Join us in building infrastructure for people – safely, responsibly and sustainably.

We are looking for an experienced Safety Manager (Safety Manager / H&S Lead) to join our team and work on major, growing infrastructure projects. In this role, you will act as a key safety partner to project management, coordinate overall H&S activities on site and lead the H&S team.

At Destia, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse and challenging projects across Finland. New projects are scheduled to start in early 2027 and will be located in the North Ostrobothnia region and elsewhere in Northern Finland. In addition to these upcoming projects, you may also work on projects that are already underway. The role involves travelling and working at project sites according to their locations. Depending on project needs, future assignments may also be located elsewhere in Finland.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

In this role, safety is about much more than meeting requirements and monitoring compliance. You will have a genuine opportunity to influence how safety is planned, managed and continuously improved across demanding projects, working closely with project management, site operations and clients. You will also help establish consistent ways of working and strengthen the safety culture as an integral part of everyday project activities.

As Safety Manager, you will be a key member of the project organisation and a trusted safety partner to project management. You will support project management in safety management and decision-making, while coordinating overall site safety activities.

You will lead the site's H&S Advisor team and oversee its day-to-day activities. You will ensure that responsibilities and areas of ownership are clearly defined, working practices are consistent, and safety resources are allocated appropriately according to the site's needs and circumstances.

The role combines overall safety leadership and coordination, practical site safety, support for project management and people leadership. You will work closely with project management, site management, safety professionals, other specialists, subcontractors, the client and other stakeholders.

You will be supported by Destia's wider safety organisation and experienced project teams.

Your key responsibilities

- Provide project management with an up-to-date and reliable overview of the safety situation, significant risks, incidents, performance and areas for improvement, supporting safety-related decision-making.

- Coordinate and continuously improve overall site safety activities.

- Support project management in safety management and decision-making.

- Lead the H&S team, oversee its day-to-day activities and ensure the effective allocation of resources.

- Ensure clear responsibilities and consistent ways of working across the team.

- Coordinate audits and inspections, compile safety observations, trends and other relevant safety data, and maintain and report the overall site safety picture to project management.

- Monitor compliance with client safety requirements and participate in inspections and audits.

- Support the development of the safety team's competence and working practices.

- Support and facilitate the practical handling and investigation of serious incidents and safety deviations.

- Monitor the progress of corrective actions and ensure that lessons learned are captured and translated into practice.

- Continuously develop the safety culture in collaboration with the project organisation.

Watch the video below to hear your future colleagues share their experiences of working on our sites!

Learn more about Destia and our services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

For us, safety is demonstrated through actions, not just words. At Destia, you will thrive when you know how to make safety an integral part of everyday choices, interactions and decisions.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- Extensive experience in site or project safety within the industrial, infrastructure and/or construction sectors.

- Experience in safety leadership, coordination and development at project level.

- Experience in people management or the readiness to take responsibility for leading safety professionals.

- A relevant university of applied sciences or university degree, for example in occupational safety, construction or civil engineering.

- A good understanding of occupational health and safety legislation, regulatory requirements, and safety practices in the infrastructure and construction sectors.

jobs.title: Environmental Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in building the infrastructure of tomorrow!

We are looking for an Environmental Manager to take responsibility for the leadership, coordination, supervision, and documentation of environmental matters in our data center project, while supporting the responsible and compliant execution of the projects.

The projects will begin in early 2027 and are located in Northern Ostrobothnia and elsewhere in Northern Finland. The role involves travel-based work, and work will take place at project sites according to their location. In the future, sites may also be located elsewhere in Finland depending on project needs.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As an Environmental Manager, you will be responsible for the overall management of environmental matters on site and act as the environmental expert as part of the project organization. In your role, you will work together with the project team to ensure that construction progresses in accordance with environmental requirements, permit conditions, client requirements, and project objectives.

You will work closely with site managers, project management, supervisors, designers, subcontractors, environmental specialists, authorities, and client representatives. The role combines practical knowledge of the site environment, environmental management, and control of reporting and documentation.

Your key responsibilities

- Leading, coordinating, and developing environmental matters in the data center project

- Ensuring compliance with environmental permits, authority requirements, client obligations, and project-specific environmental objectives

- Organizing environmental inspections, site walks, and supervision at worksites, as well as documenting and reporting observations

- Identifying environmental risks, managing them proactively, and coordinating corrective actions

- Managing environmental documentation, monitoring, reporting, and handover materials

- Guiding site personnel and subcontractors and implementing environmental practices across the projects

- Cooperating with project management and other stakeholders to ensure the smooth execution of environmental matters

- Continuously developing safety, environmental, and quality practices as part of project management

The role emphasizes both practical environmental management on site and responsibilities related to reporting and documentation. The role can be further tailored according to your experience and strengths, but in practice it combines on-site supervision with comprehensive management of environmental matters.

The employment is permanent. This role requires willingness to travel and active movement between project sites. If you work at a project site away from your home location, we will reimburse travel expenses, daily allowances, and accommodation costs in accordance with the companys travel policy.

For us, safety is demonstrated through actions, not just words. At Destia, you will thrive when you know how to make safety an integral part of everyday choices, interactions and decisions.

- Experience working with environmental matters in construction, infrastructure, industrial, or other demanding project environments

- Understanding of environmental requirements at worksites, the application of permit conditions, and environmental risk management

- A careful, systematic, and proactive way of working

- Strong documentation, reporting, and coordination skills

- Willingness to work both on site and in an office environment

We value a practical approach to the site environment, the ability to lead environmental matters proactively, and the desire to develop project sustainability together with the rest of the organization. You will succeed in this role when you can combine on-site observation, ensuring compliance, and high-quality documentation as part of the daily project work.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build the control systems that make ships cleaner and more efficient? Join WE Tech as an Application Engineer and help us deliver electrification solutions to vessels all over the world.

WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish clean-tech company that supplies shaft generator systems, hybrid and electric propulsion, energy storage and other electrification solutions for new and existing vessels.

**Your Opportunity**

This is a hands-on engineering role in an international team. You will develop and configure the control software for our WE Drive solutions, which measure and control electric power generation, distribution and energy storage on board ships. You will follow your work from design through manufacturing and factory testing to commissioning on board, in line with marine standards and the rules of the major classification societies.

**What will you do?**

- Develop and configure control system software for WE Drive solutions, mainly in IEC 61131-3 (Structured Text) on PLC-based platforms

- Build control systems that are secure by design, in line with IACS UR E27 and validate system functionality against customer and class requirements (DNV, ABS, LR, BV and others)

- Prepare and maintain project documentation, including functional descriptions, system block diagrams and other relevant or required documentation

- Give technical support to internal teams, customers, shipyards and partners during development, manufacturing and commissioning


**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work and communicates well with colleagues and other stakeholders. You are comfortable working independently and as part of a project team.

**We expect you have**

- M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Automation or Electrical Engineering, or similar

- Relevant experience with industrial control systems, including PLCs and VFDs and a good understanding of electrical power systems and how power electronics work

- Hands-on programming experience with Structured Text and PLC development environments

- A structured way of working and high attention to detail, especially in documentation

- Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

- Eligibility to live and work in Finland


**Strong advantages**

- Experience with control system development in marine or offshore projects and working with class requirements

- Knowledge of power electronics, variable frequency drives, DC grids or battery systems as well as experience with industrial communication protocols

- Knowledge of or previous experience with cyber security for industrial control systems, especially IACS UR E26/E27 is seen as an advantage.


**Why WE Tech?**

- Meaningful, hands-on work with clean technology for the global shipping industry

- Real ownership of your work, from design to commissioning on board

- Varied engineering tasks and interesting international projects

- A team of skilled professionals and real opportunities to grow your competence

- Hybrid working and flexible working hours


You will join a growing international company with an expanding global installed base and significant opportunities to develop lifecycle business with existing and future customers.

**What we offer**

- Hybrid working solutions and flexible work hours

- Competitive salary

- Culture and sports benefits (Epassi)

- Extensive lunch benefits

- Diverse working environment

- Meaningful, hands-on role where your participation is seen

- Central office location in the heart of Vaasa


Does this sound like a good fit for you?

Please apply before the 9th of November 2026. Learn more about WE Tech at **www.wetech.fi**.

jobs.title: Commercial Project Manager (QS Manager)
jobs.description:
Join us in leading the commercial management of major data center projects.

We are looking for a Commercial Project Manager for a data center project to strengthen our data center operations in Northern Finland. In this role, you will be responsible for the projects cost and commercial management and, together with the project management team, ensure that the projects overall financial performance remains under control throughout its lifecycle.

You will work mainly on our data center project in Northern Finland and be a key member of the project leadership team. You will collaborate closely with project management, site personnel, designers, the client, and subcontractors. The role combines financial and cost control, contract matters, and commercial project management in an international and technically demanding environment.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As the Commercial Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing the projects cost and commercial framework. You will provide project management with up-to-date information on the projects financial status, cost development, and forecasts, and support decision-making from a commercial perspective.

Your key responsibilities

- leading the projects cost management and financial control

- monitoring and analyzing the project budget, costs, and forecasts

- preparing cost reporting and financial forecasts for project management

- monitoring quantities, costs, and actual performance, and analyzing deviations

- monitoring subcontractor and supplier contracts, costs, and invoicing

- managing, pricing, documenting, and tracking variations and change orders

- monitoring contractual obligations and commercial risks

- preparing and handling contractual and commercial matters together with project management and the client

- preparing and coordinating possible claims and other commercial demands

- reporting the projects financial status to project management and other stakeholders

- developing commercial processes and cost management as part of the project organization

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the financial and commercial success of a significant data center project. The position requires the ability to combine accurate financial and cost management with an understanding of the project, while actively working with different project stakeholders.

The employment is permanent, and you will work mainly at our data center project in Northern Finland. The role requires willingness to travel and active movement between project sites. If you work at the project site from another locality, we will reimburse travel expenses, daily allowances, and accommodation costs in accordance with the companys travel policy.

Watch the video below to hear your future colleagues share their experiences working on site!
Learn more about Destias services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- a relevant higher education degree, for example in construction, engineering, finance, or a commercial field

- strong experience in cost and commercial management of construction or infrastructure projects

- experience in roles such as Quantity Surveyor, Commercial Manager, Cost Manager, or similar

- a strong understanding of the cost structures, contracts, and commercial aspects of construction projects

- experience in managing variations, additional works, and commercial risks

- the ability to analyze costs, forecasts, and the projects financial status and communicate findings clearly to support decision-making

- strong Excel and systems skills

- excellent collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills

- fluency in English

- willingness to travel and work at project sites



You are an analytical, systematic, and commercially minded professional. Beyond the numbers and contracts, you understand the overall project picture and can identify financial risks and opportunities in time. You communicate clearly and work naturally with project management, clients, and subcontractors alike. You take responsibility, move matters forward decisively, and are not afraid to raise commercial issues that are critical to the success of the project.

The employment is permanent, and you will work mainly at our data center project in Northern Finland. The role requires willingness to travel and active movement between project sites. If you work at the project site from another locality, we will reimburse travel expenses, daily allowances, and accommodation costs in accordance with the companys travel policy.

What we promise at Destia

At Destia, you get to do meaningful work that impacts peoples everyday lives. We build and maintain infrastructure throughout its lifecycle together with experts from various fields in teams where everyones contribution matters. With us, you can develop your expertise and shape your career path in your own direction, including internationally as part of the Colas Group.

We want everyone to feel welcome at Destia, regardless of their background. We treat each other equally and with respect and believe that the best solutions emerge when people can be themselves at work and bring different perspectives to the table. Through our everyday actions, we take responsibility for people, the environment and society. For us, sustainability is reflected in how we work, how we care for one another, and how we develop infrastructure that serves people far into the future. Most importantly, we want these commitments to be reflected in Destia employees' everyday experiences. jobs.title: Myyntiedustaja
jobs.description:
**Kimbtron Oy etsii myyntiedustajia kasvavalle tekoälyalalle!**

Haluatko päästä myymään moderneja tekoälyratkaisuja yrityksille ja rakentamaan omaa menestystäsi nopeasti kehittyvällä toimialalla?

Kimbtron on suomalainen tekoälyratkaisujen kehittäjä, joka rakentaa käytännönläheisiä AI-työkaluja yritysten arjen tehostamiseen, tiedonhallintaan ja liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.

Etsimme nyt tavoitteellisia ja oma-aloitteisia myyntiedustajia viemään ratkaisuja uusille yritysasiakkaille.

**Mitä pääset myymään?**

Kimbtronin tuotevalikoimaan kuuluu muun muassa:

- **Johdon raportointi ja päätöksenteon tuki:** Ratkaisut yritysten tiedonhallintaan, raportointiin ja liiketoiminnan seurantaan.

- **Älykäs perehdytys ja työntekijöiden tuki:** Tekoälyratkaisut perehdytykseen, ohjeistukseen ja monikieliseen työntekijätukeen.

- **AI-tuotehaku:** Ratkaisut teknisen kaupan tuotetietojen, dokumenttien ja tuotteiden nopeaan löytämiseen.


Tuotteita kehitetään jatkuvasti, ja myyntiedustajilla on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan myös uusien ratkaisujen kaupallistamiseen.

**Mitä tehtävä sisältää?**

Tehtävässä vastaat uusien yritysasiakkaiden hankinnasta, asiakaskontaktien avaamisesta ja myyntimahdollisuuksien edistämisestä.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekoälyn tekninen asiantuntija. Saat tueksesi tuote-esittelyt, demot sekä Kimbtronin teknisen asiantuntemuksen.

Tärkeintä on kyky tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita, rakentaa luottamusta ja saada kauppaa aikaan.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Kiinnostavat ja kilpailukykyiset tuotteet nopeasti kasvavalla tekoälyalalla

- Selkeän provisiopohjaisen ansaintamallin, jossa oma aktiivisuus ja tulokset vaikuttavat ansioihin

- Valmiit tuotedemot ja teknisen asiantuntijatuen myyntiin

- Joustavuutta oman myyntityön organisointiin

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita

- **Etenemismahdollisuuksia** esimerkiksi myynnin vetovastuuseen, uusien tuotteiden kaupallistamiseen tai laajempiin liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme erityisesti:

- Myyntihenkisyyttä, tavoitteellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- Kykyä lähestyä yrityspäättäjiä ja avata uusia asiakassuhteita

- Kiinnostusta teknologiaan ja tekoälyn mahdollisuuksiin

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja

- Halua kehittyä ja edetä urallasi


Aiempi kokemus B2B-myynnistä tai olemassa olevat yritysverkostot katsotaan eduksi, mutta ratkaisevinta on asenne ja kyky saada tuloksia aikaan.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Haluatko päästä mukaan rakentamaan seuraavan sukupolven tekoälyliiketoimintaa?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, myyntikokemuksestasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri sinä sopisit tähän myyntitiimiin.

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

jobs.title: Site Supervisors

You will be at the heart of construction activities, making sure that work phases progress with high quality and on schedule, together with the entire project organization.

Your key responsibilities

- Managing site logistics: ensuring materials, machinery, and resources arrive on site at the right time

- Scheduling construction activities and managing resources

- Ensuring quality in execution and reporting

- Monitoring site costs

- Supervising subcontracting and ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled

- Onboarding work crews and supporting their well-being

You will work closely with the Site Manager, other supervisors, designers, and other stakeholders. In this role, you will have a concrete opportunity to influence how efficiently and successfully projects are delivered.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Kempeleeseen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle seniorille Kempeleeseen

Haemme hoiva-avustajia osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Kempeleessä.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

- suihkuapua

- voinnin tarkkailua

- kotona pärjäämisen tukemista

- liikkumisessa tukemista


Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

jobs.title: Site Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in building the infrastructure of tomorrow!

We are looking for an experienced Site Manager for a project starting in early 2027 in Northern Ostrobothnia.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As Site Manager, you will be responsible for the technical and financial management of your assigned section, schedule planning, and the operational execution and supervision of work in cooperation with the wider project team. You will actively participate in client relations and contribute to project resourcing, working together with the Project Director and other partners.

Destia is a people-oriented and straightforward employer in the infrastructure sector, where creating the right conditions for your success is one of our top priorities. At Destia, you will join a skilled team with a strong can-do attitude.

The Site Manager position on this upcoming project offers a varied range of responsibilities and excellent opportunities for professional growth and development. Your career path can also be shaped according to your aspirations. Together, we will ensure that your responsibilities align with your skills and interests, giving you the opportunity to work in a uniquely diverse environment where the entire infrastructure lifecycle is represented under one roof.

The position is permanent, with a start date to be agreed upon. The role requires a willingness to travel and regular travel between project sites. If you are based in another location and travel to the project site for work, Destia will reimburse work-related travel expenses, pay daily allowances, and cover accommodation costs in accordance with the company's travel policy.

Watch the video below to hear how your future colleagues describe their experiences on site!
Learn more about Destias services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- A degree in construction engineering or civil engineering, or a Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech.) or equivalent qualification.

- Previous experience as a Site Manager in earthworks or ground construction, giving you a solid understanding of the importance of project management and close collaboration between design and construction.

- Experience working on large-scale infrastructure construction projects.

- Experience monitoring and forecasting project costs.

- Good English skills.

We particularly value a client-oriented approach, flexibility, and a proactive attitude, along with the ability to manage tasks systematically and reliably from start to finish. You communicate clearly and consistently and believe in the power of collaboration.

You will be supported by Destia's skilled and supportive team.

What we promise at Destia

At Destia, you get to do meaningful work that impacts peoples everyday lives. We build and maintain infrastructure throughout its lifecycle together with experts from various fields in teams where everyones contribution matters. With us, you can develop your expertise and shape your career path in your own direction, including internationally as part of the Colas Group.

We want everyone to feel welcome at Destia, regardless of their background. We treat each other equally and with respect and believe that the best solutions emerge when people can be themselves at work and bring different perspectives to the table. Through our everyday actions, we take responsibility for people, the environment and society. For us, sustainability is reflected in how we work, how we care for one another, and how we develop infrastructure that serves people far into the future. Most importantly, we want these commitments to be reflected in Destia employees' everyday experiences. [Read more about our sustainability work and the way we operate on our website.](https://destia.fi/en/about-us/sustainability/)

Interested? Here's how to apply

For further information about the position, please contact us at rekrytointi@destia.fi.

Apply for the position using the Apply for this job section in the job advertisement. Please include your CV and cover letter, telling us about your experience, skills and career aspirations.

Keep an eye on your email, as well regularly send you updates on the progress of the recruitment process. We often start interviewing promising candidates while the application period is still open, and may move quickly to a hiring decision once we find the right person.

We also ask all applicants to share their feedback so that we can continuously improve our recruitment process!


Henkilöstöedut

To support work-life balance, job satisfaction and overall well-being, Destia offers its employees a range of benefits, including:

- ePassi benefits: dental care, massage, sports, commuting, and culture (€400 per year)

- The lunch benefit is provided separately and is not included in the €400 annual allowance. Employees are eligible for either a lunch card or a meal allowance.



- Comprehensive occupational health services


- Holiday accommodation options


- Employee profit-sharing fund


This list outlines the benefits generally available to Destia employees. Benefits may vary depending on the nature and duration of the employment relationship.


Destia Oy

Destia is the largest company providing infrastructure services in Finland and part of the global Colas Group. We create the foundations of a well-functioning society by designing, building and maintaining traffic and energy infrastructure for tomorrow. We do this with the unique sense of infrastructure of our approximately 1,900 professionals. Our revenue amounted to approximately MEUR 790 in 2025. [www.destia.fi/en/](https://www.destia.fi/en/)

Sähköposti: rekrytointi@destia.fi

jobs.title: Keittiön vuoropäällikkö, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Kouvola
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KOUVOLA

Haussa on vakituiseen ja osa-aikaiseen (90 h/3 vko) työsuhteeseen

KEITTIÖN VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖ, Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna, Kouvola.

Vuoropäällikön tehtävä on huolehtia arjen toimivuudesta, jotta työntekijät keittiössä tietävät mitä heiltä odotetaan ja asiakkaat saavat toivomansa maku- ja palvelukokemuksen. Vuoropäällikkö huolehtii myös yhteistyöstä salin ja keittiön välillä osallistuen päivittäisiin, ihan tavallisiin työtehtäviin muun henkilöstön tapaan. Hänen roolissaan korostuvat tiimin ohjaaminen ja esimerkin näyttäminen muulle työryhmälle.

Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan keittiössä valmistetaan makuelämyksiä hotellivieraille, kokousasiakkaille ja paikallisille herkuttelijoille. Ravintolapalvelut ulottuvat runsaasta hotelliaamiaisesta kokous- ja juhlatarjoiluihin sekä à la carte -annoksiin, joten työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia ja tarjoavat sopivasti vauhtia. Monipuolinen toimintaympäristö antaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa ammattitaitoa ja kehittää toimintaa yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

Vuoropäälliköltä odotamme:
💡 Kokemusta keittiötyöstä sekä alalle soveltuvaa koulutusta. Omaat ainakin useamman vuoden kokemuksen kokin työstä ja tiedät mitä ravintolakeittiössä työskentely vaatii.
💡 Paineensietokykyä ja taitoa priorisoida. Pääsi pysyy kylmänä myös paineen alla ja olet kykenevä tekemään tarvittaessa nopeitakin päätöksiä.
💡 Asiakaspalveluasennetta. Meistä jokainen on asiakasta varten – myös keittiössä.
💡 Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja tiimityövalmiuksia. Osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja huomioida tiimiläisten erilaiset tarpeet heidän työtään ohjatessasi.
💡 Valmiutta työskennellä kaikissa työvuoroissa aukioloaikojemme mukaisesti. Olet täysi-ikäinen ja puhut hyvää suomea, sillä se on pääasiallinen kieli työyhteisössämme.

Valitulle henkilölle tarjoamme:
💚 Ammatillisesti mielenkiintoisen ja kehittävän työn upeiden makumaailmojen äärellä.
💚 Vakituisen työsuhteen alueen suurimman yksityisen työnantajan palveluksessa.
💚 Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluiden esihenkilöitä koskevan työehtosopimukseen mukaisen palkan (15,60-16,93 €/h), jonka suuruuteen aiempi kokemuksesi alalta vaikuttaa.
💚 S-Ryhmän poikkeuksellisen hyvät henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytettävissä kautta koko Suomen heti työsuhteen alusta alkaen.

Lisätiedot ja rekrytoinnin aikataulu
📅 Hakuaika päättyy su 1.11.2026.
📌 Kaikki työhakemukset tulee jättää määräaikaan mennessä suoraan rekrytointijärjestelmäämme. Myöhässä tai sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia emme käsittele.
🔍 Loppuvaiheen hakijoilta saatamme odottaa osallistumista henkilöarviointiin osana rekrytointiprosessia.
📞 Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ravintolapäällikkö Terhi Ihalainen p. 010 7624 843.

jobs.title: Social- og Sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt på specialiseret demensafdeling
jobs.description:
Social- og Sundhedsassistent til specialiseret indsats for socialt udsatte ældre med demens

Christians Have Plejecenter - Forenede Care

Vil du være med til at styrke en specialiseret indsats for borgere med demens og sociale udfordringer?

Vi etablerer en målrettet indsats for socialt udsatte ældre i vores eksisterende demensafsnit og søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt, som vil være med til at løfte kvaliteten og skabe endnu bedre rammer for vores beboere.

Hos os handler det ikke kun om pleje. Det handler om at skabe et hjem, hvor tryghed, relationer og livskvalitet er i centrum.

Om indsatsen

Vi etablerer en specialiseret indsats for socialt udsatte ældre inden for vores eksisterende demensafsnit.

Indsatsen målrettes borgere med komplekse behov, hvor demens kan være kombineret med psykiske udfordringer, misbrug eller en socialt udsat livssituation.

Det betyder i praksis:

  • En styrket tværfaglig indsats (social- og sundhedsfaglig)
  • Mere tid og plads til relations arbejdet
  • Fleksible rammer i hverdagen
  • Øget fokus på tryghed, struktur og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv
  • Faglige tilgange til borgere med misbrug og psykiske udfordringer
  • Tæt samarbejde på tværs af kommune og sundhedsområde

Indsatsen giver bedre muligheder for nærvær, fordybelse og høj faglig kvalitet i arbejdet med en særlig kompleks målgruppe.

Stillingen

Vi søger en uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt på 28 timer ugentligt.

  • Fast aftenvagt
  • Arbejde hver 2. weekend
  • Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt

Vi leder efter en medarbejder, der vil være med til at gøre en mærkbar forskel i hverdagen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som social- og sundhedsassistent hos os vil du blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Helhedsorienteret pleje og omsorg
  • Personlig pleje og hygiejne
  • Medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation
  • Relations arbejde og kontaktetablering
  • At skabe struktur og genkendelighed i hverdagen
  • Observation af beboernes trivsel og sundhedstilstand
  • Samarbejde med pårørende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Sansestimulering og meningsfulde oplevelser

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

På Christians Have Plejecenter drevet af Forenede Care bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor respekt, omsorg, engagement og kvalitet er fundamentet.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger
  • En hverdag med høj faglighed og fokus på kvalitet i plejen
  • Høj trivsel og fokus på nærvær
  • Indflydelse på din arbejdsdag
  • Tæt samarbejde med kommunens demenskonsulent
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for demensområdet
  • Adgang til Danmarks største sansehave med aktiviteter året rundt

Hos os arbejder vi for at skabe et hjem, ikke bare en arbejdsplads.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for demensområdet
  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer
  • Kan arbejde med borgere med komplekse problemstillinger, herunder psykiske udfordringer og misbrug
  • Er rolig, tydelig og fagligt reflekteret
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Er en holdspiller med godt humør
  • Tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til udviklingen af praksis

Ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerchef Katherine Ratgen på telefon 30 78 54 15.

Vi ansætter løbende, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Om os

Christians Have Plejecenter drives af Forenede Care og består af 62 boliger fordelt på 7 boenheder, heraf 3 demensafdelinger.

Vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe en tryg, hjemlig og meningsfuld hverdag med fokus på relationer, livskvalitet og sanselige oplevelser.

Hos os er omsorg ikke bare en opgave. Det er en måde at være i verden på.

jobs.title: Running Gear Component Expert
jobs.description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?

We are looking for a Running GearComponent Expert with a main responsibility in 4-stroke diesel engine rotating components research and development work.
The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland. We offer a possibility to hybrid remote work.

Your role and responsibilities
As a Running Gear Component Expert your work will include development projects of new engines engineering work with new fuels, component manufacturing technology, extend of life time against fatigue, vibration analyses, field results analyses and supplier co-operation and developments. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests. Youll be working as a part of Component Expertise Running Gear team with diverse expertise.

jobs.title: Regnskabsmedarbejder - med mulighed for at vokse
jobs.description:
Kan du lide, når tallene stemmer, og er du nysgerrig på, hvordan tingene kan gøres smartere? Så bliv en del af vores økonomiteam på tre i en international fødevarevirksomhed i udvikling. Her får du en rolle, der kan vokse sammen med dig.

Hvem er vi?
AquaPri er blandt Europas førende producenter af ørred, ørredkaviar/rogn og sandart i høj kvalitet. Vi er en del af en dansk/fransk koncern, har hovedkontor i Vejle og sælger til kunder over hele verden. Vi har 125 års erfaring og står selv for hele værdikæden med 13 ørredanlæg, 2 sandartanlæg, 6 havbrug og vores eget forarbejdningsanlæg. Hos os møder du en uformel omgangstone, engagerede kolleger og et solidt fokus på ansvarlig akvakultur og fødevaresikkerhed.

Jobbet
Sammen med dine kolleger i økonomiteamet sørger du for, at lønnen er korrekt og kommer til tiden, at bogføringen er i orden, og at tallene er klar til måneds- og kvartalsafslutningerne. Hvor du får dit primære ansvar, aftaler vi ud fra dine kompetencer og ønsker.

Du starter med de daglige opgaver og lærer forretningen at kende indefra. Når du er kommet godt ind i rollen, får du mulighed for at tage mere ansvar. Det kan f.eks. være at forbedre og automatisere vores processer eller at arbejde tættere sammen med vores CFO om opgaver på tværs af virksomheden.

Teamets opgaver omfatter:

  • Kreditorer, debitorer og finansbogføring

  • Registrering og afstemning af lager

  • Løn til timelønnede og funktionærer, herunder refusioner

  • Løbende afstemninger samt måneds- og kvartalsafslutninger

  • Moms og indberetninger til myndigheder, herunder dataindsamling

  • Forbedring og automatisering af processer

  • Samt relevante ad hoc-opgaver

Dit team

Du bliver en del af et økonomiteam på tre og refererer til vores CFO. I arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og udvikler sammen teamets rutiner og processer. Hverdagen veksler mellem faste rutiner og opgaver, der skifter, så du skal kunne planlægge din tid og overholde dine deadlines.

Er det dig?

  • Du har 2–5 års erfaring med bogholderi, regnskab eller revision.

  • Du er god til Excel og interesseret i digitale værktøjer, automatisering og AI.

  • Erfaring med Uniconta og med Lessor eller Danløn er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og engelsk. Som del af en international koncern med kunder over hele verden bruger du tit engelsk i det daglige.

  • Du lærer hurtigt, er struktureret og detaljeorienteret og bevarer overblikket, også når det går stærkt.

  • Du vil gerne lære, tager selv initiativ og har lyst til at vokse med opgaverne.

Det tilbyder vi:

  • En stilling med reelt ansvar og gode muligheder for at udvikle dig

  • Plads til at komme med idéer og forbedre den måde, vi arbejder på

  • Gode kolleger, en uformel tone og fleksible arbejdstider

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

Praktisk info

Arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vejle, og vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning og dit CV til anna.sandberg@aquapri.dk allerede i dag.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Manager Anna Sandberg på tlf. 23 29 71 82 eller anna.sandberg@aquapri.dk.

Vi behandler dine personoplysninger fortroligt og efter reglerne i GDPR. Vi bruger dem kun i rekrutteringen og gemmer dem ikke længere, end nødvendigt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Dagplejer
jobs.description:
Dagplejer – Små børn, store øjeblikke – bliv dagplejer hos os

Bor du I Brøndby kommune og er du passioneret for at give de mindste børn en tryg og nærværende hverdag? Ønsker du et fleksibelt job med stor frihed og mulighed for at gøre en meningsfuld forskel? Så er jobbet som dagplejer i Brøndby Kommune måske noget for dig!

Som dagplejer arbejder du i dit eget hjem og skaber trygge rammer for børnene, samtidig med at du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du kan få sparring og støtte til din udvikling.

Hvad kan du forvente?

  • Fleksibilitet og selvbestemmelse: Du planlægger selv din arbejdsdag med aktiviteter, der stimulerer børns læring og udvikling. Fra kreative stunder derhjemme til turer på legepladsen eller i skoven.
  • Meningsfuldt arbejde: Du giver børnene en tryg og stimulerende hverdag, hvor de føler sig set og hørt – du er med til at forme deres første år, som er afgørende for deres udvikling.
  • Trygt fællesskab: Du får støtte fra dygtige kollegaer, dagplejepædagoger og leder, som er til rådighed for sparring og vejledning. Vi udvikler løbende vores faglighed gennem møder og kurser.

Din arbejdsdag:

  • Dagen starter tidligt, hvor børnene ankommer omkring kl. 6.45, og I spiser morgenmad.
  • I løbet af dagen deltager børnene i både indendørs og udendørs aktiviteter som cykelture, kreative stunder, massere af leg og bevægelse mm. 
  • Der er også en fast dag i ugen, hvor du samles med andre dagplejere og børn i vores legestue.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en engageret person, som:

  • Har pædagogisk erfaring 
  • Er indstillet på at arbejde hjemmefra og skabe et trygt og udviklende miljø
  • Det er et krav, at du er bosiddende i Brøndby Kommune (vester og øster området)
  • Det er et krav, at du har et røgfrit hjem og 
  • Det er et krav, at du kan være en dansk sproglig rollemodel. 

Fordele ved jobbet:

  • Fleksibilitet og stor selvbestemmelse
  • Et berigende job, hvor du gør en forskel i børns liv
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og støtte fra kollegaer
  • En arbejdsdag i eget hjem, uden transporttid 
  • Du arbejder 48 timer om ugen. Til gengæld får du 7 ekstra fridage årligt 
  • Som dagplejer har du, sammen med dit personlige fradrag, et skattefradrag på 60%, fordi du har udgifter til børnenes kost og slitage på hjemmet. De 60% i fradrag kommer efter træk af AM-bidrag, pensionsbidrag mv herunder ATP. 

Er du klar til at gøre en forskel for små børn?

Send din ansøgning til os i dag og vær med til at skabe en hverdag fyldt med varme, nærvær og leg.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vil du vide mere: Du er mere end velkommen til at ringe til leder af dagplejen Malene Rasmussen på 43282599 eller souschef Anette skov Nørby 43282598 og høre mere om jobbet som dagplejer.

Ellers send dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning. Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på ”ANSØG”-knappen. 
 

Ansøgningsfrist:

Vi ansætter løbende 


 Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. 

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. 

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

Wellpack is looking for a skilled CNC turner for our client company in Lohja to manufacture demanding industrial products. The client is a long-established Finnish technology industry company that manufactures demanding products and assemblies for industrial applications. Its production is characterized by high quality, strong technical expertise, and the machining of demanding materials.

Could you have the right CNC machining skills for the job? Read more about the job description and qualifications!

What is the work like?

As a CNC turner, you will work on a wide range of machining tasks. You will independently program and operate CNC lathes, so the role requires previous experience with Fanuc controls and programming directly at the machine. The machines used are modern CNC lathes, including machines with sub-spindles and tailstocks.

The materials and component sizes vary, offering a broad range of machining tasks and technically interesting work.

The work is currently carried out in one shift from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with the possibility of moving to a two-shift system. Depending on production needs, there may also be opportunities to work longer days and weekends. The position will start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

We expect you to have

* Previous work experience in CNC turning

* Independent Fanuc control and programming skills

* A precise and quality-oriented approach to work

* Carefulness and a responsible attitude

* A valid Occupational Safety Card

* Good Finnish or English language skills

The following are considered an advantage

* Experience with other controls

* Experience with a CAM-software

* Experience in machining demanding or large components

* Experience in machining titanium and other demanding materials

We offer you

* Full-time work in varied CNC turning tasks

* The opportunity to work with components of different sizes and materials

* A versatile range of machines and technically interesting tasks

* The opportunity to make full use of your CNC programming and turning skills

* The possibility of working longer days and weekends depending on production needs

* Assistance with arranging accommodation, if needed

* Competitive salary

* Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

You will be employed by Wellpack, a high-quality staffing services company established in 2013. Wellpack is particularly known as a trusted partner in the industrial and defence industries. We connect skilled professionals with high-quality jobs and contribute to employment in Finland.

jobs.title: Site Engineers
jobs.description:
Would you like to help build reliable and safe infrastructure that makes a real difference in people's everyday lives?

Destia is looking for several Site Engineers for projects starting in early 2027. Your role may focus on one of the following areas: scheduling, safety, quantity management, quality, or environmental management.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As a Site Engineer, you will play a key role in the project team. Within your area of responsibility, you will help ensure that schedules and quality are managed throughout the construction phase, while making sure that work is carried out safely, with due consideration for the environment and in accordance with agreed requirements.

Your key responsibilities

- Preparing, implementing and monitoring project schedules

- Quantity management, tracking and reporting

- Environmental engineering and management

- Financial management, including cost monitoring, forecasting and invoicing

- Managing additional and variation works, including identifying, calculating and submitting quotations for them

- Safety monitoring, guidance, preventive measures and documentation

- Quality assurance and documentation

- Quantity management and control

- Liaising with authorities and supporting permit processes

In your application, we would be pleased to hear which aspects of site engineering interest you most.

You will work closely with the Site Manager, site supervisors, designers and other stakeholders. In this role, you will have a tangible impact on the quality and smooth execution of our projects.

The position is permanent, and your first project will be located in Northern Ostrobothnia or elsewhere in Northern Finland. The role requires a willingness to travel and regular travel between project sites. If you are based in another location and travel to the project site for work, Destia will reimburse work-related travel expenses, pay daily allowances, and cover accommodation costs in accordance with the company's travel policy.

Watch the video below to hear how your future colleagues describe their experiences on site!
Learn more about Destias services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

As a Site Engineer, you will help ensure that figures add up and quality standards are met, while understanding how decisions and solutions affect project delivery.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- A relevant technical degree, such as a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech.) or equivalent qualification

- Experience in similar roles, with a focus on quality, safety, scheduling or environmental management

- Good IT skills and experience with industry-specific software

- Good English skills

You do not need to be an experienced professional; we also welcome applications from professionals at an earlier stage of their careers who are eager to learn and develop. What matters most is a proactive and analytical approach, strong collaboration skills, and a desire to grow as part of a team building high-quality, sustainable infrastructure for people.

What we promise at Destia

At Destia, you get to do meaningful work that impacts peoples everyday lives. We build and maintain infrastructure throughout its lifecycle together with experts from various fields in teams where everyones contribution matters. With us, you can develop your expertise and shape your career path in your own direction, including internationally as part of the Colas Group.

We want everyone to feel welcome at Destia, regardless of their background. We treat each other equally and with respect and believe that the best solutions emerge when people can be themselves at work and bring different perspectives to the table. Through our everyday actions, we take responsibility for people, the environment and society. For us, sustainability is reflected in how we work, how we care for one another, and how we develop infrastructure that serves people far into the future.
