jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Sales and Customer Relations Manager
jobs.description:
**We are looking for a SALES AND CUSTOMER RELATIONS MANAGER**

**Do you get a buzz from turning interest into sales?**

**&** Espoo theatre brings surprising performing arts from Finland and around the world to the stage. We are a dynamic theatre with an ambitious programme and an open-minded audience, and now we want to reinvent the way we approach sales.

Join us as our Sales and Customer Relations Manager, finding new audiences for our inspiring productions and building customer relationships that last from one season to the next. In this role, you will help shape who we reach, what we offer them, and how we turn interest into sales.

Your role will combine proactive sales, customer relationship building and sales development.

- **Win new customers.** You will identify opportunities, start conversations – particularly with businesses – and turn initial enquiries into proposals and confirmed sales.

- **Develop compelling packages to sell.** You will identify audiences for initiatives such as shared ticket offers and create appealing packages around our programme for businesses, organisations, and groups of all kinds.

- **Build lasting customer relationships.** You will look after our existing customers and work with us to design a loyalty programme that encourages long-term engagement.

- **Reimagine group sales.** You will lead a group sales development project and work with the team to improve our existing programme for group organisers.

- **Track results and keep improving.** You will test new approaches and assess what delivers results.


**What are we looking for?**

- **You have a strong track record in winning new customers, developing sales, and creating successful concepts.** You have opened doors, brought in new customers, and grown sales.

- **Use CRM and ticketing systems with confidence.** Previous experience of Lippu.fi systems would be an advantage.

- You know how to connect with people face to face, by phone, by email, and online. You listen, identify what the customer needs, and give them a compelling reason to come to the theatre.

- You manage your work in a structured way: planning, prioritising, taking action, and following through on commitments. You are comfortable using digital customer relationship management tools.

- Knowledge of the theatre and / or any other art and creative sector would be an advantage, but your experience may equally come from another field, provided you are genuinely interested in our programme and know how to find audiences for it.


You will report to the Sales and Marketing Director and be supported by our seven-person marketing and communications team – a place where ideas do not have to arrive fully formed and where we are not afraid to change direction. You will bring the customer perspective and sales expertise to our shared thinking, with the freedom to influence, experiment, and drive sales at **&** forward.

jobs.title: Mekaanikko, Autohuolto Seitoy Oy
jobs.description:
Olemme paikallinen, pieni ja ketterä monimerkkikorjaamo, sekä Toyota merkkihuolto. Kuuluminen valtakunnallisiin E-expert ja Autoasi -autokorjaamoketjuihin takaa meille aina ajan tasalla olevat tiedot ja taidot korjata sekä huoltaa kaikki merkit valmistajien ohjeiden mukaan tehdastakuun säilyessä näin ollen ennallaan. Lue lisää **https://seitoy.fi/**

**Etsimme asiakkaallemme Autohuolto Seitoy Oy:lle mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen**

**Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?**

Tehtävässä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti mekaanikon perustöitä. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa autojen määräaikaishuollot, jarru- ja alustatyöt sekä iskunvaimentimien vaihdot. Lisäksi hoidat rengastöitä ja muita huoltokorjaamon arkeen kuuluvia tehtäviä. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja sopii hyvin henkilölle, joka viihtyy käsillä tekemisessä ja haluaa kehittää omaa teknistä osaamistaan aidossa työympäristössä.

Työt alkavat joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on arkisin klo 7.30-15.30 tai 8-16 ja työtunnit ovat 37,5 viikossa. Työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Seinäjoella Päivölänkadulla.

**Mitä odotamme?**

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne ja halu oppia. Tehtävä sopii vastavalmistuneelle automekaanikolle, eikä aikaisempi työkokemus ole välttämätöntä. Tarjoamme myös kokeneemmallekin osaajalle haastavia tehtäviä. Eduksi katsomme ilmastointilaitteiden pätevyyden ja sähköturvallisuusosaamisen, mutta ne eivät ole pakollisia. Suomen kielen taito on edellytys tehtävässä toimimiselle.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden liittyä mukaan käytännönläheiseen ja osaavaan työyhteisöön, jossa hyvä fiilis ja tekemisen meininki näkyvät arjessa. Työyhteisössä toimii autohuollon ammattilaisia ja meillä arvostetaan yhteistyötä, huumoria ja reipasta otetta työntekoon. Palkkasi määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan – haarukka 11,50-20,20 €/h. Työsopimus kirjoitetaan Seitoyn kanssa.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026** mennessä, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Jos kaipaat lisätietoja työtehtävästä, niin olethan yhteydessä puh. 0504752852 tai roope.takala@biisoni.fi

Postdoc Position in Computational Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a Postdoctoral Research Associate in Computational Materials Chemistry, with a strong background in first-principles (DFT) calculations, computational materials science, and machine-learning-driven materials discovery. The successful candidate is expected to have experience in areas such as high-throughput DFT calculations, thermodynamic and phase stability analysis, crystal structure prediction, materials informatics, and machine learning, preferably applied to inorganic functional materials. Knowledge of solid-state chemistry, perovskite-related materials, and materials databases would be highly advantageous. You are invited to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years, with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027.

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the VILLUM Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, part of the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), and integrated into CatMatX, a research laboratory led by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev and focused on developing next-generation functional materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications. The research will focus on the machine-learning-driven computational discovery of novel double-perovskite oxynitrides, integrating first-principles (DFT) calculations, high-throughput computational screening, thermodynamic and phase-stability analysis, materials informatics, and machine-learning approaches. Particular emphasis will be placed on predicting the formability, thermodynamic stability, crystal and electronic structures, cation/anion ordering, and functional properties of previously unexplored double-perovskite oxynitrides. The computational predictions will be closely integrated with experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and evaluation of selected materials for solar water splitting within CatMatX. The successful candidate is also expected to contribute actively to the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparation of project reports, presentations, and scientific publications, and development of research proposals supporting ongoing and future activities at SDU NanoSYD.

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project and CatMatX Lab;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning focused on the machine-learning-driven computational discovery of double-perovskite oxynitrides;

  • Development and application of first-principles (DFT) calculations and high-throughput computational workflows for predicting crystal structures, formability, thermodynamic stability, electronic properties, and cation/anion ordering;

  • Development and application of materials-informatics and machine-learning approaches for accelerated screening and identification of promising double-perovskite oxynitrides;

  • Construction, curation, and analysis of computational materials datasets, including integration of data from first-principles calculations and available materials databases;

  • Independent computational data analysis, interpretation of research results, and identification of promising materials for experimental synthesis and validation in close collaboration with experimental researchers;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, and project meetings;

  • Supervision and co-supervision of MSc and PhD students and contribution to collaborative research activities within CatMatX and NanoSYD;

  • Publication of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals and contribution to the preparation of research proposals and project reports.

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students conducting research on related topics;

  • Assistance with teaching activities;

  • Assistance with the establishment and development of research infrastructure;

  • Contribution to the preparation of grant proposals for external research funding.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students conducting research on related topics;

  • Assistance with teaching activities;

  • Assistance with the establishment and development of research infrastructure;

  • Contribution to the preparation of grant proposals for external research funding.

 Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Computational Materials Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Theoretical Chemistry, Condensed Matter Physics, Chemical Physics, or a closely related field;

  • Strong theoretical background and demonstrated hands-on experience in first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT);

  • Proven experience with widely used electronic-structure codes, such as VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, CASTEP, or similar computational packages;

  • Experience in calculating and interpreting electronic, structural, magnetic, and/or thermodynamic properties of materials;

  • Experience with computational modelling of solid-state materials, preferably including transition-metal compounds, mixed-anion materials, magnetic materials, and/or catalytic materials;

  • Experience with machine learning, high-throughput computational screening, materials databases, and/or data-driven materials discovery;

  • Strong programming and scripting skills, preferably in Python, and experience with computational workflows and high-performance computing (HPC) environments;

  • A strong track record of publications in international peer-reviewed scientific journals, including publications as a leading author;

  • Excellent command of English, both written and spoken;

  • Ability to conduct research independently and work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team;

  • Strong social, communication and scientific presentation skills;

  • Willingness and ability to collaborate closely with experimental researchers and external research partners.

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Knowledge and/or research experience in solid-state chemistry, materials chemistry, and inorganic materials synthesis;

  • Experience with mixed-anion compounds, particularly transition-metal oxynitrides and nitrides;

  • Experience with materials characterization techniques, such as XRD, XPS, SEM/TEM, Raman, and UV–Vis spectroscopy;

  • Research experience with advanced characterization techniques at synchrotron and/or neutron radiation facilities;

  • Knowledge and/or research experience in electrochemistry, photoelectrochemistry, photocatalysis, and solar water splitting;

  • Experience in connecting computational predictions with experimental synthesis, characterization, and materials performance;

  • Proven experience in national and/or international collaborative research projects and strong interest in interdisciplinary research.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include the following documents in English: 

  • A one-page motivation letter describing the applicant’s previous research experience and its relevance to the offered position;

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);

  • Certificates and diplomas for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees, including transcripts in Danish and/or English;

  • A complete list of publications, with publications most relevant to the offered position clearly highlighted, especially the first-authored publications;

  • A research statement outlining computational strategies for the discovery and investigation of novel transition-metal-based mixed-anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, including first-principles calculations and machine-learning-driven materials discovery;

  • A reference letter may be submitted but is not required.

The files should not exceed 10 MB.

The application deadline is November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

jobs.title: Haemme nyt liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!
jobs.description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!**

**Työt alkavat heti.**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

**Ketä haemme?**

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia Vaasassa sijaitsevalle datakeskushankkeelle. Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön datakeskuksella kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkisin ja lauantaisin 06-21 välisenä aikana. Työajoista on mahdollista sopia joustavasti.

**Mitä vaaditaan?**

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

**Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:**

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

**Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti.**

**Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:**

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

**Lisätietoja arkisin klo 9–15**

**Marianne Granlund, 0503373384, marianne.granlund@ramudden.fi**

jobs.title: Har du hænderne godt skruet på? Vi søger 2 produktionsmedarbejdere i Holstebro!
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, kvalitetsbevidst og klar på nye udfordringer? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

På vegne af en stor og solid virksomhed i Holstebro, der producerer aluminiumsfacader og vinduer, søger vi 2 medarbejdere til produktion og montage.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde med hænderne, er nysgerrig på nye opgaver og måske har en lille håndværker gemt i maven.

Du bliver en del af et team med gode kolleger, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og en god arbejdsindsats er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Samling af aluminiumsfacader og aluminiumsvinduer

  • Montering af beslag og forskellige komponenter

  • Påsætning af gummi- og tætningslister

  • Lettere montageopgaver

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har hænderne godt skruet på og lyst til at lære nyt

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har sans for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og praktiske opgaver

  • Kan samarbejde med dine kolleger og bidrage positivt til teamet

Det vigtigste er din indstilling og lyst til at lære. Har du praktisk erfaring fra tidligere arbejde, produktion, montage eller håndværk, er det selvfølgelig en fordel – men din motivation er mindst lige så vigtig.

Du skal som minimum beherske det danske sprog i skrift og tale svarende til modul 3 i dansk undervisning.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling på daghold

  • Ansættelse på ubestemt tid

  • Opstart snarest muligt

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger og mulighed for at lære nye færdigheder

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet rekrutterings & vikarbureau med ni afdelinger fordelt i landet. Vi er medlem af Vikar Branchen DI, som bla. forpligtiger os til at oveholde lovpligtoge regler så som GDPR. Vi passer godt på dig hos Medarbejderne ApS.

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails ikke behandles.

Du kan ansøge om jobbet via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020176

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Sotkamoon
jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Sotkamossa.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää avustajia tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus helpperiksi täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi

Lue lisää Hembystä täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Chauffør til forvogn/hænger & gardintrailer med medbringertruck
jobs.description:
Er du vores kommende chauffør? 

Bulk-Transport disponerer over forvogn/hænger, suge/blæsebiler, tiptrailere, walking floor og trucktrailere til palle leveringer. Vi er en virksomhed i udvikling, og som led i vores vækststrategi, udvider vi løbende flåden med nye enheder. 
Vi søger en chauffør til en forvogn/hænger og gardintrailer med medbringertruck.

Vi forventer at du:

  • Har erfaring med forvogn/hænger eller gardintrailer med medbringertruck og som chauffør i det hele taget 
  • Er i besiddelse af chaufførbevis og kørekort CE
  • Har en professionel tilgang til både kunder, materiel og kollegaer

Vedrørende forvogn/hænger er det kørsel i Sverige og Danmark.
Du må påregne udedøgn fra mandag til fredag.
Der er kørsel i hele landet, og mulighed for at tage bilen med hjem, hvis du bor rigtigt geografisk set.

Hos Bulk-Transport A/S kan vi tilbyde en spændene og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelses forhold. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje.

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kørselsleder Jesper Hansen på telefon 2042 7227 eller afdelingschef Torben Danielsen på telefon 2033 7273 eller send din ansøgning senest d. 2 november 2026 

Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende, tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Er du mester i at kontakte nye kunder i DACH og kan du udføre værdibaseret salg?
jobs.description:
Kan du stille skarpt på rengøringsbranchen og yde kompetent og troværdig rådgivning, hvor du sætter dig i kundens sted? Har du evnen til at tage ansvar og levere en professionel salgsoplevelse, hvor dine kunder opnår succes? Så er du den sælger, vi søger til vores salgsteam.


Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af vores salgsteam, og din primære opgave bliver, at opsøge og skabe relationer og salg til kundeemner i DACH.

Helt konkret kommer du til at:

  • booke præsentationsmøder med nye kunder via telefonen, e-mail og LinkedIn
  • afholde online præsentationsmøder for nye kunder
  • lave tilbud til nye kunder
  • udføre salgs- og tilbudsopfølgning
  • deltage i messer og events i DACH (Der kan forventes op til 10 rejsedage årligt i jobbet.)

Vi anvender bl.a. følgende systemer: HubSpot CRM, Dealfront, Leadfeeder, LinkedIn, Relatel, Whereby og Demio.


Vi forestiller os at du

  • har erfaring med at bruge telefonen til at opsøge nye kunder og booke mødeaftaler
  • taler og skriver dansk og tysk på forretningsniveau
  • er god til sætte dig ind i kundens behov
  • arbejder struktureret og systematisk
  • ikke er bange for at tage ansvar og arbejder proaktivt for at opnå dine salgsmål
  • har erfaring med AI-værktøjer og bruger dem aktivt i dit daglige arbejde

Under ansættelsen lægger vi vægt på din erfaring med de nævnte opgaver, systemer og eventuel erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, men vigtigst af alt er, at du elsker at tale med nye mennesker og forfølge dine salgsmål for at skabe resultater.


Vi kan tilbyde dig

  • Adgang til avancerede værktøjer inden for salg
  • Dygtige kollegaer og en støttende arbejdskultur, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Fleksible arbejdstider for en optimal work-life balance
  • Eget kontor i virksomheden
  • Frihed til at planlægge og strukturere dit eget arbejde inden for en fælles ramme
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling gennem kurser, workshops og intern salgstræning
  • Kaffe og frugtordning samt fælles morgenmad hver fredag
  • Mulighed for at deltage i frokostordning
  • Regelmæssige sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter
  • Udvikling på både personligt og fagligt plan med løbende status- og udviklingssamtaler med din manager
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pensionsordning ved PFA


Om virksomheden

Fra vores kontor i Odense driver vi CleanManager, en innovativ softwarevirksomhed med et klart mål: at optimere drift og effektivitet inden for rengøringsbranchen. Vi har i dag mere end 15.000 brugere på vores software og er markedsledende i Danmark. Vi er også godt på vej ind på markederne i Tyskland og Storbritannien. Vi er i øjeblikket 24 medarbejdere, der samarbejder på tværs af teams – dog med undtagelse af når vandrepokalen i bordfodbold eller backgammon er på spil. Se mere på www.cleanmanager.dk.

CleanManager er en del af zvoove, Europas førende leverandør af software- og AI-løsninger til vikarbureauer, rengøringsbranchen og sikkerhedstjenester. zvoove digitaliserer og optimerer arbejdsgange for mere end 8.000 kunder og håndterer årligt administrationen af over 3 millioner medarbejdere, 21 mia. euro i løn og 3 millioner ansøgninger. Med 1000 medarbejdere fordelt på 24 lokationer i Europa og Latinamerika er zvoove med til at styrke konkurrenceevnen i hele servicebranchen.


Arbejdstid og løn

Fuldtidsstilling.

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge og løn aftales ud fra kvalifikationer.


Ansøgning

Søg via HR-On. Vedhæft CV, eventuelle anbefalinger og anden relevant information.

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

jobs.title: Rengøring 30-37 timer
jobs.description:
Horsens Rengøring har meget travlt og søger 2 nye medarbejdere til vores Kørende Teams - er du en af dem?
Vi er en uhøjtidelig virksomhed, med fokus på humor, samarbejde og ordentlighed og vi løfter sammen.

Vil du med på et af vores Teams så læs videre og skynd dig at sende din ansøgning – vi mangler dig.

HVEM ER DU?
Som person er det vigtigt, at du er stabil, pligtopfyldende, positiv af sind og god til at indgå i et team. Vi forventer også at du er effektiv og kvalitetsbevidst i dit arbejde.

JOBBET
Du møder ind på vores kontor, hvor du sammen med en kollega kører rundt på forskellige opgaver i firmabil. Det kan være rengøringsopgaver i private hjem, flytte- og håndværkerrengøringer, trappevask, kontorer m.m. I er tilbage på kontoret mellem kl. 14.00-16.00. Du vil få en aktiv og travl dag med gode og spændende opgaver og søde, hjælpsomme kollegaer.

KRAV TIL DEN RETTE KANDIDAT
Det er et krav, at du har kørekort til manuel gear og taler, læser og forstår dansk eller som minimum engelsk.
Straffeattest skal forevises.
Erfaring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig, da du vil få en grundig praktisk oplæring samt en kollega at køre med.

ARBEJDSTID & STED
Arbejdstiden er 30-37 timer ugentlig. Du møder på vores adresse Spedalsø 45, Horsens kl. 7.00 mandag til fredag og har fri omkring kl. 15.00-16.00. Der er en vagt hver 6. lørdag.

START
Jobbet er ledigt nu - så du skal kunne begynde meget hurtigt.

LØN
Vi har overenskomst, så løn og vilkår er ud fra Serviceoverenskomsten.

ANSØG
Hvis du er interesseret, så udfyld formularen hurtigst muligt på vores hjemmeside www.horsensrengøring.dk under Jobs og vedhæft dit CV.

Du er uddannet kok, gerne med erfaring fra italiensk køkken, restauration eller catering. Du behersker engelsk, da flere nationaliteter arbejder i køkkenet, mens restaurantpersonalet fortrinsvis er italienere.

Du får grundig oplæring og løbende ledelsestræning, så du bliver endnu bedre til at drive og udvikle køkkenet.

jobs.title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja / Nostolaitteet, (Vantaa)
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme raskaan kaluston asentajaa työskentelemään nostolaitteiden pariin Vantaalle! Mikäli sinulla on kokemusta raskaan kaluston huolto- ja asennustöistä sekä vahva ymmärrys hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta, saatat olla juuri etsimämme osaaja.

Tehtävässä työskentelet raskaan kaluston, kuten nostolaitteiden ja työkoneiden parissa, suorittaen huolto- ja asennustöitä sekä kentällä että korjaamolla. Vastaat vaativista huolloista, asennuksista ja vianhauista eri konetyypeille. Työaika on arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7:30-16:00 (40 h/vko). Tässä tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksellemme.

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Kokemusta raskaan kaluston ja erityisesti nostolaitteiden asennuksesta ja huollosta

\- Kykyä etsiä ja hyödyntää teknistä tietoa eri koneista ja järjestelmistä

\- Vahvaa osaamista hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta

\- Valmiuksia vaativiin huolto- ja korjaustöihin

\- Kokemusta vianhausta sekä koneiden testauksesta

\- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- Monipuoliset ja teknisesti mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät

\- Kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen vakaassa yrityksessä

\- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, joka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

\- Yritys tarjoaa työntekijöilleen kattavat koulutusmahdollisuudet

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten täytä hakemus pikimmiten ohessa olevan linkin kautta. Kerro hakemuksessa osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksesta. Vaihtoehtoisesti voit myös lähettää hakemuksen sekä ansioluettelosi sähköpostitse Clickin rekrytointikonsultti Matias Venemiehelle. jobs.title: Sähkö-/kunnossapitoasentaja, Sähkö-Team Oy (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Sähkö-Team Oy:lle sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon ja korjaukseen keskittyvää asentajaa Helsingin Roihupellossa sijaitsevalle korjaamolle.

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Toimenkuva:

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

Palkkaus määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten täytä hakemus pikimmiten ohessa olevan linkin kautta. Kerro hakemuksessa osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksesta. Vaihtoehtoisesti voit myös lähettää hakemuksen sekä ansioluettelosi sähköpostitse Clickin rekrytointikonsultti Matias Venemiehelle. jobs.title: MIG/MAG welder, Uusimaa
jobs.description:
Are you a MIG MAG welder looking for a job in the Western Uusimaa area? You might be the right fit for the job!

Location: Western Uusimaa
Employment: Fixed term employment contract, possibility for a permanent employment contract
Salary: Competitive salary based on your skills and experience

We are seeking an experienced MIG MAG welder for our client company in Vihti for a long-term position. The company specializes in manufacturing steel structures and turns its customers ideas into finished products, handling everything from design and assembly to delivery.

About the role

In this role, you will work on a wide variety of welding tasks, as the welded products vary. The work is carried out in modern and well-lit facilities in two shifts 40 hours per week. If you are relocating from another location, we can assist with accommodation arrangements if needed. Practical welding tests are a part of the recruitment process.

We expect from you

* Solid MIG/MAG welding skills

* Previous work experience with MIG/MAG welding

* Precision and attention to detail in your work

* Good technical skills

* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

* Finnish or English language skills

Viewed as an advantage

* The ability to read technical drawings

We offer you

* A possibility for long-term employment

* Competitive salary based on your skills and experience

* A comfortable and modern working environment with up-to-date equipment

* Assistance with finding accommodation if needed

You will be employed by Wellpack, a company founded in 2013 that provides high-quality staffing services. Wellpack connects skilled workers with quality jobs and contributes to building employment in Finland.

Apply quick!

Please submit your application as soon as possible via the Apply link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our system. jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

jobs.title: Sähkö- ja automaatioasentaja, Algol Technics Oy
jobs.description:
_Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut._

_Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä kymmenessä eri maassa._

Miltä kuulostaisi vaihtelevat työtehtävät huollon ja kunnossapidon saralla? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**

Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.

Algolilla toimit huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Päiviisi kuuluvat vaihtelevat tehtävät, jotka sisältävät monipuolisia sähköasennus- ja huoltotöitä pääsääntöisesti teollisuusnostureiden parissa. Huolehdit asiakasyrityksissä, että hommat etenevät ja linjastot liikkuvat. Pääset toimimaan itsenäisesti ja työssä liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Toimit osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Sinulla on taustaa teollisuussähköstä, mutta tartut mielelläsi myös mekaanisiin töihin. Sähköalan osaamisen olet voinut hankkia koulutuksen tai käytännön työkokemuksen kautta. Työssä tehdään paljolti myös mekaanista asennusta, joten esimerkiksi autojen, koneiden tai muun tekniikan parissa harrastaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.

Arvostamme omatoimista ja palveluhenkistä työotetta. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työn mielenkiintoisissa tehtävissä ja osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Algol Technicsin palvelukseen.

Pääset osaksi osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen perustuu yhteistyöhön ja keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys näkyy arjessa ja vaihtuvuus on poikkeuksellisen pientä.

Algol Technics tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön osana pitkän historian omaavaa perheyritystä, jossa asiat tehdään suunnitelmallisesti ja luotettavasti. Taustalla on yli 130 vuoden historia saman perheen omistuksessa, mikä näkyy pitkäjänteisyytenä ja varmuutena arjessa.

Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten työterveyshuollon ja Epassin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Tahdomme kuulla sinusta! Jätäthän hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026.** Tehtävässä aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Algol Technicsin kirjoille.

Tehtävän rekrytoinnista vastaa Biisoni ja Algol Technicsin toiveesta mahdolliset yhteydenotot: roope.takala@biisoni.fi, p.0504752852

jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Position: 20% Part-time

  • Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45

    • Evening shift: 13:30-21:30

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds Vei 1, 0668 Oslo


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

jobs.title: Kafémedarbeider - deltid
jobs.description:
Vi søker fire kafémedarbeidere til mindre deltidsstillinger ved Skalmstadsetra på sørsiden av Hafjell. Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig foregå på lørdager januar til april 2027, samt enkelte dager i vinterferien og påsken.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som er pålitelig, selvstendig, serviceinnstilt og ryddig, og som klarer å beholde oversikten når flere ting skjer samtidig. Du må være komfortabel med å ta initiativ, følge med på det som skjer rundt deg og vurdere hva som bør prioriteres.

Erfaring fra kafé, restaurant eller butikk er selvfølgelig positivt, men ikke nødvendigvis avgjørende. Det viktigste for oss er at du er lærevillig, tar ansvar og bidrar der det trengs. Du får god opplæring og tydelige rutiner før du skal stå på egne ben.

Vi søker primært medarbeidere over 20 år, blant annet fordi arbeidet innebærer servering av alkohol. Det er likevel mulig for yngre å søke, og vi vurderer søkere ut fra egnethet og hvilke arbeidsoppgaver de kan utføre.

Arbeidet innebærer mye kontakt med gjester, og du må kunne kommunisere godt med gjestene på norsk, et annet skandinavisk språk, eller engelsk.

Arbeidsstedet har begrenset kollektivtilbud, så du må på forhånd ha avklart hvordan du kommer deg til og fra jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, og dere vil alltid være to medarbeidere på jobb. Oppgavene består av kundeservice, servering, drikke/bar, rydding og oppvask samt enkel klargjøring og servering av mat og kaker. Mye bestilling og betaling skjer ved disken, men vi ønsker at medarbeiderne ser hva som er naturlig i den enkelte situasjonen. Vi jobber fleksibelt mellom oppgavene og forventer at begge bidrar der det til enhver tid er behov. Noen ganger betyr det å ta imot bestilling ved disken, andre ganger å gå bort til et bord, servere, rydde eller følge opp gjestene der. God service hos oss handler derfor mye om å være oppmerksom, ta initiativ og samarbeide godt med den man er på jobb sammen med. Kaféen er liten og oversiktelig og du må trives med å ta ansvar for flere deler av kafédriften i løpet av en vakt.

Matservering vil være enkel og godt tilrettelagt på forhånd. Det kan være oppvarming og enkel ferdigstilling av mat og anretning av kaker. Det forventes ikke at medarbeiderne skal lage mat fra bunnen av samtidig som de betjener kaféen.

Vi tilbyr

Arbeidstid og omfang

Det faste behovet er primært lørdager i januar og mars, med utgangspunkt i omtrent annehver lørdag per medarbeider. I tillegg trenger vi bemanning enkelte dager i vinterferien (uke 8) og påskeperioden (uke 12)

Kaféens åpningstid er normalt kl. 13-18, med arbeidstid noe før åpning og etter stenging. Vi forsøker å tilpasse vaktene etter tilgjengelighet, og det er derfor mulig å søke både dersom du ønsker omtrent det beskrevene omfanget, eller om du ønsker å jobbe noe mer eller mindre. Det kan også bli mulighet for ekstravakter ved arrangementer og andre behov gjennom året. Vi håper gjerne å finne medarbeidere vi kan spørre igjen ved senere behov, men kan per i dag ikke love et fast omfang utover periodene som er beskrevet over.

Hva vi tilbyr vi?

Stillingen passer godt for deg som ønsker en mindre deltidsjobb ved siden av annen jobb, studier eller andre forpliktelser.

Vi tilbyr et hyggelig og uformelt kafémiljø, med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og tett samarbeid med en kollega.

Du får god opplæring, tydelige arbeidsrutiner og mulighet til å jobbe selvstendig innenfor trygge rammer.

Lønn etter gjeldende satser for serveringsbransjen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skalmstadsetra ligger på sørsiden av Hafjell, et lite tun med gamle bygninger og mange faste hyttegjester i nærområdet. Vi ønsker å skape en hyggelig og uformell kafé der både hyttefolk, fastboende og andre besøkende kan stikke innom.

jobs.title: Service Instructor
jobs.description:
**Join us as a Service Instructor in hotel cleaning services in Turku!**

Are you an experienced cleaning services professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the team in their daily work and help ensure high-quality service? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work as a Service Instructor under the supervision of your manager and have a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at the customer site. You work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with our shared quality standards and operating procedures. You act as a key link between employees, management and the customer, supporting your manager, but the role does not include actual managerial responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and succeeding in the role requires a customer-oriented mindset and good interpersonal skills. In your role, you have a direct impact on the customer experience and the smooth running of the customer relationship. Active cooperation, clear communication and a solution-oriented approach are therefore essential.

**Your duties include, among other things:**

- ensuring the smooth running and quality of daily cleaning work, planning the division of tasks and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- continuously developing operations together with your manager and actively contributing ideas for improvement

- guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- customer cooperation

- regularly participating in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- experience in cleaning work

- the ability to guide and support the team in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful working environment, and provide clear feedback

- good organisational skills and a proactive approach

- a customer-friendly approach and a positive attitude

- the ability to work under pressure and solve problems

- the ability to communicate both verbally and in writing in Finnish or English. Language skills play an important role in this guiding position, as they are essential for understanding work instructions, ensuring safe working practices and managing employment-related matters. We value a diverse workplace where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength

- a valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen


**We offer you:**

- a permanent, part-time employment contract of 30 hours per week

- shifts on weekdays and weekends, including morning, daytime and evening shifts

- a starting date to be agreed together

- comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding path and N-Clean Academy

- fair employment terms, a safe working environment and support for employee wellbeing

- competitive pay in accordance with the collective agreement for employees in the property services sector, €2,235/month


**Equality and responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not accept discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to providing a safe and healthy working environment.

**Did you know?**

Employees enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS is at an excellent level of **55**! This is reflected in our everyday work through mutual respect and the way we work and succeed genuinely together.

N-Clean has succeeded in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, reflecting our long-term commitment to developing a people-oriented and responsible working life. In 2024, we were selected as the most people-oriented workplace, and in 2025, we placed third in the competition and also achieved third place in the Finland's Most People-Oriented Working Life Act category. This recognition reflects our people-oriented approach to recruitment, where personal interaction, appreciation and the candidate experience are at the heart of what we do.

**Join our amazing team!**

**Send us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 29 October 2026.**

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.

Zabezpečovať realizáciu poradenských aktivít v školách prezenčným, alebo dištančným spôsobom: - realizovať individuálne poradenstvo pre pedagogických zamestnancov (PZ), vedúcich pedagogických zamestnancov (VPZ), - realizovať návštevy hodín PZ a VPZ s cieľom zvýšenia kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - poskytovať im spätnú väzbu na pozorované edukačné aktivity, - navrhovať odporúčania na zvýšenie kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - identifikovať a diagnostikovať problémy PZ a VPZ, - podporovať PZ a VPZ pri tvorbe návrhov možných riešení ich problémov, - pomáhať im pri aplikácii týchto riešení vo výchovno-vzdelávacom procese v triede a práci so žiakmi, - vedieť poskytovať poradenstvo v niektorých z uvedených oblastí: vzdelávacie programy (ŠVP, ŠkVP), hodnotenie vzdelávacích výsledkov žiakov, vzdelávací proces a vyučovací štýl učiteľa, personalizácia vyučovania a inkluzívne vzdelávanie, digitalizácia. Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Ak ešte nemáte absolvované vzdelávanie v mentoringu alebo koučingu 50 h , zabezpečíme a uhradíme ho za vás. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Pracovná doba typická pre pozíciu Asistent/ka na predajni nových vozidiel je 8 hodín denne, v pracovných dňoch od pondelka do piatku a v sobotu do 13:00 hod ( s možnosťou dohody ).

Podpora pri príprave obchodných ponúk a kalkulácií pre klientov.

Koordinácia obchodných aktivít s oddelením logistiky a expedície.

Príprava podkladov a prezentácií pre obchodné stretnutia.

3. Správa zmlúv a dokumentácie.
    Evidencia a archivácia obchodných zmlúv a dohôd.

Kontrola dodržiavania zmluvných podmienok.

Príprava pravidelných správ a prehľadov o obchodných aktivitách a výsledkoch.

Riešenie administratívnych úloh spojených s reklamáciami a pohľadávkami.

4. Ostatné
Podpora pri organizácii interných a externých firemných akcií a stretnutí.

Zastupovanie obchodného manažéra v prípade jeho neprítomnosti.

Pravidelná účasť na školeniach a seminároch s cieľom zvyšovania kvalifikácie.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu

Klientsky servis a poradenstvo: poskytovanie informácií o ponuke jazykových kurzov, termínoch a priebehu jazykových skúšok, cenníku a podmienkach štúdia.

Organizácia jazykových skúšok: registrácia uchádzačov na skúšky, príprava podkladov, koordinácia priebehu skúšok a vydávanie certifikátov.

Riešenie požiadaviek: prijímanie a riešenie otázok, žiadostí, reklamácií či zmien týkajúcich sa kurzov a skúšok.

Administratíva a evidencia: správa klientskych účtov, evidencia prihlášok, príprava zmlúv, zakladanie, vyhľadávanie a archivácia dokumentov.

Komunikácia s úradmi: vybavovanie záležitostí v mene jazykovej školy na úradoch a v inštitúciách (napr. cudzinecká polícia, úrady práce a pod.).

Reprezentácia a eventy: organizácia školských podujatí, účasť na odborných a vzdelávacích eventoch a prezentácia školy.

Spolupráca v tíme: úzka komunikácia s lektormi, skúšobnými komisiami, vedením školy a ďalšími oddeleniami.
Operatívne úlohy: flexibilné plnenie denných úloh spojených s plynulým chodom jazykovej školy a potrebami študentov.
