Hlavné úlohy a zodpovednosti: • Montáž mechanických a elektrotechnických zostáv podľa pracovných inštrukcií. • Kompletizácia plastových dielov vrátane vizuálnej a hmatovej kontroly dielov pred montážou. • Osádzanie komponentov do prípravkov, skrutkovanie, zapájanie káblov, jednoduché merania podľa inštrukcií. • Obsluha zariadení na ultrazvukové zváranie plastov (spúšťanie, ukladanie dielov, kontrola výsledku). • Kontrola a vyhodnocovanie kvality zvarov podľa definovaných kritérií (tvar, pevnosť, čistota spoja). • Vedenie záznamov o nekvalite alebo odchýlkach. • Práca podľa pracovných inštrukcií, technologických postupov a vizuálnych návodov. • Disciplinované plnenie pokynov majstra alebo vedúceho bunky. • Účasť na školeniach týkajúcich sa nových produktov, BOZP a kvality. • Dodržiavanie časových noriem a denných plánov. • Spolupráca na zlepšovaní produktivity a minimalizácii nepodarkov. • Hlásenie chýb, odchýlok alebo technických problémov nadriadenému. • Zodpovednosť za čistotu pracoviska v rámci 5S štandardov. • Dodržiavanie bezpečnostných pravidiel pri práci s elektrickými zariadeniami a zváracími prístrojmi. • Používanie predpísaných OOPP.

Ročný bonus do výšky 50percent platu. 2 x ročne 250 € dovolenkový bonus. Príspevok na občerstvenie 5 € mesačne. Rizikové poistenie zamestnancov. Finančné odmeny k pracovným výročiam. Príspevky na mimopracovné aktivity.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

Okrem spríjemňovania zdanlivo obyčajných dní našich klientov, Ti v našej organizácii ponúkame materiálne výhody benefity: - zabezpečenie opatrovateľského kurzu organizáciou - v prípade potreby poskytnutie dočasného ubytovania max. doba 3 mesiace, zvýhodnená cena nájmu - Sick days deň na zotavenie formou plateného voľna - Každý odpracovaný rok = deň dovolenky navyše - Multisport karta s príspevkom zamestnávateľa - 20percent zľava na vybrané predstavenia SND v Bratislave - zvýhodnená celoročná registrácia v Staromestskej knižnici v Bratislave - 5percent zľava pri nákupe cez zlavomat.sk - odmena pri uzatvorení prvého manželstva či narodení dieťaťa - Odmeny pri pracovných a životných jubileách - možnosť krátkodobého vypožičania služobného motorového vozidla na súkromné účely v prípade potreby po uplynutí skúšobnej doby - možnosť požiadať o zamestnaneckú pôžičku po uplynutí 1 roku trvania pracovného pomeru - podporujeme rozvoj a chuť vzdelávať sa, zabezpečujeme supervízie individuálne aj skupinové - zaujímavé teambuildingové aktivity nemateriálne výhody benefity: - komorný typ zariadenia menšie kapacity počtov klientov - práca v príjemnom a dynamickom kolektíve, ktorá má ZMYSEL - možnosť NAHLIADNUŤ HLBŠIE do života ľudí so skúsenosťou so životom na ulici a byť súčasťou organizácie, ktorá sa už viac ako 15 rokov podieľa na systematickom ukončovaní problematiky ľudí bez domova

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
Servicechef för löne- och ekonomitjänster, Jakobstad
jobs.description:
Servicechef för löne- och ekonomitjänster
Leder du människor på ett inspirerande sätt och får vardagen att fungera?

Har du god kännedom om löne- och ekonomiförvaltningens processer och brinner du för ledarskap, verksamhetsutveckling och att lyckas tillsammans? Vi söker en servicechef till våra löne- och ekonomitjänster i Jakobstad, en person som håller i alla trådar men som aldrig glömmer människorna i andra änden av dem.
Som servicechef får du bygga en smidig vardag tillsammans med ett kunnigt team. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera expertis inom löne- och ekonomiförvaltning med ledarskap och praktiskt utvecklingsarbete.
Vad kommer du att arbeta med?
Du ansvarar för teamets personal, serviceproduktion och kvalitet. Du organiserar verksamheten, håller helheten under kontroll och säkerställer att teamet har de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas.
I rollen kommer du att:
- fungera som chef för serviceteamet
- ansvara för organisering och kvalitet i teamets verksamhet
- säkerställa att serviceproduktionen fungerar smidigt
- stöda, uppmuntra och coacha dina medarbetare
- aktivt utveckla arbetssätt och processer
- delta i utvecklingsprojekt
- stöda teamet i förändringssituationer
- samarbeta nära med kunder, andra servicechefer och intressenter
- delta i den utvidgade ledningsgruppens verksamhet

I den här uppgiften får du både ansvar samt möjlighet att påverka. Samtidigt står du aldrig ensam, utan har stöd av din egen chef, andra servicechefer och kompetenta kollegor.
Är du vår nya kollega?
Du har erfarenhet av löne- och ekonomiförvaltning och förstår helhetsprocesserna inom båda områdena. Du kan organisera både ditt eget och teamets arbete, tar initiativ och driver saker framåt på ett målmedvetet sätt.
Vi hoppas att du har:
- erfarenhet av och god förståelse för löne- och ekonomiförvaltningens processer
- lämplig högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens som du förvärvat genom arbetserfarenhet
- intresse för chefsarbete och ledarskap
- god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga
- ett aktivt och ansvarsfullt arbetssätt
- förmåga att organisera och hantera helhet
- vilja att stöda, uppmuntra och hjälpa andra att lyckas
- engagemang för att utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med teamet
- förmåga att kommunicera på både svenska och finska


Vi uppskattar ett ledarskap som präglas av tydlighet, förtroende och ett genuint intresse för människor. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är viljan att lära sig, utvecklas och bygga en välfungerande vardag tillsammans med andra.
Varför ska du välja oss?
Vi erbjuder dig en ansvarsfull och mångsidig roll där du får möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen av våra löne- och ekonomitjänster och teamets vardag.
Hos oss får du:
- ett meningsfullt arbete till förmån för organisationer inom den offentliga sektorn
- möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten
- stöd för din professionella utveckling
- flexibel och förkortad arbetstid, 7 timmar och 15 minuter per dag
- möjlighet till hybridarbete efter introduktionsperioden
- stöd från din chef och kunniga kollegor

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö palkka- ja talouspalveluihin, Pietarsaari
jobs.description:
Palvelupäällikkö palkka- ja talouspalveluihin
Johdatko ihmisiä kannustavasti ja saatko arjen rullaamaan?

Tunnetko palkka- ja taloushallinnon prosessit ja innostutko ihmisten johtamisesta, toiminnan kehittämisestä sekä yhdessä onnistumisesta? Etsimme Pietarsaaren palkka- ja talouspalveluihin palvelupäällikköä, joka pitää langat käsissään, mutta ei unohda niiden toisessa päässä olevia ihmisiä.
Palvelupäällikkönä pääset rakentamaan sujuvaa työarkea osaavan tiimin kanssa. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka haluat yhdistää palkka- ja taloushallinnon asiantuntemuksen, esihenkilötyön ja käytännönläheisen kehittämisen.
Mitä työpöydällesi kuuluu?
Vastaat tiimisi henkilöstöstä, palvelutuotannosta ja toiminnan laadusta. Organisoit arkea, pidät kokonaisuuden hallinnassa ja varmistat, että tiimilläsi on hyvät edellytykset onnistua työssään.
Tehtävässäsi:
- toimit palvelutiimin esihenkilönä
- vastaat tiimin toiminnan organisoinnista ja laadusta
- huolehdit palvelutuotannon toimivuudesta ja sujuvuudesta
- tuet, kannustat ja valmennat tiimiläisiäsi
- kehität aktiivisesti toimintatapoja ja prosesseja
- osallistut kehitysprojekteihin
- tuet tiimiä muutoksissa
- teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, muiden palvelupäälliköiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa
- osallistut laajennetun johtoryhmän toimintaan

Saat tehtävässä sekä vastuuta että mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa. Kaikkea ei kuitenkaan tarvitse tehdä yksin, sillä tukenasi ovat oma esihenkilösi, muut palvelupäälliköt ja osaavat kollegat.
Olisitko juuri sinä uusi työkaverimme?
Sinulla on kokemusta palkka- ja taloushallinnosta ja ymmärrät molempien prosessit kokonaisuutena. Osaat organisoida omaa ja tiimin työtä, tarttua asioihin sekä viedä niitä määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.
Toivomme sinulta:
- kokemusta ja vahvaa ymmärrystä palkka- ja taloushallinnon prosesseista
- soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista
- kiinnostusta esihenkilötyöhön ja ihmisten johtamiseen
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
- aktiivista ja vastuullista työotetta
- kykyä organisoida ja hallita kokonaisuuksia
- halua tukea, kannustaa ja auttaa muita onnistumaan
- intoa kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa
- kykyä kommunikoida sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi

Arvostamme johtamisotetta, jossa yhdistyvät selkeys, luottamus ja aito kiinnostus ihmisiin. Sinun ei tarvitse olla kaikessa valmis. Tärkeintä on halu oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa toimivaa arkea yhdessä muiden kanssa.
Miksi meille kannattaa tulla?
Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan palkka- ja talous palveluiden toimintaan ja tiimisi työarkeen.
Meillä saat:
- merkityksellisen työn julkisen sektorin organisaatioiden hyväksi
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa
- tuen ammatilliseen kehittymiseen
- joustavan ja lyhyen työajan, 7 tuntia 15 minuuttia päivässä
- mahdollisuuden hybridityöhön perehdytyksen jälkeen
- oman esihenkilön ja osaavien kollegoiden tuen
- säännölliset one-to-one keskustelut
- aktiivista elämäntapaa tukevia henkilöstöetuja
- yhteisiä tapahtumia ja mukavia hetkiä työkavereiden kanssa
- mukavan ja yhteistyöhön kannustavan työympäristön

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme sujuvampaa arkea
Meillä työskentelet tärkeiden palveluiden parissa yhdessä osaavien ammattilaisten kanssa. Uskomme siihen, että hyvä johtaminen näkyy arjen sujuvuutena, avoimena yhteistyönä ja ihmisten mahdollisuutena onnistua työssään.
Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi?
Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille, millaista osaamista, näkemystä ja johtamisotetta sinä toisit palkka- ja talouspalveluidemme arkeen. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten kannattaa toimia pian, viimeistään 8.11.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palkka- ja talouspalveluiden palvelujohtaja Camilla Pääkkölä 040 354 4177.
Tule mukaan johtamaan, kehittämään ja tekemään työarjesta sujuvampaa yhdessä kanssamme!

jobs.title: Director of IT and Workplace
jobs.description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

  • Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

  • Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities

  • Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

  • Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

  • Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

  • Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

  • Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in IT, spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

  • 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

  • Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

  • Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

  • Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

  • Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience, with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

  • Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

  • Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

  • IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

  • Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was coâfounded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the worldâs leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Childrenâs, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts whoâve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building worldâchanging technologies â ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @hippocraticai.com email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Keisarinkotoon!
jobs.description:
Hei sinä lähihoitaja – me etsimme ehkäpä juuri sinua!

**Keisarinkodossa Piikkiössä olisi paikka yhdelle hyvälle tyypille. Voisitko se olla sinä?**

Jos olet lähihoitaja, joka tykkää ihmisistä, vaihtelevista päivistä ja siitä, että töihin on kiva tulla, **jatka lukemista!** Meillä Keisarinkodossa tehdään tärkeää työtä, mutta otsa kurtussa ei tarvitse olla. Arjessa on tilaa **hymyille, huumorille, hyvälle kahville ja onnistumisille** – unohtamatta tietenkään laadukasta ja turvallista hoitotyötä.

Mitä meillä pääset tekemään? Olemaan läsnä, auttamaan, kohtaamaan, kuuntelemaan ja toteuttamaan hyvää arkea yhdessä asukkaidemme kanssa. Työpäivät eivät ole samanlaisia, ja juuri se tekee tästä työstä mielenkiintoista. Joskus tarvitaan ripeyttä, joskus rauhallista kuuntelijaa ja välillä ripaus huumoria. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata heti – **me opetellaan ja autetaan toinen toisiamme.**

Mitä me toivomme sinulta?

- Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja.

- Olet luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen.

- Kohtaat ihmiset aidosti ja arvostavasti.

- Osaat tehdä töitä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa.

- Sinulla on positiivinen asenne ja mielellään myös **pilkettä silmäkulmassa.**


Ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelyn kokemus on plussaa, mutta **hyvä tyyppi ja oikea asenne painavat vaakakupissa paljon.**

Miksi juuri meille? Koska meillä **työkaveria ei jätetä yksin**. Meillä saa kysyä, oppia, nauraa ja välillä todeta yhdessä, että _"selvittiinpäs tästäkin!"_

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään ja jossa hyvä työ näkyy sekä asukkaiden arjessa että työkavereiden fiiliksessä.

Joko nappasit ajatuksesta kiinni? Jos mietit, että **"tuonne voisin kyllä tulla töihin"**, niin laita hakemus tulemaan! Me odotamme innolla, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun.

**Tervetuloa Keisarinkotoon – meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti:** sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

_P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua._

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa parasta työporukkaa ikinä?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti on avannut ovensa lokakuun alussa, ja etsimme joukkoomme vielä yhtä **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea: **Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. We have ambitious targets to grow our wealth management services and it is essential for us to strengthen this ambitious and dynamic team.

We are seeking candidates capable of developing a network that can mobilize the expertise required to generate solutions and guarantee client satisfaction. Our clients have high requirements, and we are proud to offer them solutions tailored to their personal situation and reflecting their international status and entrepreneurial profile.

Your next challenge:

• Identify and develop new business opportunities by understanding prospective clients' needs and building meaningful connections.
• Develop and nurture a portfolio of clients by building long-term, trusted relationships and delivering tailored solutions.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of client interactions and business development activities using the bank's CRM tools.

You bring:

• An established network of private clients and/or financial intermediaries in Germany.
• Strong knowledge of the products and services typically sought by private clients and financial intermediaries, including asset management, private equity, wealth planning solutions and credit facilities.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a genuine interest in understanding clients' needs and delivering tailored solutions.
• A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset combined with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
• Strong influencing and negotiation skills, enabling you to create value for clients and develop mutually beneficial business relationships.
• The highest standards of integrity, professionalism and ethical conduct.
A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

You are :

• Organized, proactive and structured in managing client interactions and business
• development activities.
• Collaborative and motivated to contribute to a diverse and supportive team environment.
• Eager to learn, grow and develop professionally.

Reporting to the Senior Data Governance Officer, you will work with Business, Risk, Finance, Data and IT stakeholders to embed effective governance practices across the data lifecycle.

Your next challenge:

• Support the day-to-day implementation of the Bank's Data Governance framework, standards and procedures.
• Contribute to BCBS 239 implementation and related remediation activities.
• Maintain and control Data Governance artefacts, including the Business Glossary, Business Terms, metadata, data ownership and data lineage.
• Support Data Owners and Data Stewards in fulfilling their responsibilities and using Data Governance tools.
• Perform completeness and consistency checks on metadata and governance information, and coordinate the resolution of identified gaps.
• Support the documentation and maintenance of business and technical lineage across business concepts, data fields, applications and source systems.
• Embed Data Governance requirements in data and IT projects throughout the data lifecycle.
• Contribute to the improvement and automation of operational Data Governance processes and controls.
• Maintain evidence supporting BCBS 239, internal control, audit and regulatory requirements.
• Use Microsoft 365, Power BI, Copilot and relevant AI-enabled automation capabilities to improve efficiency and ways of working.

Your skills:

• One to three years of professional experience working with data, preferably in banking or financial services.
• Practical experience with financial, risk, accounting, regulatory or banking data is preferred.
• Previous Data Governance experience is an advantage but is not required.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.
• Good understanding of the data lifecycle, including data sourcing, transformation, storage, mapping and consumption.
• Knowledge of data development processes and the movement of data between systems.
• Working knowledge of data modelling, database and data architecture concepts.
• Ability to use SQL to explore datasets, analyse data structures and support data investigations.
• Knowledge of Data Governance and metadata tools, such as HOPEX, Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview or equivalent solutions.
• Understanding of Business Glossary, metadata management, data ownership and data lineage concepts.
• Practical experience with Power BI, including data analysis and the creation or maintenance of dashboards.
• Strong command of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and relevant AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.
• Knowledge of BCBS 239 or banking regulatory data requirements is an advantage.
• Highly self-driven, proactive and able to take ownership of assigned activities with limited supervision.
• Hands-on and comfortable working directly with data, tools and governance artefacts.
• Analytical, structured and attentive to detail.
• Strong team player who collaborates effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Able to challenge inconsistencies constructively, follow up with stakeholders and drive activities to completion.
• Curious about data, technology and AI, with a continuous improvement and automation mindset.

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our Talent Attraction and Acquisition team, supporting recruitment across PwC Luxembourg.
Working closely with Talent Acquisition Advisors and Talent Acquisition Partners, you will join a collaborative team where strong coordination makes a real difference. By bringing structure, responsiveness and consistency to our activities, you will help create a smooth recruitment experience for candidates while supporting the team in working effectively with hiring teams and meeting its operational and administrative requirements.

What your role will look like

As a Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator, you will combine hands-on recruitment scheduling with essential administrative responsibilities. You will manage multiple activities and priorities in parallel, ensuring that each step is handled accurately, on time and with the right level of attention.
The role requires someone who can stay one step ahead, take ownership and bring clarity, while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

You will:

• Coordinate interviews across the firm, from scheduling and invitations to sharing practical information with candidates.
• Manage Talent Acquisition team calendars and coordinate multiple schedules to ensure a smooth and efficient interview process.
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing clear, timely and professional communication throughout interview coordination.
• Manage the validation and follow-up of Talent Attraction and recruitment invoices and expenses.
• Manage ADEM administration, including vacancy declarations, required updates and documentation, ensuring accurate records and compliance with Luxembourg requirements.
• Track and report on key scheduling metrics, including time-to-schedule, rescheduling, no-shows, interviewer availability and bottlenecks.
• Prepare weekly and monthly activity reports and maintain accurate data for key Talent Attraction and Acquisition metrics.
• Support Talent Attraction and Acquisition projects and initiatives, ensuring effective coordination and follow-up.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date process documentation to support consistency, knowledge sharing and business continuity.

Your growth and opportunities

This role offers the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Talent Attraction and Acquisition while gaining exposure to recruitment activities across PwC Luxembourg.
You will develop your expertise in recruitment coordination, administration, stakeholder management and reporting, while building a broader understanding of how an in-house Talent Acquisition function operates.
As you grow into the role, you will have the opportunity to take greater ownership, contribute ideas and improvements, and become a trusted point of reference for the team. The experience you build will provide a strong platform to continue developing within Talent Acquisition and the broader HR environment.

The skills you bring

You are organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You communicate with confidence and professionalism, take ownership of your responsibilities and pay close attention to the details that contribute to a well-coordinated recruitment process.

• 3 to 4 years of experience in an administrative or coordination role.
• A genuine interest in Human Resources and recruitment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
• Clear, warm and professional written and spoken communication in a multicultural environment, with fluency in English and French.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to follow up, align expectations and challenge constructively when needed.
• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and reliability.
• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential candidate and employee information.

Ways of working

• You contribute actively to the team, build trusted relationships and understand how your work supports shared outcomes.
• You communicate with care and professionalism, adapt to different stakeholders and remain solution-focused when priorities evolve.
• You follow through on commitments, work collaboratively and handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.

Additional skills that would support your success

• Portuguese language skills would be considered an asset.
• Previous exposure to recruitment, HR coordination or a similar environment would be an advantage.
• Confidence working with HR or recruitment systems and digital tools.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel and an interest in data and reporting.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Bring your organisation, communication skills and sense of service to a role where your contribution is visible and valued. You will have the opportunity to build strong recruitment expertise, take increasing ownership and become a trusted part of the Talent Attraction and Acquisition team.

If you are looking for a role where great coordination, strong relationships and attention to detail are genuinely valued, we would be happy to hear from you.

Optional Skills

Accepting Feedback, Active Listening, AI Fluency, AI-Human Collaboration, Applicant Tracking System, Behavioral Interviewing, Campus Placement, Candidate Management, Candidate Selection, Candidate Sourcing, Communication, Contract Negotiation, Digital Tooling, Direct Recruiting, Emotional Regulation, Empathy, Employee Referral Programs, End-to-End Recruitment, Escalation Management, Faculty Relations, Hiring Management, Hiring Manager Liaison, Inclusion, Intake Interviews {+ 28 more}

The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. • Établir les plannings et assurer une répartition efficace des tâches et des responsabilités;

time type Full time

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.
You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;

You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

Daria Manoilenko
Recruiting

I look forward to receiving your application

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

We are looking for a

Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Luxembourg - flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Lead for a Risk Analytics team with a strong analytical and hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk analytics and related processes by data-oriented insights in terms of external end customer's solvency / fraud indicators in a balanced risk decision environment. The focus of the team lies on helping our steering teams defining our risk strategy, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it. In line with the company's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe (example: France, Italy, Spain & UK).

The main responsibilities of the Risk Analytics Lead are:

• Leading a high-performing team of risk analytics experts in an international setup
• Ensuring that the team uses industry-standard analytics tools and data-driven decision-making to solve complex fraud / solvency risk related problems and support product expansion
• Driving continuous improvement of underlying data analyses, existing business processes and monitoring/reporting, while establishing best practices for ad-hoc and deep-dive analyses
• Providing risk insights for pricing requests and ensuring effective collaboration with internal stakeholders on analytical requirements
• Playing a key role in cross-functional Risk Data Science initiatives and in enabling machine learning based models and advanced analytics for risk decisioning
• Representing the Risk Analytics team in key projects with project responsibility for risk steering related analytics and implementation
You will lead the Risk Analytics team and work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Risk Steering, Data Science, Pricing, Financial Controlling, Sales and Operations.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the global Client Underwriting Lead. The location is flexible, preferred locations are Luxembourg, Germany (Berlin, Verl, Baden-Baden) and the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).

What you should bring:

• You have a proven track-record in data analytics and credit risk management, ideally within a Bank / BNPL industry / fast-growing payment industry.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading (cross-border) teams in a relevant area such as credit risk analytics, ideally in an international, agile, cross-functional environment
• You have experience in successfully enabling machine learning-based models and advanced analytics for risk assessment and decisioning
• Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL and Python) to perform complex analytical tasks
• You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics

jobs.description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

Financial Crime Compliance Officer                                                                                                                                                                                                         (CDI)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (Ref: MIBLFCCO_092026)

About the Role:

The focus on documented testing, remediation tracking, and assessment of first-line controls reflects current Luxembourg monitoring roles, where the Bank specifically seek experience in second-line testing and assessment of control effectiveness.

Responsibilities:

• Execute scheduled Financial Crime Compliance monitoring reviews in accordance with the approved annual Compliance Monitoring Programme.
• Perform sample-based testing of financial crime controls, including areas such as:
 Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC).
 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
 PEP and sanctions screening.
 ongoing monitoring.
 transaction monitoring/KYT.
 high-risk customers and relationships.
 periodic reviews.
 suspicious activity escalation and reporting processes, where applicable.
• Assess whether controls have been performed in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Document testing performed, evidence reviewed and conclusions reached in accordance with established monitoring methodology.
• Identify control weaknesses, exceptions and potential compliance deficiencies and escalate them to senior team members.
• Assist in performing root-cause analysis of identified issues.
• Support the preparation of monitoring reports, including factual findings and supporting evidence.
• Maintain monitoring files and supporting documentation to an appropriate audit and regulatory standard.
• Track agreed remediation actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding items.
• Support the production of statistics, KPIs and KRIs.
• Assist with thematic reviews and ad-hoc monitoring exercises arising from emerging risks or regulatory developments.
• Maintain awareness of relevant Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulatory developments.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of monitoring procedures, testing scripts, and working papers.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
• Ideally 1–3 years of relevant experience within Compliance, AML/CFT, Financial Crime, Internal Control, Risk or Audit in the financial services sector. A strong graduate profile with relevant internships may also be considered depending on the organisation.
• Fluency in English.

Required Skills:

• Basic to good understanding of financial crime risks.
• Familiarity with Luxembourg AML/CFT requirements and the CSSF regulatory environment.
• Understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and sanctions concepts.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills.
• Ability to review evidence critically rather than relying solely on process confirmation.
• Strong attention to detail and documentation standards.
• Good written communication skills.
• Ability to manage deadlines and multiple monitoring assignments.
• Professional judgement, integrity.

Salary range:

• €72,000

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

jobs.description:
Senior SAP PSCD Consultant (m/f/d)

- Remote, GermanyEmployees can work remotely
- Full-time
- Service Region: Germany,France,Switzerland

Company Description

English

We are Nagarro – a global SAP Business Unit with a strong focus on digital transformation. We design and implement innovative IT solutions that drive businesses forward across industries. With more than 1,200 SAP experts in Germany and 18,000 colleagues worldwide, we offer a dynamic, open, and team-oriented work environment.

We advise our clients on IT strategies, implement and operate SAP systems, and develop tailored solutions for SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA. Our expertise spans retail, manufacturing, process industries, professional services, and the public sector. We work in on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments and develop in-house products to increase efficiency.

Deutsch
Wir sind Nagarro – eine globale SAP Business Unit mit starkem Fokus auf digitale Transformation. Wir gestalten und implementieren innovative IT-Lösungen, die Unternehmen branchenübergreifend voranbringen. Mit mehr als 1.200 SAP Expert:innen in Deutschland und 18.000 Kolleg:innen weltweit bieten wir ein dynamisches, offenes und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir beraten unsere Kunden zu IT Strategien, implementieren und betreiben SAP Systeme und entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für SAP ERP und SAP S/4HANA. Unsere Expertise reicht von Handel über Fertigung und Prozessindustrie bis zu Professional Services und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Wir arbeiten in On-Prem-, Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen und entwickeln eigene Produkte zur Effizienzsteigerung.

Job Description

English

As an SAP PSCD Consultant, you will:

- Take responsibility for customer projects in SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) and support the PSCD module.
- Lead or assist in all project phases: conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out of SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA solutions.
- Analyze, optimize, and improve processes in public sector finance.
- Ensure functional and technical feasibility of SAP solutions.
- Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to deliver high-quality SAP services.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer and best practices within the SAP team.

Deutsch

Als SAP PSCD Consultant übernimmst du:

- Verantwortung für Kundenprojekte im SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) und Unterstützung des PSCD-Moduls.
- Betreuung aller Projektphasen: Konzeption, Design, Customizing, Prototyping und Roll-out von SAP ERP- und SAP S/4HANA-Lösungen.
- Analyse, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen im Public Sector Finance.
- Sicherstellung der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzbarkeit von SAP-Lösungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und internen Teams, um hochwertige SAP-Services bereitzustellen.
- Mitwirkung beim Wissensaustausch und der Weitergabe von Best Practices innerhalb des SAP-Teams.

Qualifications

English

- Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or equivalent qualification with relevant professional experience
- Proven experience in SAP consulting, ideally in SAP PSM and PSCD modules
- Solid knowledge of Public Sector Management (PSM) processes and SAP PSCD
- Experience in SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA projects, including conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out
- Knowledge of SAP FI and SAP S/4HANA Finance is a plus
- Fluent German (C1) and good English skills
- Flexible and willing to travel (20% up to 40%)

Deutsch

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation mit relevanter Berufserfahrung.
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der SAP-Beratung, idealerweise in den Modulen SAP PSM und PSCD.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Public Sector Management (PSM) und im SAP PSCD-Modul.
- Erfahrung in SAP ERP- und SAP S/4HANA-Projekten, einschließlich Konzeption, Design, Customizing, Prototyping und Roll-out.
- Kenntnisse in SAP FI und SAP S/4HANA Finance sind von Vorteil.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
- Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft (20% bis 40%).

Additional Information

English:

- 30 days of paid vacation, internal and external training opportunities, MyN – Nagarro Employee Share Program, attractive company car and company bicycle arrangements, company-funded accident insurance policy, modern office space at central locations with high-tech equipment, sports programs, access to the corporate benefits portal, free fruit and drinks.
- Plenty of room for innovation in a high-growth environment with the latest technologies and products. With us, you can get involved and make a difference.
- Flat hierarchies and a long-term, stable job with attractive development opportunities.

Deutsch:

- 30 Tage Urlaub, interne und externe Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, MyN – Nagarro, attraktive Firmenwagen- und Jobrad-Modelle, Mitarbeiteraktienprogramm, betrieblich finanzierte Unfallversicherung, moderne Büroräume an zentralen Standorten mit High-Tech Equipment, Sportprogramme, Corporate Benefits Portal, kostenloses Obst und Getränke.
- Viel Raum für kreative Ideen und Innovationen in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Bei uns kannst Du dich einbringen und etwas bewegen.
- Flache Hierarchien und einen langfristigen, stabilen Arbeitsplatz mit ansprechenden Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

jobs.title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

jobs.description:
KO: Šajerová Hana, tel.: 553 760 820 - volat PO-PÁ od 8:00 do 15:30 hod., e-mail: kariera@hagemann.cz

Máte silný smysl pro detail, chuť udržovat pořádek, pečlivost a spolehlivost?
Pak bychom Vám rádi nabídli práci uklízečky. Tato práce zahrnuje běžný úklid, tj. zametání, vytírání podlah, utírání prachu, čištění nábytku a zařízení, vysávání koberců a vynášení odpadků. Dále provádění čištění a dezinfekci toalet, umyvadel, pisoárů a záchodů, a to denně nebo podle stanovených hygienických norem. Součástí práce je i čištění oken, zrcadel, přepážek a světelných a tepelných zdrojů, mechanické mytí a leštění podlah, případně obsluha úklidových strojů. Kromě toho je součásti této práce výpomoc při výdeji obědů v závodní jídelně, úklid kuchyně, jídelny, příprava varnic a mytí nádobí.
Motivace pro tuto práci často pramení z radosti z viditelných výsledků dobře odvedené práce a z pocitu, že přispíváte k příjemnému prostředí pro ostatní.

- Příspěvek na stravování v závodní jídelně.

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.

Your responsibilities:


Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.
Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.
Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.
Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.
Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.
Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.
Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.
Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.
Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.
Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership Team
Contribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function.

Your background:


Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controls
Results-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organization
Ability to translate financial and operational insights into actions
10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilities
Digital mindset with proof record on digital innovations

Your benefits:


Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program Global
Parental Leave Program



We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. jobs.title: Field Service Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.

DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.

As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.

This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.

Position Summary

The Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.

You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.

The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.

This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.

Key Responsibilities

Install, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.
Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.
Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.
Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.
Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.
Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.
Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.
Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.
Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.

Qualifications, Knowledge & Experience

At least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.
A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.
Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.
Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.
Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.
Valid driving licence and passport.
Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.

Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.

Location & Travel

Employment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.

Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities.

The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.

The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.

For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.ai

Last application date is October 31st, 2026.


Why DTE?

We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.

We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.

Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.

As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.

Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.

We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

Toimintamme laajentuessa etsimme huoltoasentajaa Turun toimipisteeseemme. Etsimme tehtävään sähköalan osaajaa tai alasta kiinnostunutta, oppimishaluista tekijää. Aiempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.
