jobs.title: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

  • Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

  • Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

  • Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

  • Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

  • The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

  • Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

  • Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

  • Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges. 

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the job is as soon as possible, and it will be agreed with the successful candidate. The appointment is for a full-time permanent position.

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Prof. Director Claudio Pica

SDU eScience center

Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science

University of Southern Denmark

email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk

Application deadline 28 October 2026.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Entrepriseleder til tømrer afdeling
jobs.description:
Hos EMR Murer & Entreprenør A/S søger vi en erfaren entrepriseleder til styring af byggeprojekter med egenproduktion inden for tømrerarbejde.

Ansvar og arbejdsområder:

Som entrepriseleder får du ansvaret for vores egenproduktion på en række spændende byggeprojekter. Du sikrer fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed og bliver en vigtig del af samarbejdet mellem byggeplads, projektledelse, bygherre og rådgivere.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

• Ledelse af tømrerentrepriser med ansvar for den daglige drift og planlægning.

• Koordinering af medarbejdere og interne ressourcer på byggepladsen.

• Opfølgning på tidsplaner, kvalitet og økonomi.

• Planlægning af materialeleverancer og logistik.

• Kvalitetssikring med støtte fra EMR’s interne KS-afdeling herunder DS1140.

• Ansvar for sikkerheden på pladsen med støtte fra EMR’s arbejdsmiljøorganisation.

• Bidrage til et godt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med bygherre, rådgivere, underentreprenører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Vores ønsker og forventninger til dig:

Stillingen kan tilgås fra flere faglige baggrunde. Vi ser gerne, at du har en baggrund som tømrer, suppleret med en uddannelse som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er dog din erfaring med styring af tømrerentrepriser, dit engagement og dine samarbejdsevner.

Som person er du:

• Tydelig, involverende og god til at skabe tillid.

• Målrettet, resultatorienteret og vedholdende.

• Motiverende, positiv og samarbejdsvillig.

• Ordholdende, loyal og løsningsorienteret.

• I stand til at læse og forstå tegninger og projektmateriale.

• Engageret i dine kolleger og de sjak, du har ansvaret for.

• Opmærksom på sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø.

• En dygtig kommunikator med en tydelig, saglig og tillidsskabende kommunikationsstil.

Arbejdsområde:

EMR udfører projekter i hele Danmark i både fag-, hoved- og totalentrepriser. Du vil derfor indgå som en del af byggeledelsen på EMR’s egne projekter med ansvar for tømrerentreprisen, ligesom du vil stå i spidsen for selvstændige fagentrepriser for eksterne bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

Entreprisernes størrelse og kompleksitet spænder typisk fra 5 til 80 mio. kr., hvilket giver mulighed for både faglige og ledelsesmæssige udfordringer samt en alsidig hverdag.

Vil du vide mere:

Er du interesseret, så send dit CV og et par ord om dig selv. Din ansøgning behandles naturligvis fortroligt. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende og ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Vil du høre mere om jobbet, eller har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Morten Søby - T: 40 62 07 88 - ms@emr-as.dk

jobs.title: Administration- och marknadsföringsansvarig
jobs.description:
RE Motors söker en Administration- och marknadsföringsansvarig för fast anställning!

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

- Ansvara för utveckling och underhåll av företagets webbshop samt hantera beställningar och kundkommunikation, främst via e-post.

- Planera, skapa och publicera innehåll för sociala medier, hemsidan och andra digitala kanaler.

- Planera och genomföra marknadsföringskampanjer, nyhetsbrev, provkörningsevenemang.

- Sköta administrativa uppgifter såsom uppdatering av prislistor och produktinformation etc.

- Bistå vid försäljning av utrustning och tillbehör.


**Kvalifikationer och personliga egenskaper**

Vi söker en självständig, strukturerad och ansvarstagande person som tar egna initiativ och kan planera och prioritera sitt arbete. Du trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och har förmåga att självständigt organisera dina arbetsdagar.

**Vi ser gärna att du:**

- Har relevant utbildning inom företagsekonomi, marknadsföring eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

- Har goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, särskilt Excel.

- Behärskar svenska, finska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

- Har god datorvana och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system och arbetsprocesser.

- Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.

- Har erfarenhet av Google Ads och Meta Ads Manager (meriterande).

- Ifall du inte uppfyller alla kraven är det inte ett hinder, vi skolar upp dig.

- Viktigast är en stark arbetsmoral och en vilja att lära sig.


**Vi erbjuder**

- En heltidsanställning med varierande och ansvarsfulla arbetsuppgifter.

- Möjlighet att påverka och vidareutveckla företagets e-handel, marknadsföring och administrativa processer.

- Ett självständigt arbete med goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

- En engagerad arbetsgemenskap i ett etablerat företag inom motorbranschen.

jobs.title: REKRYTERINGSKONSULT
jobs.description:
**Rekrytering handlar om mycket mer än att tillsätta lediga tjänster. Det handlar om att skapa tillväxt.**

**WasaTalent Oy** är en partner inom rekrytering och direktsökning som förenar rätt människor med rätt möjligheter. Vi har byggt vårt rykte genom ett rakt och tydligt arbetssätt, en djup förståelse för våra kunder och en förmåga att hitta kompetens där andra inte ser den. I takt med att vi växer söker vi nu en rekryteringskonsult som vill vara med och skapa framgång för både våra kunder och WasaTalent.

Vi söker en ny kollega till vårt team – en

**REKRYTERINGSKONSULT**

_Vill du hjälpa företag att hitta rätt kompetens och människor att ta nästa steg i karriären? Brinner du för ditt arbete och möter du människor med ett genuint intresse?_

**Vad innebär arbetet i praktiken?**

Det handlar om samtal med HR, vd:ar, specialister och framtidens talanger. Om att förstå kundernas verksamhet så väl att du kan identifiera rätt person för just deras behov.

Det handlar om att våga lyfta luren, ta kontakt och bygga nätverk som leder till lyckade rekryteringar även långt framöver. Och om de där stunderna när du får ringa en kandidat och säga:

_Grattis, jobbet är ditt._

**Vem lyckas hos oss?**

Vi söker dig som förstår företagens verksamhet och affärsmässiga förutsättningar. Du kan identifiera kompetens, förstå vad olika roller kräver och föra naturliga samtal på alla nivåer i en organisation. Vi värdesätter särskilt erfarenhet av rekrytering av specialister och chefer samt kunskap om metoder för direktrekrytering och digitala sökverktyg. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på finska och engelska. Kunskaper i svenska är en fördel. Det avgörande är ändå att du trivs med människor, är intresserad av affärsverksamhet och vågar ta kontakt med nya personer.

Vi upplever att de bästa rekryteringskonsulterna är nyfikna av naturen. De ställer många frågor, lyssnar noga och ser potential där andra bara ser en rad i ett cv.

**Varför WasaTalent?**

För att vi inte strävar efter att vara störst i branschen, men däremot bäst.

Hos oss har du verkliga möjligheter att påverka ditt arbete, dina kundrelationer och företagets framtid. Du får frihet, ansvar och möjlighet att växa i rollen så långt som din egen ambition tar dig. Din lön består av en grundlön och en resultatbonus som betalas ut varje månad. På så sätt återspeglas dina insatser och framgångar också i din lön.

**Den här rollen kan vara rätt för dig om** du tror att varje lyckad rekrytering börjar med ett genuint möte mellan människor. Och framför allt om du ser potential hos människor innan andra hinner upptäcka den.

Kom och skapa nya framgångshistorier tillsammans med oss.

Din arbetsplats finns i Vasa och arbetet kan inte utföras helt på distans.

Mer information om tjänsten får du av Päivi Ekholm, 040 524 5554 / paivi.ekholm@wasatalent.fi.

**Intresserad?**

Skicka din ansökan och ditt cv via WasaTalents rekryteringssystem senast **8.11.2026**.

jobs.description:
Etsimme joukkoomme **ajoneuvomekaanikkoa**, jolla on perustason osaamista ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä sekä halua kehittyä ammatissaan.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisia huolto-, korjaus- ja vianmääritystöitä erilaisten ajoneuvojen parissa. Arvostamme **reipasta, huolellista ja oppimishaluista tekijää**, joka tarttuu töihin oma-aloitteisesti.

Aikaisempaa laajaa kokemusta tai vaativien remonttien hallintaa ei edellytetä – tärkeintä on, että **ajoneuvotekniikan perusteet ovat hallussa ja halu oppia uutta on kohdallaan.**

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi**

- Määräaikais- ja perushuollot

- Jarru-, alusta- ja ohjausjärjestelmien huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- Öljyjen, suodattimien ja muiden kulutusosien vaihdot

- Renkaiden vaihdot ja muut yleiset huoltotyöt

- Ajoneuvojen perustason vianmääritys

- Muut monipuoliset huolto- ja korjaustyöt


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Perusosaamista ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- Kiinnostusta autoihin ja ajoneuvotekniikkaan

- Tavallisimpien korjaamon työkalujen ja laitteiden hallintaa

- Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia lisää

- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana työporukkaa

- Alan koulutusta ja/tai käytännön kokemusta


Aikaisempi kokemus **vaativammista korjaustöistä lasketaan eduksesi.**

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Radiography
jobs.description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching Responsibilities
The position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and Expectations
The Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Purchaser - Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Do you have experience with technical or project procurement in a larger international company? Would you like to help develop a global supply chain in an international project-driven organization? Then you may be the Purchaser we are looking for.

We are upgrading, servicing, and operating engine- and biomass-based power plants around the world. This creates a continuous need to source goods and services from subcontractors and ensure reliable transport for our customers.

For our Global Supply Chain department, we are looking for an outgoing and internationally minded colleague with commitment, determination, and a positive attitude. The department consists of 20 employees responsible for procurement, warehousing, and transport of goods and services.

BWSC – Ever better energy! 

Join us in our mission of building a world of sustainable energy and make a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

Your responsibilities

  • Support Project Procurement Managers with procurement tasks related to the execution of upgrading, service- and maintenance projects for engine and biomass power plants globally.
  • Obtain quotations from suppliers and place purchase orders within a defined area of responsibility.
  • Participate in broader departmental activities such as category management, supplier relationship development, negotiations, and implementation of supplier agreements.
  • Contribute to identifying and evaluating potential suppliers.
  • Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders.
  • Maintain and update various data, including supplier data, in the ERP system.
  • Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries and invoice approvals.
  • Assist with various development-oriented Global Supply Chain tasks within BWSC, including work instructions and new workflows.

The work is carried out in close collaboration with other departments in a dynamic and project-oriented organization. A flexible, cooperative, and positive attitude is therefore essential.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Experience within procurement, including purchase order placement and follow-up.
  • Completed education as an office assistant and/or relevant higher education qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of practical experience with technical or project procurement.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills.
  • Good IT skills and experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Ability to work in a structured manner and meet deadlines.

What do we offer? 

At BWSC we build inspiring careers locally and internationally and give you access to a great network of possibilities. 

We offer you a position with great colleagues and the opportunity to bring your skills into play and grow professionally and personally. As a Purchaser at BWSC, you will receive a competitive starting salary and a strong reward package.

We offer an exciting position in a skilled, collaborative, and project-driven work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club that organizes various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

Ready for a challenge?  

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Supply Chain Manager Anders S. A. Pedersen at asap@bwsc.dk.

BWSC is committed to promoting equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. Therefore, we do not recommend specifying age, etc., in the application. 

BWSC no longer receives or handles applications received via email due to GDPR requirements. In order for your application to be processed, you must submit your application via our online recruitment system. 

Get to know us even better on our website, www.bwsc.com, where you can learn more about our business, organization, project portfolio, and what we want to achieve at BWSC. 

About BWSC 

Burmeister & Wain Scandinavian Contractor A/S (BWSC) is a global power plant Operation & Maintenance and technical service provider with engineering expertise, enabling power plant owners to deliver cleaner and affordable energy. We are experts in servicing, upgrading, operating, and maintaining energy systems for diesel, natural gas, and renewable baseload power plants worldwide. We help our customers increase reliability and availability of energy production, improve efficiency and performance of their power plant, design and integrate future-proof technologies, and secure lower cost of maintenance.

Our people are at the core of everything we do and key to building strong relationships with our customers. We invest in our people and their wellbeing, supporting professional development and creating an environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth drive our continued success and growth as a company.

jobs.title: Työmaatilojen asentaja, PK-seutu
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme ammattitaitoista ja monipuolista työmaatilojen asentajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Tässä on tilaisuutesi työllistyä vakaaseen ja tunnettuun yritykseen, jossa pääset hyödyntämään monipuolista osaamistasi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.



Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- Kokemusta rakennusalan asennus-, korjaus- tai kirvesmiestöistä.

- Hyviä perustaitoja erilaisten käsityökalujen käytössä.

- Ymmärrystä putki- ja LVI-töistä.

- Perustuntemusta sähköasennuksista ja niiden toimintaperiaatteista. Sinun ei tarvitse olla koulutettu sähkö- tai putkiasentaja – tärkeämpää on monipuolinen tekninen ymmärrys, käytännön osaaminen ja halu oppia uutta. Varsinaiset sähköasennukset kuuluvat asianmukaisen pätevyyden omaaville ammattilaisille.

- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

- Oma-aloitteisuutta, huolellisuutta ja joustavaa asennetta.

- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta ulkona tehtävään työhön.

Edellytämme sinulta:

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta rakennus- tai asennustöistä.

- Voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia.

- Mahdollisuutta käyttää omaa autoa työmatkoihin Vantaan toimipisteelle.

- Kykyä työskennellä tarvittaessa korkealla.

- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme:

- BE-ajokortin (pikku-E).

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vakaan ja pitkäaikaisen työpaikan sekä toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen.

- Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät.

- Mukavan työporukan ja hyvän perehdytyksen tehtäviin.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi.

- Rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset työehdot ja palkkauksen.

- HR Tukku Oy:n henkilökohtaisen ja välittävän palvelun – olemme tukenasi ja apunasi aina kun tarvitset.

Jos olet monipuolinen, käytännönläheinen tekijä, jolla on hyvä asenne ja halu sitoutua pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen, haluamme kuulla sinusta!

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille osaamisestasi. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa mahdollisimman nopeasti.


HR Tukku Oy

HR Tukku Oy on vuonna 2023 perustettu henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka on syntynyt kahden kokeneen henkilöstöpalvelualan ammattilaisen ideasta tuoda markkinoille todellista yrittäjähenkisyyttä ja alan parhaita käytäntöjä. Tämä näkyy sekä työntekijöillemme että asiakkaillemme parempana palveluna ja aitona kumppanuutena. Meillä ei kelloon katsota, jos joko työntekijämme tai asiakkaamme apuamme tarvitsee.

Asiakkaalle palvelu näyttäytyy erinomaisena tavoitettavuutena, nopeana vasteaikana ja periksiantamattomuutena.

Työnhakijoille ja tekijöille yrittäjävetoisuus tarkoittaa henkilökohtaisempaa ja välittävämpää palvelua sekä aitoa huolenpitoa. Tarjoamme räätälöityjä työ- ja uramahdollisuuksia – etsit sitten vakituista, määräaikaista tai osa-aikaista työtä.

Sesongin aikana työtahti on nopea, joten odotamme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta rengastöistä, tehokasta työskentelyotetta ja kykyä työskennellä sujuvasti osana tiimiä.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu

- Henkilöautojen ja pakettiautojen renkaiden kausivaihdot

- Renkaiden asennukset vanteille

- Renkaiden tasapainotukset

- Renkaiden pesu ja varastointitehtävät

- Muut rengassesonkiin liittyvät tehtävät


Odotamme sinulta

- Aiempi kokemus rengasasentajan tehtävistä

- Hyvä tekninen osaaminen ja varma työskentelyote

- Hyvä fyysinen kunto ja kyky työskennellä ripeässä tahdissa

- Huolellisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullista asennetta

- Kykyä työskennellä tehokkaasti osana tiimiä

- B-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi


Tarjoamme sinulle

- Sesonkityön marras–joulukuussa

- Palkan rengasalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti

- Palkanmaksun 1–2 kertaa kuukaudessa

- Työajat pääasiassa arkisin klo 8–17

- Tarvittavat työvälineet ja varusteet

- Toimivan työympäristön ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen


Etsimme tekijöitä, joilla on jo kokemusta rengastöistä ja jotka pääsevät nopeasti mukaan sesongin työrytmiin.

**Kiinnostuitko?** Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro aiemmasta rengastyökokemuksestasi sekä siitä, milloin pääsisit aloittamaan.

Tervetuloa mukaan rengassesonkiin!

jobs.title: Expression of Interest - Offshore Helicopter Pilots
jobs.description:
Join Our Pilot Pool for Future Opportunities

At Avincis, we are proud to support the green energy transition by providing safe and efficient helicopter transport to offshore wind farms and associated installations.

As the offshore wind industry continues to grow, we are preparing for potential future expansion of our operations in Denmark and Northern Germany. We are therefore interested in connecting with experienced helicopter pilots who may wish to join our team as new opportunities arise.

---

Please note that this is not an active vacancy. We are building a network of qualified helicopter pilots who may be interested in future opportunities within our operations. Candidates whose qualifications and experience match our requirements may be contacted as suitable positions become available.

About the Opportunity

Pilots joining Avincis operate Airbus H135 and H145 helicopters in support of offshore wind operations, including:

  • Personnel transport to offshore wind farms and vessels

  • Crew change operations

  • Equipment transport

  • Offshore hoist operations

  • IFR and offshore flight operations

Our current Danish bases include Esbjerg, Roskilde, Grenaa and Thorsminde, supporting some of Northern Europe's largest offshore wind projects.

While no positions are currently guaranteed, candidates meeting our requirements may be contacted regarding future opportunities as business needs develop.

Who We Are Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • EASA ATPL(H) or CPL(H) with IR(H)

  • EASA Class 1 Medical

  • English Language Proficiency Level 6

  • Minimum 2,000 hours total helicopter flight time, including:

    • 1,000 hours PIC

    • 500 hours PIC Multi Engine

    • 500 hours offshore helicopter experience

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Offshore HHO experience

  • IFR operations

  • Airbus H135 or H145 experience

  • MCC / Multi-Pilot qualification

  • Residence in Denmark or the surrounding region

Why Register Your Interest?

By joining our pilot pool, you will:

  • Be among the first candidates considered for future opportunities

  • Connect with a leading offshore helicopter operator

  • Become part of an organization committed to safety, professionalism and operational excellence

  • Explore future opportunities within both Avincis Denmark and the wider Avincis Group

How to Apply

Please upload:

  • CV

  • Relevant licences

  • Certificates

Candidates meeting the qualification requirements may be invited to provide additional documentation regarding aeronautical experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and retained for consideration in connection with future recruitment processes.

Personligt er du smilende, udadvendt og serviceminded. Du sætter en ære i dit arbejde, og du brænder for at levere kundeservice af allerhøjeste karakter. Det er nemlig tilfredse kunder, vi lever af.

 

Vi har brug for, at du blandt andet er skarp på følgende:

Forståelse for tal og købmandsskab

Rådgivning af kunder i vores bilhus

Håndtering af leads

Skabe en god kundeoplevelse – vi lever af tilfredse kunder

Udarbejdelse af tilbud - både i forbindelse med køb og finansiering

Prissætning af byttebiler

Vi tilbyder et godt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel omgangstone, løn efter kvalifikationer , samt en attraktiv pensionsordning.

Du skal være villig til at arbejde, når kunderne er der - det vil også sige 2 x søndage pr.md.. . Tiltrædelse snarest - men vi venter gerne på den helt rette kandidat.

Leif Jørgensen Automobiler er et 44 år gammelt firma

Har du lyst, tilbyder vi også gode muligheder for at gøre karriere indenfor bilbranchen i vores store fællesskab. Vi har en moderne ledelse, som sætter pris på medarbejdere, der tager initiativ og ansvar, og du kan i høj grad præge din hverdag.

jobs.title: SAP Basis Specialist, Espoo
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will work at an important interface between internal stakeholders and the SAP technical team. The role is suitable for someone who already has some practical experience with SAP environments or other similar technical maintenance and support work, and who wants to further grow their expertise alongside more experienced specialists.

We offer a competitive salary (approx. €2,800–€4,000/month), the opportunity for significant professional development, and learning with the support of experienced colleagues. You will receive comprehensive onboarding and a flexible working model that considers work-life balance. You will work as part of a supportive team where everyone's contribution is valued.

Work tasks

Your main duty will be to ensure the stable and efficient operation of the SAP production environment through continuous maintenance and monitoring. The job involves close cooperation with an external SAP team, ticket management, and system configuration, offering an opportunity to deepen your expertise as a SAP Basis specialist.

In your role, you will be responsible for, among other things:
- Daily maintenance of the SAP environment and supporting production continuity
- Monitoring, troubleshooting error situations, and analyzing technical problems
- Cooperation with the SAP ECS team and managing necessary tickets in the SAP for Me environment
- Coordinating maintenance breaks, downtimes, and other technical changes
- Supporting the deployment of transports to production
- Individual system setting changes and service activations
- Coordinating technical observations and measures with different stakeholders

We are looking for

What we hope from you

In this role, the most important thing is not a perfect list of all SAP Basis expertise areas, but the ability to get involved in technical daily operations and learn quickly. So you are not necessarily a senior yet, but not quite at the beginning of your career either. You have already seen enough of practical IT or SAP environments to work independently without constant hands-on guidance.

You might be the person we are looking for if you have
- already some experience in SAP Basis tasks, technical application support, or a similar maintenance environment
- a technical mindset and the ability to understand where problems may originate from
- readiness to investigate, learn, and take responsibility for practical work
- ability to work in English
- possibility to work in a hybrid model in Espoo (after onboarding 2-3 days/week remotely ok)

We consider it an advantage if you have experience in, for example
- SAP Basis maintenance
- SAP for Me tool
- monitoring, analyzing short dump errors, and investigating error situations
- transport management
- security note implementations
- EarlyWatch or Cloud ALM environments – ownership of this
- system or client copy operations
- knowledge of ABAP basics

We Offer You
- an opportunity to work in an interesting and business-critical SAP environment
- a role where you get to grow your expertise through hands-on work
- an expert team and collaboration with experienced SAP professionals
- a hybrid work model: work is done mainly in Espoo, at least 2–3 days a week at the office, more during the onboarding phase
- a salary of approx. €2,800–€4,000/month depending on expertise and experience, and for very experienced specialists, the level can be higher

Other Good to Know Information
- The role occasionally involves on-call situations related to maintenance breaks in the evenings or on weekends. These occur a few times a year, but during these times we hope for readiness to be at the computer if necessary
- A security clearance will be conducted for the person selected for the position
- Start date is as soon as possible after finding a suitable person

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.title: Kunnossapitomestari sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapitoon
jobs.description:
Alva-yhtiöiden vastuulla ovat kaikille tärkeät elämisen peruspilarit: vesi, lämpö ja sähkö. Teemme työtä yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa energiatehokkaiden ja vihreiden valintojen sekä vastuullisen omaisuudenhallinnan puolesta. Olemme näkemyksellinen ja tulevaisuuteen katsova kumppani, joka saa asiakkaansa menestymään. Tavoitteemme on olla hiilineutraali vuoteen 2030 mennessä. Konsernissamme työskentelee noin 240 ammattilaista ja liikevaihtomme vuonna 2025 oli 187 miljoonaa euroa. Alva-yhtiöt Oy:n omistaa Jyväskylän kaupunki. Olemme Future Workplaces 2025 -sertifioitu työpaikka.
Työhösi kuuluu energiantuotannon sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidon operatiivisen toiminnan työnjohtovastuu ja osallistut vuosihuolloissa oman vastuualueesi asennusvalvontaan. Työkohteet vaihtelevat Alvan toiminta-alueella Jyväskylän ympäristössä.
Vastaat vikakorjausten, vianhakujen sekä ennakkohuoltotöiden järjestelystä. Tehtävässä toimit teknisenä tukena asentajille sekä käyttöhenkilöstölle ja vastaat osaltasi kunnossapitojärjestelmän ylläpidosta.
Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta ja yli viiden vuoden työkokemusta sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidon työtehtävistä tai hyvää sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidon suunnittelukokemusta. Sähkönjakelujärjestelmien, Valmet DNA automaatiojärjestelmien sekä kenttälaitteiden hyvä tuntemus sekä S1 tai S2 pätevyys luetaan eduksesi.
Tehtävässä tarvitset voimassa olevan B-ajokortin, sähkötyöturvallisuus-, työturvallisuus- sekä tulityökortin. Työturvallisuus- ja tulityökortti on mahdollista suorittaa töiden alkaessa. Käynninvarmistus on osa kunnossapidon toimintamallia ja osallistut varallaoloon.
Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ja erinomaisia yhteistyötaitoja. Olet vastuuntuntoinen, oma-aloitteinen ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevä kehityshakuinen ammattilainen.
Tarjoamme mukavan työyhteisön ja mielenkiintoisen tehtävän, jossa pääset kehittämään myös omaa osaamistasi. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja työ alkaa viimeistään 1.2.2027. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee Jyväskylässä.
Lisätietoja: kunnossapitoinsinööri Hannu Katajisto, hannu.katajisto(at)alva.fi tai puh. 040 486 6953 maanantaisin kello 13-15.
Hakemuksesi ja CV:n palkkatoiveineen voit lähettää osoitteessa Alva.fi/meille töihin 29.11.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että voimme edetä rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana. Tehtävään valitulle tehdään turvallisuusselvitys. Lisäksi edellytämme hyväksyttyä terveystarkastusta, joka sisältää huumetestauksen.

jobs.title: Testaus- ja käyttöönottoinsinööri
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisissa teollisuuden testaus- ja käyttöönottotehtävissä ja päästä mukaan varmistamaan asiakkaidemme sujuvaa liiketoimintaa modernissa työyhteisössä?

Haemme Installerylle **testaus- ja käyttöönottoinsinööriä** Uudenmaan alueelle työskentelemään osana meidän ja asiakkaamme tuotekehityksen tiimiä. Tarjoamme kiinnostavia tehtäviä teollisuuden järjestelmien parissa sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi osana ammattitaitoitoista tiimiä.

Installery on erikoistunut teollisuuden projekti-, kunnossapito- ja tarkastustuspalveluihin. Meidät tunnetaan laadukkaasta työnjäljestä, vahvasta ammattiosaamisesta ja asiakaslähtöisestä toimintatavasta.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Osallistut automaatiojärjestelmien ja laitteiden testaukseen sekä käyttöönottoon, testien suunnitteluun, kehittämiseen ja käytännön toteutukseen kentällä sekä asiakkaidemme tiloissa.

Toimeksiantomme ovat pitkäkestoisia. Perehdyt ensin järjestelmiin kokeneempien osaajien avulla ja sen jälkeen otat haltuusi kokonaisuuksia joiden toiminnan ja kehittämisen parissa työskentelet tiimisi kanssa.

Kohteemme sijaitsee Uudenmaan alueella, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus helpottaa liikkumista.

Asiakkuuksiimme kuuluu muun muassa korkean teknologian toimijoita, teollisuuden tuotantolaitoksia sekä kriittisten järjestelmien kohteita. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mielenkiintoisissa ympäristöissä ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi teollisuuden huippuosaajien rinnalla.

Työsi tapahtuu päivävuorossa, ja läsnäolo asiakkuuksissamme on noin 80 - 100%, etätöitä voit tehdä esimerkiksi dokumentaatiota tai raportointia suorittaessasi.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta työkokemusta teollisuuden sähkö - ja / tai automaatio asennuksista, vianhausta ja ongelmanratkaisusta vähintään 3-4 vuoden ajalta, sekä automaatioalan tuntemusta erilaisten käyttö - ja ohjausjärjestelmien kautta. (PLC, esim Siemen, käyttöliittymät) Meiltä löytyy kiinnostavia kohteita myös kokeneemmille osaajille.

Tehtävässä edellytyksenä on sähkö - ja / tai automaatioalan ammattitutkinto, alan insinööritutkinto ja ennen kaikkea arvostamme käytännön kokemusta sekä kiinnostusta sähkö - ja automaatioalaa kohtaan.

Työ vaatii teollisuuden sähkö -, ja automaatiokomponenttien tuntemusta, järjestelmätason ymmärrystä (kenttäväylät, liitettävyydet, käyttöliittymät), sekä kokemusta mittauksista, tarkastuksista ja testauksesta.

Työkielemme on suomi. Lisäksi englannin perustaidot ovat välttämättömät teknisten manuaalien tulkinnassa ja asiakasrajapinnassa.

**Miksi Installery?**

jobs.title: Osa-aikainen verkkokaupan ja varaston moniosaaja – Löytö24 / CarHelp Karkkila
jobs.description:
Etsimme **erittäin oma-aloitteista, vastuuntuntoista ja järjestelmällistä henkilöä** kehittämään ja rakentamaan **Löytö24-verkkokaupan** toimintaa Karkkilassa.

**Löytö24 on tehtävän tärkein ja ensisijainen painopiste.** Syyskuussa avaamme Karkkilaan uuden varaston, johon tulee suuri määrä erilaisia uusia ja käytettyjä tuotteita. Tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan käytännössä toimivan kokonaisuuden tuotteiden käsittelystä aina verkkokauppaan ja asiakkaalle toimitukseen asti.

Työ ei ole pelkkää tuotteiden lisäämistä verkkokauppaan. Tavoitteena on saada **Löytö24 nopeasti kasvamaan ja tuotteet tehokkaasti myyntiin**.

Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu osallistuminen CarHelpin muiden verkkokauppojen ylläpitoon, markkinointiin ja kasvattamiseen.

Mitä työ sisältää?

- **Löytö24-verkkokaupan päivittäinen kehittäminen ja ylläpito**

- Uusien tuotteiden kuvaaminen ja kuvien käsittely

- Tuotteiden tietojen, ominaisuuksien ja hintojen selvittäminen

- Tuotteiden lisääminen Löytö24-verkkokauppaan ja muille myyntialustoille

- Myynti-ilmoitusten tekeminen ja niiden kehittäminen

- Tuotteiden lajittelu, merkitseminen ja järjestäminen

- Varaston loogisen järjestelmän rakentaminen ja ylläpito

- Tuotteiden kerääminen, pakkaaminen ja lähettäminen asiakkaille

- Noutojen ja tuotteiden luovutusten hoitaminen

- Varastosaldojen ja tuotteiden seuranta

- Uusien tuotteiden käsittely nopeasti niiden saapuessa

- Löytö24 myynnin ja näkyvyyden aktiivinen kehittäminen

- **Sosiaalisen median aktiivinen hyödyntäminen Löytö24 markkinoinnissa**

- Tuotteiden ja verkkokaupan aktiivinen esille tuominen Facebookissa, Instagramissa ja TikTokissa

- Osallistuminen myös muiden verkkokauppojen, kuten **renkaiden verkkokauppojen**, ylläpitoon ja kasvattamiseen


Millainen henkilö sopii tehtävään?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka on:

- **Erittäin oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen**

- Täsmällinen ja luotettava

- Hyvä suunnittelemaan omaa ajankäyttöään

- Itsenäinen – et tarvitse jatkuvaa ohjausta

- **Päätöksentekokykyinen – uskallat tehdä ratkaisuja itse**

- Järjestelmällinen ja osaat luoda järjestystä myös tilanteissa, joissa sitä ei vielä ole

- Nopea oppimaan uusia asioita ja järjestelmiä

- Tietokoneen ja verkkopalveluiden kanssa sujuvasti toimiva

- Myynnillisesti ajatteleva ja tuloshakuinen

- **Aktiivinen sosiaalisessa mediassa**

- Kiinnostunut sisällön tekemisestä ja tuotteiden markkinoinnista

- Hyvässä fyysisessä kunnossa – työ sisältää myös renkaiden ja muiden suurempien tuotteiden käsittelyä


Eduksi katsomme:

- Kokemuksen verkkokaupoista tai tuotteiden myynnistä verkossa

- **Meta Business Managerin ja Meta-mainonnan tuntemuksen**

- Facebookin ja Instagramin aktiivisen käytön

- TikTokin tuntemuksen

- Kokemuksen tuotteiden kuvaamisesta ja sisällöntuotannosta

- Kokemuksen varasto- tai logistiikkatyöstä

- Hyvän englannin kielen taidon


Tämä työ ei sovi sinulle, jos:

- Tarvitset jatkuvasti tarkkoja ohjeita siitä, mitä pitää tehdä

- Jäät odottamaan, että joku muu ratkaisee ongelmat

- Sinun on vaikea suunnitella omaa ajankäyttöäsi

- Päätösten tekeminen itsenäisesti tuntuu vaikealta

- Työskentelet hitaasti ilman selkeää syytä

- Et pidä käytännön ja fyysisestä työstä

- Some ja verkkokauppa eivät kiinnosta


Meillä tuotteita tulee jatkuvasti lisää, joten **tässä työssä pitää saada aikaan tulosta ja asioita pitää viedä eteenpäin joka päivä.**

Tarjoamme:

- Osa-aikaisen työn, jossa mahdollisuus kasvaa kokoaikaiseksi

- **Erittäin itsenäisen ja vastuullisen roolin**

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa ja kehittää **Löytö24-verkkokauppaa alusta alkaen**

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan verkkokaupan myyntiin ja tulokseen

- Monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset tekemään sekä verkkokauppaa, varastoa että markkinointia

- Käytännön tekemistä ilman turhaa byrokratiaa

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa yrityksen mukana, jos yhteistyö toimii hyvin


**Jos olet järjestelmällinen, oma-aloitteinen ja aikaansaava tekijä, joka näkee itse mitä pitää tehdä eikä odota jatkuvasti ohjeita, tämä tehtävä voi sopia sinulle erittäin hyvin.**

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator in our Tokyo office to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process in Japan and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:




CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.




COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across multiple time zones, primarily supporting Go-To-Market teams, including remote interviews and onsite panels. You’ll balance speed with attention to detail, anticipate needs, and communicate proactively to keep candidates and interviewers aligned. You’ll ensure logistics, materials, and feedback loops are clear and on time, and troubleshoot day-of changes and scheduling conflicts with a calm, solutions-oriented approach, making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.




BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, talent branding projects, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow, creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - At least 1–2 years of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proactive, reliable approach and thoughtful attention to detail

 - A growth mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of mistakes, learn from feedback, and refine your processes to improve accuracy and consistency

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills to represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with candidates and colleagues in both languages

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack, and Notion

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be one of the founding data scientist on Replit's Growth team, working with Product and Engineering leadership across acquisition, activation and recommender systems, and helping shape how Replit experiments.

This role is for someone who doesn't wait to be asked. You spot problems and opportunities before anyone else does, bring a strong point of view, and push it until it changes what we build.




YOU WILL:

 - Own data science for major growth areas, partnering with PMs and engineers from problem framing and sizing through launch and readout

 - Make fast decisions trustworthy: we ship weekly and need a decision within days, but retention takes weeks to show up. You'll design the experiments and metrics that close that gap; for example, variance reduction (CUPED), sequential testing, and short-term proxy metrics validated against long-term retention and revenue

 - Help set the experimentation standards teams rely on for Replit's highest-traffic surfaces: how metrics and guardrails are defined, and the checks that catch a broken test before it misleads anyone

 - Use quasi-experimental designs (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity) where randomization isn't feasible, such as pricing changes and regional launches

 - Help define the data science behind an emerging personalization and recommendations workstream: problem framing, offline and online evaluation, and measuring incremental lift

 - Model the economics of a freemium, usage-based product: credit consumption, conversion, and how pricing and limits change behavior

 - Develop user and project segmentation from behavioral and content signals (e.g., embeddings and clustering) so growth analysis reflects what people are actually building

 - Partner with Data Engineering on a shared metrics layer and experimentation tooling


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 6+ years in data science, with significant time on growth or experimentation for high-scale prosumer, PLG, or self-serve products

 - Data science experience at a fast-growing startup, where you built metrics, datasets, and experimentation practices without much existing infrastructure

 - Deep expertise in experimental design and statistical inference, including reaching reliable decisions when readout windows are short and the outcomes that matter are slow

 - Experience establishing experimentation standards or platforms adopted by multiple teams

 - Expert SQL and Python

 - A track record of analysis that changed what a team shipped, and of influencing senior Product and Engineering leaders

 - Heavy, practical use of AI tools to move faster in your own work


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Comfortable building your own datasets in dbt;

 - Pricing, packaging, or monetization analysis for usage- or credit-based products

 - International or mobile growth experience

 - MS or PhD in statistics, economics, computer science, or another quantitative field


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with multi-armed bandits or adaptive experimentation

 - Familiarity with developer tools, AI products, or creator platforms

This is a full-time role based in our Foster City, CA office with an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: direttore commerciale/direttrice commerciale
jobs.description: Per una PMI italiana in forte crescita nell'ambito dell' automazione industriale, ricerchiamo la figura di un Sales Manager- Automazione Industriale per guidare l'evoluzione dell'area commerciale da modello 'imprenditoriale' a struttura scalabile e data-driven. Chi è il nostro cliente Realtà che opera tra Automazione industriale e sicurezza di macchine/impianti, con un posizionamento da partner tecnico-consulenziale: integra componenti tecnologiche e un portafoglio di servizi specialistici. La sfida Inserimento con affiancamento iniziale alla Direzione Commerciale, pensato come transizione concreta e rapida verso la guida dell'Area Sales. Cerchiamo una figura già strutturata, capace di portare metodo, KPI, organizzazione e leadership positiva, incidendo direttamente su processi, rete vendita e crescita. E' una persona che non si staccherà dal business, al contrario contribuirà direttamente insieme al team alla crescita e allo sviluppo commerciale dell'azienda. Responsabilità Coordinare e affiancare team commerciale interno e rete di agenti/partner nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità. Definire (con la Direzione) obiettivi, priorità e piano commerciale; monitorare avanzamento e scostamenti. Gestire e sviluppare direttamente alcuni clienti strategici. Identificare nuovi segmenti, casi d'uso e soluzioni da introdurre (approccio 'business development'). Promuovere l'uso del CRM e la qualità della pipeline (forecast, next step, copertura). Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede: Milano Nord Est Modalità: presenza in sede + attività sul territorio Orario: full time Trasferte: frequenti su territorio nazionale RAL: 50.000 - 65.000 € (in base a esperienza e competenze, criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere) CCNL: Commercio Inquadramento: Quadro Variabile/benefit:MBO (premio variabile) Auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo Ticket Restaurant Welfare: 2,5 mensilità #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. jobs.title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
jobs.description: Per Startup in fase di sviluppo che sta costruendo una piattaforma europea di connettività satellitare con focus su capacità wholesale, servizi di connettività gestita e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite, ricerchiamo un/una Responsabile Downstream, Wholesale e Connettività Satellitare IoT (percorso Co-founder) La figura riportando alla direzione, affiancherà e collaborerà con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems già inserito nel progetto, portando esperienza concreta, verificabile e diretta nel settore satcom. Obiettivo della ricerca Inserire un profilo senior in grado di guidare lo sviluppo downstream e commerciale dell'iniziativa, con responsabilità primaria nella costruzione del mercato, delle partnership e dell'offerta per la vendita di connettività satellitare all'ingrosso e dei servizi collegati. Il ruolo è pensato per una figura con forte attitudine imprenditoriale, credibilità industriale e capacità di esecuzione in una fase iniziale di impresa. Responsabilità principali La persona selezionata avrà il compito di: definire e guidare la strategia downstream e wholesale per servizi di connettività satellitare, airtime e capacità integrata; costruire e gestire relazioni commerciali con operatori satellitari, service provider, distributori, teleporter, integratori, OEM e partner industriali; trasformare capacità satellitare e servizi di rete in offerte vendibili, incluse soluzioni airtime, connettività gestita, white-label, wholesale e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite; identificare i segmenti di mercato prioritari e i casi d'uso in cui il satellite offra un vantaggio competitivo rispetto alle reti terrestri; collaborare con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems per tradurre i bisogni del mercato in requisiti di capacità, copertura, terminali, gateway, SLA, API e supporto. Inserita a riporto diretto dell'HSE & Facility Manager, la risorsa avrà un ruolo chiave nel presidio quotidiano di Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente in stabilimento, con responsabilità operative e di miglioramento continuo. Responsabilità principali Condurre attività di valutazione dei rischi e contribuire alla stesura/aggiornamento del DVR e della documentazione correlata. Definire e implementare misure di prevenzione e protezione, monitorandone l'efficacia tramite audit, verifiche e indicatori. Gestire e aggiornare lo scadenziario relativo ad adempimenti normativi (safety e ambiente) e requisiti volontari. Coordinare il supporto di consulenti esterni per valutazioni specifiche (es. rumore, chimico, ATEX, ergonomia, movimentazione manuale, ecc.). Pianificare ed erogare (o far erogare) la formazione HSE e la sensibilizzazione del personale, anche con iniziative sul campo. Gestire la sorveglianza sanitaria in collaborazione con il Medico Competente (programmi, idoneità, tracciabilità). Presidiare la qualifica e gestione HSE degli appaltatori: accessi, documentazione, permessi di lavoro e DUVRI. Curare la gestione delle sostanze chimiche (valutazione rischio, conformità, impatti ambientali, schede sicurezza, omologazioni/approvazioni interne). Supportare la verifica dei processi produttivi e delle modalità operative per ridurre rischi e impatti ambientali. Contribuire agli adempimenti ambientali (autorizzazioni, prescrizioni, monitoraggi e attività analitiche). Mantenere e migliorare procedure e istruzioni operative del Sistema di Gestione secondo ISO 45001 e ISO 14001, supportando audit interni/esterni. Promuovere la cultura della sicurezza e programmi di sicurezza comportamentale, favorendo il coinvolgimento attivo dei lavoratori. Analizzare near miss, incidenti e infortuni con approccio root cause, definendo e tracciando azioni correttive/preventive. Collaborare con l'HSE Manager su iniziative di sostenibilità e miglioramento delle performance ambientali. Requisiti Laurea (preferibile indirizzo ingegneristico/tecnico con focus HSE o affini). Abilitazione ASPP (Moduli A e B). Esperienza consolidata in ruolo HSE in contesti manifatturieri/industriali. Conoscenza operativa delle norme ISO 45001 e ISO 14001. Zakres obowiązków: Asystent rodziny prowadzi pracę z rodziną w miejscu jej zamieszkania lub w miejscu wskazanym przez rodzinę. Zadania asystenta rodziny realizowane są w pełnym wymiarze
czasu pracy w systemie zadaniowym.
Zakres wykonywanych zadań:
1) opracowywanie i realizacja planów pracy z rodzinami, we współpracy z członkami rodziny  i w konsultacji z pracownikiem socjalnym.
2) opracowywanie, we współpracy z członkami rodziny i koordynatorem rodzinnej pieczy
zastępczej, planu pracy z rodziną, który jest skoordynowany z planem pomocy dziecku umieszczonemu w pieczy zastępczej.
3) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w poprawie ich sytuacji życiowej, w tym w zdobywaniu,
umiejętności prawidłowego prowadzenia gospodarstwa domowego
4) udzielanie pomocy rodzinom w rozwiązywaniu problemów socjalnych.
Więcej informacji na stronie internetowej:
http://paczkow.naszops.pl/pliki/plik/ogloszenie-asystent-rodziny-1790325922.pdf
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wykształcenie wyższe na kierunku pedagogika, psychologia, socjologia, nauki o rodzinie lub praca socjalna lub wykształcenie wyższe na dowolnym kierunku uzupełnione szkoleniem z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną i udokumentuje co najmniej roczny staż pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną lub średnie branżowe i szkolenie z zakresu pracy z dziećmi lub rodziną, a także udokumentuje co najmniej 3-letni staż.
Sposób aplikowania:
- bezpośrednio do pracodawcy
- wymagane dokumenty: Druk kwestionariusza osobowego, klauzula informacyjna, oświadczenie dostępne są na stronie
internetowej Ośrodka Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie.
Dokumenty należy składać w sekretariacie Ośrodka do dnia 02.10.2026 r. do godziny 13.00 w
zamkniętej kopercie z dopiskiem: Dotyczy zatrudnienia osoby do wykonywania zadań
asystenta rodziny w Ośrodku Pomocy Społecznej w Paczkowie lub za pośrednictwem
poczty, kuriera (decyduje data wpływu do Ośrodka). Dokumenty, które wpłyną po upływie
wyżej określonego terminu lub będą niekompletne, nie będą rozpatrywane.

jobs.title: Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Specialist you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. On a given day, you’ll help our customers navigate billing questions, manage their accounts, and get the most out of Replit. You'll be the voice of our users, bubbling up patterns and feedback to Replit's Product and Engineering teams so we can keep improving. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, Stripe, Orb and Replit itself to get the job done.

You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.

 


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve account, billing, and product issues, while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support’s Team's  Knowledge Base

 - Own and manage escalated customer interactions that are complex, sensitive, or high-impact, driving resolution across stakeholders.

 - Help shape and refine support processes as the team and product continue to grow




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of customer support experience

 - Experience with support platforms (Zendesk), payment systems (Stripe, Orb), and ticketing workflows

 - Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to asking questions and resolving ambiguity

 - Ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills

 - Comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment

 - Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Background in B2B SaaS customer success or support

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Location(s):  Luxembourg Marriott Hotel Alfa

JOB SUMMARY

Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

OR
