jobs.title: Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects I (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

XXXX-112 Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
69,000 - 77,000 € per year

Who we are

XXXX (XXXX) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. XXXX enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The XXXX service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, XXXX will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. You will support flagship projects such as but not limited to, HDAB2-LU, which is enabling the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and laying the foundations for a robust health data ecosystem aligned with European data-sharing frameworks.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will contribute to the development of data governance practices, data access services, and project-related solutions that facilitate secure data sharing, strengthen health and research data ecosystems, and promote the responsible adoption of trustworthy AI. Your work will directly contribute to XXXX's mission of unlocking the value of data while ensuring transparency, compliance, and public trust.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will drive the development and delivery of the data access request management capacity. This includes the collection and validation of access conditions from different data providers, standardising the information into data request application form, defining the access review procedure and SOPs, compiling requirements of data access management tools, supporting the implementation of the tools to and implementing the data access request management workflows in the tools. You will work with the other project team members from XXXX, including Project Coordinator, Work Package Leaders, Data Protection Officer (DPO) and ethical, legal and societal implications (ELSI) experts to implement the required compliance measures related to the projects. Finally, you will interact with the information security, technology, and data teams to ensure adequate design and delivery of services.

What you will do

• Develop and deliver XXXX' DM/DS services within the scope of the projects
• Contribute to other services and the maintenance of XXXX' DM/DS toolbox.
• Develop guidelines on data management, stewardship and protection for the projects
• Contribute to the XXXX' Data Catalogue by populating, curating, and updating metadata related to data custodians, provenance and use restrictions for datasets of the projects
• Implement necessary General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) accountability measures for data processing activities involving personal data required by the projects
• Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for data processing activities concerning sensitive data for the projects
• Provide training on DM/DS best practices, tools, and related to the DS services of the projects
• Develop internal processes and guidelines to support relevant information security and data protection compliances and certifications related to the projects
• Engage in (inter-)national projects related to DM/DS service development related to the projects
• Train and supervise less experienced team members working on the projects

Who you are

• MSc or PhD in natural science or technology, or social science with technical skills.
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, including relevant ones in the following areas:
          - data stewardship
          - data management
          - community coordination, outreach and training.
• Working knowledge in data lifecycle management, FAIR data principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse) and the GDPR
• Experience in technical writing (white papers, documentation, reports, policies) and content for dissemination to stakeholders and the public (online guides, tutorials)
• Good working knowledge of one programming language (Python or R)
• Good working knowledge of command line shell (any OS)
• Good working knowledge of basic website authoring (markdown, jinja, HTML)
• Proven experience in one of the following topics:
          - Ethical, legal and societal implications in data-driven research projects
          - Designing and implementing organisational risk management processes
          - Data requests management of sensitive data
          - DPIA
         - Community building and management
• Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
• Service and collaborative attitude
• Ability and willingness to interact closely with stakeholders
• Ability to handle multiple assignments while working independently and effectively under deadlines

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The XXXX is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join XXXX and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

Apply now!

jobs.title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

jobs.description:
Description:


Superviseur Opérationnel (H/F) - Luxembourg | CDI | Management & Opérations

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation de ses activités, notre client, entreprise de services implantée au Luxembourg, recherche
plusieurs Superviseurs Opérationnels afin de renforcer son organisation terrain.
Vous occupez un rôle clé combinant management, pilotage opérationnel, gestion budgétaire et relation client dans un environnement multisites.


Votre rôle :

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Opérationnelle, vous prenez en charge un portefeuille de sites et supervisez plusieurs responsables terrain.


Vos principales responsabilités seront de :

● Manager et accompagner les responsables terrain, fixer leurs priorités et suivre leurs résultats ;
● Garantir le bon déroulement des prestations et le respect des engagements clients ;
● Assurer un suivi régulier de la satisfaction client, gérer les réclamations et mettre en place les actions correctives nécessaires ;
● Suivre les budgets des différents sites, analyser les coûts, la productivité et les éventuels écarts ;
● Participer au lancement, au suivi et, lorsque nécessaire, à la réorganisation des sites ;
● Veiller au respect des standards de qualité, sécurité et performance ;
● Assurer un reporting fiable grâce aux outils digitaux et aux différents indicateurs de suivi.

jobs.description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: IT department
Job Number: UOL08471
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Expertise: Administration/ Corporate Functions
Job (internal): End user computing specialist
Job Level: level 1
Functions: ICT and SAP competence centre
Role Type: Open Position


Your role:

Are you passionate about optimizing IT asset flows and ensuring smooth delivery of technology to end-users? We are seeking an enthusiastic End-User Computing Specialist with a keen focus on IT logistics to join our IT team. In this hands-on role, you will manage the complete journey of IT hardware – from incoming delivery through to deployment, recovery, and retirement – with an eye for detail, organization, and compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

• Receive, inspect, and accurately register incoming IT hardware and accessories: laptops, monitors, peripherals
• Maintain well-organized and secure stockrooms, ensuring clear labelling, categorization, and safety standards
• Prepare devices for deployment, including labelling, assembling accessory kits, and packaging equipment, working closely with the End-User Computing and Service Desk teams
• Distribute hardware to ServiceDesk for handover to users, supporting the handover process with thorough documentation and ownership tracking
• Retrieve and process equipment from leavers or for replacements, returning items for stock, refurbishment, or compliant disposal
• Collaborate with procurement and vendors for repairs, RMA processes, warranty claims, or delivery discrepancies
• Support regular inventory reconciliation and assist in physical stock audits to ensure records match inventories
• Proactively monitor equipment levels and forecast potential shortages or overstock situations
• Help to organize and execute special on-site installation projects
• Help to plan and execute device refresh cycles
• Securely decommission obsolete hardware


Your profile:

• High school education or up to 3 years of experience in IT support, end-user computing, help desk, or a similar role
• Good understanding of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 environment, and end-user devices
• Knowledge of IT service management principles and ticketing tools is considered an asset.
• Good understanding of IT security principles and good practices
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve common hardware, software, and connectivity issues
• Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-oriented mindset
• Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
• Willingness to learn new technologies and develop technical expertise
• Ability to prioritize tasks and manage workload effectively
• Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, or data analysis is an advantage
• Excellent command (C1) in French & English ; additional languages are considered an asset


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs


How to apply:

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

jobs.title: Senior infrastructure Engineer (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Description:


How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organizational activities.

Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:

·          Administer, maintain and continuously improve LIST's backup, storage and file-service infrastructure.
·          Operate the Commvault backup platform, including policies, schedules, retention, reporting and capacity management.
·          Monitor backup jobs, perform recovery tests, and support disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·          Administer storage infrastructure and file services supporting SMB shares, VMware and other infrastructure workloads.
·          Manage storage capacity, performance, availability, resilience, data protection and lifecycle activities.
·          Monitor infrastructure hardware and services, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup and network-related components.
·          Maintain relevant monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, service indicators, thresholds and operational reports.
·          Investigate and troubleshoot incidents, failures, alerts, performance issues, capacity constraints and hardware problems.
·          Perform or coordinate upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, replacements and decommissioning.
·          Contribute to capacity planning, performance optimization, service continuity and infrastructure architecture improvements.
·          Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, dependencies, recovery requirements and escalation paths.



Additional infrastructure responsibilities:

Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also provide support for:

·          Active Directory operations, including user and computer administration, group management, access control and directory hygiene.
·          Telephony and unified-communications services, including operational support, maintenance, lifecycle activities and service improvements.

You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Information Security, Applications and Development teams, researchers, external service providers and other stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable and efficient IT services


Project delivery and activity management:

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritizing tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field experience


Experience and skills:

·          Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or a comparable IT environment.
·          Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise backup and recovery platforms, preferably Commvault.
·          Practical experience with backup policies, retention, monitoring, recovery procedures, recovery testing and disaster-recovery operations.
·          Experience administering or supporting enterprise storage systems, file services and storage technologies for virtualisation or infrastructure workloads.
·          Experience with infrastructure monitoring, including service availability, hardware health, capacity, performance and alert management.
·          Experience with infrastructure maintenance, lifecycle management, patching, vulnerability remediation and service continuity.
·          Experience supporting Active Directory or other identity and directory services is an advantage.
·          Experience with VMware or comparable virtualisation technologies is an advantage.
·          Experience operating or supporting enterprise telephony, unified communications or related services is an advantage.
·          Good understanding of infrastructure-security practices, including hardening, access control, vulnerability remediation, encryption and data protection.
·          Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and firewalls.
·          Experience with scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or equivalent is an advantage.
·          Experience supporting cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
·          Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·          Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.


Soft skills:

·          Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·          Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·          Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate and report on activities.
·          Strong documentation, communication, planning and organizational skills.
·          Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·          Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·          Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·          Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.


Language skills:

•               Fluency in English (Luxembourgish, German and especially French are considered as an asset), both oral and written.


Your LIST benefits:

·          An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·          Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·          An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·          Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers


Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
·          Contact details of 2 references


Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Contexte

Dans le cadre de son développement, notre société recherche un(e) Chargé(e) d'affaires Chauffage. Ce
poste associe expertise technique, gestion de chantier, chiffrage et relation client. La personne recrutée
prendra en charge ses affaires de manière autonome, depuis l'analyse du besoin et l'établissement de
l'offre jusqu'au suivi des travaux, à la réception et au contrôle de la rentabilité.

Missions principales

Gestion et suivi des chantiers

• Préparer les chantiers en amont : organisation, planification, besoins humains et matériels et
approvisionnements.
• Piloter et coordonner les équipes internes, fournisseurs et éventuels sous-traitants.
• Participer aux réunions de chantier et assurer le lien avec les clients, bureaux d'études et autres
intervenants.
• Suivre l'avancement des travaux et veiller au respect des délais, de la qualité d'exécution et des règles
de sécurité.
• Anticiper les difficultés techniques ou organisationnelles et mettre en place les actions correctives
nécessaires.
• Organiser la réception des travaux et assurer le suivi des éventuelles réserves.
Études, chiffrage et achats
• Analyser les demandes clients, plans, cahiers des charges et dossiers techniques.
• Réaliser les métrés, études de prix, chiffrages et devis pour les projets ne relevant pas des grilles
tarifaires standards.
• Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, comparer les offres et participer aux négociations.
• Proposer des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins du client, en recherchant le meilleur équilibre
entre performance, faisabilité et coût.
• Intervenir aussi bien sur des projets professionnels et grands comptes que sur des projets résidentiels.
Suivi commercial et financier
• Être l'interlocuteur privilégié du client pendant toute la durée de l'affaire.
• Assurer le suivi commercial des offres et accompagner le client dans ses choix techniques.
• Suivre les budgets, les coûts, les achats et la marge des affaires confiées.
• Identifier et chiffrer les éventuels travaux supplémentaires.
• Transmettre les éléments nécessaires à la facturation et assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la
direction.

Profil recherché

• Expérience significative dans le domaine du chauffage et dans le suivi de chantiers, permettant une
prise en charge autonome des affaires.
• Bonne maîtrise du chiffrage, de la réalisation de devis et de l'analyse de dossiers techniques.
• Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires simultanément et à gérer les priorités.
• Sensibilité aux coûts, à la marge et à la rentabilité des chantiers.
• Organisation, rigueur, autonomie, réactivité et sens des responsabilités.
• Très bon relationnel et capacité à travailler avec les clients, équipes de terrain, fournisseurs et
partenaires.
• Maîtrise courante des outils informatiques et bureautiques ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de chiffrage
ou ERP constitue un atout.
• Permis B indispensable compte tenu des déplacements liés à la fonction.
• La connaissance du marché luxembourgeois et/ou des marchés publics et appels d'offres constitue un
atout.

Ce que nous offrons

• Un contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI) à temps plein.
• Un poste polyvalent avec une réelle autonomie et des responsabilités dès la prise de fonction.
• Un véhicule de société avec carte carburant.
• Les outils professionnels nécessaires à la fonction.
• Un environnement de travail à taille humaine, avec une chaîne de décision courte.
• Des projets variés et la possibilité de participer activement au développement de l'activité.
• De réelles perspectives d'évolution interne en fonction des compétences et de l'implication.

Lieu : Howald, Hesperange - déplacements principalement au Luxembourg et ponctuellement dans la Grande Région.

jobs.title: Customization Execution Lead (x|w|m) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres Consumable Customization Services Teams als Customization Execution Lead (x|w|m) und übernimm eine zentrale Rolle bei der strategischen Steuerung und funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit in unserem Customization-Umfeld. In dieser Rolle verbindest du Sales, PM CCS, Customization Platform, Engineering, Operations und BPM, um Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und strategische Initiativen aufeinander abzustimmen. Durch Transparenz, fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Customization-Prozesse trägst du zu einem planbaren und skalierbaren Operating Model und damit zu besserer Gesundheit für mehr Menschen bei. Zu besetzen ist die Position am Standort Aubagne oder Göttingen mit der Möglichkeit, an einigen Tagen pro Woche remote zu arbeiten.

Wachse mit uns – deine Aufgaben

- Steuere die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, PM CCS, Customization Platform, Engineering, Operations und BPM und bringe unterschiedliche Prioritäten und Abhängigkeiten für eine effektive Umsetzung von Customization-Aktivitäten zusammen
- Entwickle und koordiniere strategische Projekt- und Programmpläne und definiere Ziele, Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Deliverables im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen
- Analysiere die Geschäftsentwicklung im Customization-Umfeld sowie relevante Health-of-Business-Kennzahlen, identifiziere Abweichungen bei Durchlaufzeiten, wiederkehrende Engpässe und Umsetzungsrisiken und leite geeignete Maßnahmen ab
- Priorisiere Smart-Customization- und weitere Verbesserungsinitiativen anhand von Geschäftsauswirkungen, Umsetzbarkeit und organisatorischen Abhängigkeiten und unterstütze eine effektive Umsetzungsreihenfolge und Ressourcenfokussierung
- Stelle ein aussagekräftiges Management Reporting sicher, indem du KPIs, Risiken, offene Themen, Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen konsolidierst und Transparenz für regelmäßige Senior-Management-Reviews schaffst
- Steuere Execution Reviews und Eskalationsmechanismen, unterstütze die funktionsübergreifende Beseitigung von Umsetzungshindernissen und verfolge vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent nach
- Arbeite eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, steuere Erwartungen und sorge für eine gemeinsame Ausrichtung auf strategische Projekt- und Programmziele

Das bringst du mit

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Life Sciences, Projektmanagement oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung
- Mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung im geschäftsbezogenen Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, Business Steering, Business Operations, Operational Excellence oder einem vergleichbaren funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld
- Umfassendes Verständnis strategischer Business-Steering-Prozesse, Methoden und Tools kombiniert mit Kenntnissen von Customization-, Engineered-to-Order- und Quotation-to-Delivery-Prozessen in einem technischen B2B-Umfeld
- Fundierte Erfahrung im Performance Management, in der KPI-Steuerung, Ursachenanalyse und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten zur strukturierten Problemlösung
- Nachweisbare Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zu koordinieren, unterschiedliche Prioritäten zusammenzuführen und Stakeholder in globalen Matrixorganisationen einzubinden
- Ausgeprägtes strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen frühzeitig zu erkennen, Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen zu überführen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen
- Mit deinen sehr guten Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten vermittelst du komplexe Informationen adressatengerecht, auch gegenüber dem Senior Management
- Eine detailgenaue und flexible Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich insbesondere bei Projektdokumentation und Reporting sowie im Umgang mit sich verändernden Anforderungen und Zeitplänen aus
- Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen

Deine Benefits

Als weltweit wachsendes Life-Science-Unternehmen, das im MDAX und TecDAX notiert ist, bietet Sartorius eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen:

- Raum für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung: Mentoring, Leadership-Programme, Talent-Gespräche, internes Seminar-Angebot
- Arbeite in deinem Rhythmus: Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, Gleitzeit, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
- Von Anfang an mitgestalten: Umfassendes Onboarding inklusive Online-Plattform – schon vor dem Einstieg, Workshops, „Buddy“ als Ansprechpartnerin bzw. Ansprechpartner  
- Internes Vernetzen: Communities zu zahlreichen Themen, wie Coaching, agiles Arbeiten und Yoga, Business Women Netzwerk
- Diese Position wird innerhalb der Sartorius Stedim FMT S.A.S. besetzt

Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Nationalitäten, Geschlechter, sexuellen Orientierungen, Religionen, Altersgruppen, Behinderungen und kulturellen Hintergründe.

✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Development
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money. 



In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Sales Development Manager in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA that will recruit, develop, & lead a highly driven and hardworking team of Sales Development Representatives (Inbound) & Business Development Representatives (Outbound). We are looking for someone who is passionate about building a winning team and coaching & elevating the craft of new sellers at Notion. The Sales Development team is the first interaction with prospective Notion customers and is key to the success of our Sales organization!



At Notion the Sales Development team is responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding market share through qualified pipeline, as well as driving the business forward by developing the next generation of top closers. As the Sales Development Lead you will be responsible for delivering both revenue and talent for our business. You will focus on the Recruitment, Enablement and Execution of your team to assure the continued successful trajectory of this strategically important department.



Our ideal candidate for this role has proven experience in managing, building and encouraging a team to achieve daily, weekly and monthly/quarterly targets in addition to delivering feedback to marketing and sales operations about lead quality and process improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 1. As an AMER Sales Development Manager, you will work directly with Sales Managers, cross functionally with Marketing Leadership, & Revenue Operations Leadership in creating and developing Notion’s Sales Development strategy, process and playbooks

 2. Partnering with regional leaders across Sales Strategy, Marketing, and Sales teams to plan territory mapping and pipeline development programs

 3. Build winning teams through Attracting, Hiring, and Developing the world’s best xDRs

 4. Enable your team to relentlessly prospect, identify and qualify sales pipeline through your coaching and mentoring on topics including courageous qualification, prospecting techniques, phone skills, and strategic engagement with Account Executives

 5. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure we capitalize on the massive market opportunity ahead of us

 6. Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 7. Join a fantastic team at a magical time: We've hit profitability and over 100 million users with a small team, which gives us a huge green field to work with. You'll join at the perfect time to shape how we grow from here.

 8. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with the product to inform what we do next.

 9. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.
    
    


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Experience including either
   
   - 1-2 years managing a high-performing Sales Development team
   
   - 1-2 years Account Executive experience (and strong performance) at a SaaS company; after having successfully made the leap from Sales Development to Account Executive 

 - Strong track record of achieving sales targets across team and individual goals

 - Skilled in managing and coaching early-career salespeople

 - You have strong, recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive mindsets, collaboration, and the ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of a high growth startup

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of an early stage team

 - You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, the ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building

 - You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem-solving as part of a regional leadership team

 - You have strong empathy for customers and a passion for revenue and growth

 - You have a good understanding of value selling

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've built new business sales playbooks or processes

 - You've been a first or early hire at a fast-growing start-up before

 - Experience leading and improving Sales Development critical metrics

 - Experience running successful weekly and monthly team meetings
   
   

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.



Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Notion.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and New York City, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $195,000 - $205,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite

jobs.title: Vil du være en del af væksten hos Jørgen Hansen Biler?
jobs.description:
Kan du følge med, når det går stærkt?

Det gør det hos os.

Vi oplever stor vækst. Salget af Kia og MG udvikler sig stærkt, kundetilgangen vokser, og med det nye Kia PV5-program står vi foran en spændende periode med endnu flere muligheder. Vi forventer, at udviklingen fortsætter, og at salget af både Kia og MG kun kommer til at gå endnu stærkere i de kommende år.

Derfor udvider vi holdet.

Vi søger en målrettet salgsrådgiver, der trives med mennesker, tempo og resultater. Du bliver en vigtig del af salgsafdelingen på tværs af vores afdelinger i Skærbæk og Esbjerg og får en alsidig arbejdsuge med kundekontakt, salg, opfølgning og samarbejde på tværs af begge bilhuse. Du bliver samtidig en del af et stærkt salgsteam med 8 salgsrådgivere, hvor sparring, samarbejde og vidensdeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du kan lide, når der er fart på, tager ansvar for dine kunder og følger op på mulighederne, når de opstår. Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor ambitionerne er høje, beslutningsvejene korte, og hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit eget aftryk på resultaterne.

Din arbejdsuge kommer blandt andet til at bestå af:

  • Rådgivning af kunder om deres næste bil

  • Kundekontakt i butikken, på telefon og digitalt

  • Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser, prøvekørsler og leads

  • Opfølgning på aftaler og igangværende salg

  • Oprettelse og opdatering i vores salgs- og CRM-systemer

  • Klargøring af demobiler og biler til fremvisning

  • Sikre stærke kundeoplevelser i både Esbjerg og Skærbæk

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har drive og får ting til at ske

  • Trives med højt tempo og en arbejdsuge, hvor ikke to dage er ens

  • Tager initiativ og ansvar for dine egne opgaver

  • Motiveres af at skabe resultater

  • Følger op og ser opgaverne helt til dørs

  • Er god til mennesker og naturligt skaber relationer

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på aftaler, detaljer og opfølgning

  • Er fleksibel og trives med at arbejde på tværs af vores afdelinger

  • Har interesse for biler og salg

  • Har kørekort til personbil

Vi tilbyder:

  • En selvstændig og alsidig rolle på tværs af vores afdelinger i Esbjerg og Skærbæk

  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger

  • En virksomhed i vækst med ambitioner og muligheder

  • Grundig oplæring i biler, systemer og salgsprocesser

  • Mulighed for mere ansvar i takt med din udvikling

  • Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Korte beslutningsveje og et arbejdsmiljø med højt humør

  • En arbejdsuge, hvor søndagsvagter er en naturlig del af jobbet, og hvor frihed planlægges på andre dage

 

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Indehaver Jørgen Hansen på +45 20 87 43 22 eller jorgen@jh-biler.dk.

Tiltrædelse ønskes snarest muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til jorgen@jh-biler.dk med emnefeltet “Salgsrådgiver”.

Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist
jobs.description:
Consultant Interventional Cardiologist – PCI On-Call Service

Department of Cardiology, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark

The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer
  • The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
  • An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
  • Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
  • An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.

Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements
  • You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
  • You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
  • You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
  • Or are willing to learn Danish
  • You can perform PCI procedures independently.
  • You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
  • You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
  • You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
  • You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
  • You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.

Desirable qualifications
  • Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
  • Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
  • Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
  • Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
  • Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.

About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:
  • 6,000 invasive procedures annually
  • 8,000 inpatient admissions annually
  • More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
  • Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually

Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk
 
Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. The advertisement will be withdrawn once the position has been filled.
Please submit your application by email to:
Ljubica Vukelic Andersen
Head of Department of Cardiology
Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
Email: ljubica.andersen@rn.dk
Telephone: +45 30 38 25 10

Please include:
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • Letter of motivation
  • Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
  • List of publications, if applicable.

The assessment process will follow the applicable Danish requirements for consultant appointments, including assessment of competencies across the seven physician roles.

Skal du være med til at fremtidssikre og energioptimere Danmarks bygninger?

Hos Nordic Facility Solutions ApS oplever vi en stærk efterspørgsel på vores løsninger inden for bygningsautomation, energioptimering og teknisk rådgivning. Derfor søger vi en dygtig og engageret CTS/BMS-tekniker / Project Technician, som vil være med til at levere kompromisløs kvalitet til vores kunder.

Vil du have en fleksibel hverdag med frihed under ansvar, stærk faglig sparring og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på projekterne? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Dine primære opgaver

Som vores nye tekniker får du en alsidig og selvstændig rolle, hvor du arbejder on-site hos vores kunder. Du bliver en nøgleperson i at sikre, at bygningernes tekniske anlæg kører optimalt og energirigtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Idriftsættelse og programmering: Opstart, konfiguration og indregulering af nye og eksisterende CTS/BMS-anlæg.

  • Energioptimering: Analysere drift og sikre det optimale sammenspil mellem varme, ventilation og køling.

  • Service og fejlfinding: Test, diagnosticering, vedligeholdelse samt udvidelser og ombygninger på systemerne.

  • Verificering og dokumentation: Sikre korrekt netværksudstyr, test og rapportering af høj kvalitet.

  • Kundefokus: Være den tillidsskabende tekniske ekspert og sparringspartner for bygningsejere, driftspersonale og samarbejdspartnere.

Hvem er du?

Du er fagligt stolt, løsningsorienteret og drives af at levere løsninger, der gør en reel forskel for den grønne omstilling. Du trives i en udadvendt rolle, hvor du tilrettelægger din egen arbejdsdag on-site hos kunden.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en teknisk baggrund som f.eks. automatiktekniker, elektriker, CTS-tekniker, maskinmester eller lignende erfaring inden for bygningsautomation.

  • Har solid erfaring med programmering, idriftsættelse og fejlfinding på CTS/BMS-systemer (kendskab til f.eks. Schneider, Siemens eller Niagara er en fordel).

  • Har en god forståelse for bygningsinstallationer (HVAC / VVS / EL) og energibesparelser.

  • Er selvstartende, strukturerede og ansvarsbevidst i din tilgang til projekterne.

  • Kommunikerer klart og tillidsfuldt på dansk (og gerne engelsk) i skrift og tale.

  • Har kørekort (kategori B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Nordic Facility Solutions ApS træder du ind i et stærkt tværfagligt miljø med hurtige kommandoveje og en flad organisationsstruktur. Vi værdsætter engagement, høj faglighed og det gode kollegaskab.

Du får blandt andet:

  • Frihed og fleksibilitet: Høj grad af medbestemmelse over din egen arbejdsdag og opgaveløsning.

  • Faglig udvikling: Løbende sparring med dygtige kolleger samt gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og kurser.

  • Afvekslende hverdag: Spændende projekter i marken kombineret med gode relationer.

  • Attraktive vilkår: Lønpakke svarende til kvalifikationer, sundhedssikring, evnt. firmabil / kørselsordning og pensionsordning.

Er du interesseret?

Vil du være en del af vores hold? Så send os dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Du er velkommen til at kontakte Mikkel Behrendtsen på tlf. +4540920073 eller Mb@nordicfacilitysolutions.com

  • Send din ansøgning til: Mb@nordicfacilitysolutions.com

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen hos Nordic Facility Solutions ApS!

jobs.title: Er du typen, der tager ansvar og får tingene til at spille? Så læs med her!
jobs.description:
Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og praktisk anlagt medarbejder til en fuldtidsstilling på daghold hos en mindre produktionsvirksomhed i Herning.

Virksomheden producerer blandt andet bordplader og trapper, og her er stolte håndværkstraditioner og høj kvalitet en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan lide at tage fat, holde overblik og gå forrest, når der er brug for det. Du behøver ikke at være leder, men du skal have lyst til at tage ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrage til, at hverdagen fungerer godt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Pakning og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Forsendelse og håndtering af tilhørende papirer

  • Truckkørsel

  • Betjening af pudsemaskine

  • Læsning af tegninger, ordrer og arbejdsinstruktioner

Der kan også være andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen, så det er vigtigt, at du trives med en varieret arbejdsdag og er klar til at hjælpe dér, hvor der er behov.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er en voksen og moden person, som har en naturlig ansvarsfølelse og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du tager gerne initiativ, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har øje for både kvalitet og orden.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra træindustrien og/eller med lager og logistik

  • Har truckcertifikat og erfaring med truckkørsel

  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Er stabil, kvalitetsbevidst og god til at samarbejde

  • Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk – det er et krav, da du skal kunne læse tegninger, ordrer, forsendelsespapirer og vigtige arbejdsinstruktioner på dansk

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed med omkring 15 engagerede kolleger, som står klar til at tage godt imod dig og lære dig op i opgaverne.

Her er der kort vej fra tanke til handling, og du får mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift. Det er en arbejdsplads, hvor man hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og arbejder sammen om at levere et godt resultat.

Du bliver i første omgang ansat gennem Medarbejderne ApS i en prøveperiode. For den rette medarbejder er der gode muligheder for fastansættelse hos virksomheden på sigt.

Lyder det som en stilling for dig?

Så ansøg om stillingen via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020175

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails bliver IKKE behandlet.

Arbejdssted: Herning
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid på daghold

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet Vikar & Rekrutterings Bureau, med mange års erfaring og en høj standard. Vi er medlem af VikarBranchen DI, som bla. andet forpligtiger os til at overholde mange etiske regler så som GDPR og overenskomster. Vi lever af at knytte kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

Restaurantchef søges til Bandholm Badehotel – en del af Horizon

Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for service og gæsteoplevelser på Bandholm Badehotel?

Vi søger en engageret restaurantchef, der har passion for værtskab og lyst til at udvikle både vores service og vores team.

På Bandholm Badehotel er nærvær, kvalitet og gode gæsteoplevelser omdrejningspunktet. Som restaurantchef får du ansvaret for vores Restaurant Alba samt morgenmad, konferencer og selskaber – i tæt samarbejde med køkkenet, hotellets øvrige afdelinger og dit tjenerteam og vores driftchef Rasmus.

Vi søger en dygtig og struktureret leder, som skaber overblik, går forrest i driften og sørger for, at både gæster og medarbejdere føler sig godt tilpas.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på service, arbejdsgange og gæsteoplevelser.

  • En varieret arbejdsdag i smukke omgivelser ved vandet.

  • En arbejdsplads med en god tone, stærkt sammenhold og tæt samarbejde på tværs af huset.

  • Mulighed for faglig sparring på tværs af Horizon, som Bandholm Badehotel er en del af.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Ansvar for den daglige restaurantdrift og service, herunder morgenmad, frokost, à la carte, konferencer og selskaber.

  • Planlægning af vagter og bemanding i tjenerteamet.

  • Sikring af høj kvalitet i værtskab, servering og den samlede gæsteoplevelse.

  • Opfølgning på økonomi, lønforbrug og relevante nøgletal.

  • Oplæring og udvikling af dit team, både fagligt og servicemæssigt.

  • Sikring af, at medarbejderne kender menuer, vine og hotellets tilbud, så de kan vejlede gæsterne med sikkerhed og engagement.

  • Selskabssamtaler og planlægning i samarbejde med vores koordinator.

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og hotellets øvrige afdelinger.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er faglært tjener eller har tilsvarende erfaring og faglig viden.

  • Er en tydelig, motiverende og nærværende leder, som selv går forrest, men også giver andre ansvar og plads til at udvikle sig.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er travlt.

  • Indgår aktivt i driften og tror på, at et stærkt team skabes ved at arbejde sammen.

  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem god service, kvalitet og en sund økonomi.

  • Har lyst til at være med til at videreudvikle Bandholm Badehotel som et sted, gæsterne glæder sig til at besøge og vende tilbage til.

Kort om Bandholm Badehotel og Horizon

Bandholm Badehotel ligger i smukke omgivelser ved vandet på Lolland. Her danner hotellet og Restaurant Alba rammen om ophold, restaurantbesøg, konferencer og selskaber med fokus på nærvær, gastronomi og godt værtskab.

Vi er en del af Horizon, som driver flere hoteller og restauranter. Det giver os et fællesskab med mulighed for at dele erfaringer, udvikle medarbejdere og hente inspiration på tværs af vores steder.

Hos os får du mulighed for at få indflydelse på din arbejdsplads og være med til at omsætte ambitioner til gode oplevelser for vores gæster.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

  • PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

  • Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

  • Expertise in visual attention and perception

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

  • Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

  • Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

  • Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

  • Good command of statistics

  • Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

  • Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

  • Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

  • A detailed CV

  • Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

  • A complete and numbered list of publications 

  • Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

  • Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
